# dsh-guard-plan-qc — Labour protection and safety protective equipment configuration table check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-guard-plan-qc` reads one 劳动防护用品配置表 — the headcount and period the plan states, plus one row per configured product — and checks that table's own completeness and internal consistency: that every row fills 品名 (product name), 规格型号 (specification) and 配置数量 (quantity), that the quantity parses as a number greater than zero, that it reconciles with the headcount the plan states times the per-person factor you configure, that the 发放日期 (issue date) falls inside the plan period, that the 有效截止日期 (expiry date) is later than the issue date, and that the table covers the product categories you require.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-guard-plan-qc: real output over its GP-002 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-guard-plan-qc/main/docs/assets/dsh-guard-plan-qc-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `GP-002` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row names the product but leaves 规格型号 empty. Is that reported? | Yes. `GP-001` requires every row to fill the fields in `requiredFields` — shipped as 品名, 规格型号 and 配置数量, replaceable with your own table's columns — and reports the row together with the fields it is missing; an empty string counts as unfilled. It checks that the columns are filled, not whether the product or its specification is the right one. |
| The 配置数量 cell says 若干. Is that the same as a quantity of zero? | No. `GP-002` reports the two separately: a value it cannot parse (such as 若干) is reported as not being a number, while a value that parses but is not greater than zero is reported with the figure itself. `2双`, `１，２００` and `2 件` all parse, unit attached. The rule does not check whether the figure is true or whether the quantity is enough; with `checkQuantity` set to false it does not run at all. |
| The headcount is 20 and `factors` gives 绝缘手套 2 per person, but the row configures 30. Will that be caught? | Yes, once `factors` is configured. `GP-003` multiplies the per-person factor by the headcount and reports a matching row whose quantity differs by more than its `tolerance`. `factors` ships empty, so as delivered the rule reports itself in `skipped` with that reason instead of passing silently; it also reports itself there when the material declares no headcount. The factor is the figure you looked up, not a national one — the rule does not judge whether it is reasonable. |
| The plan period is 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31 and a 发放日期 reads 2026-02-20. Is it reported? | Yes. `GP-004` reports that row as earlier than `periodFrom`. The period comes from the material's top-level `periodFrom` / `periodTo`; when both are missing the rule reports itself in `skipped` rather than assuming a period, and a date it cannot parse is reported separately instead of being skipped silently. |
| The 有效截止日期 is the same day as the 发放日期. Does it pass? | No. `GP-005` requires the expiry date to be later than the issue date and reports the row when it is not, and it runs only when the row states both dates. Whether that validity period is long enough — it depends on the product and the job — is not judged. |
| The table lists 安全帽 but my required list says 安全头盔. Will it be reported as uncovered? | Yes. `GP-006` compares by literal containment against 品名 and 规格型号, so a different wording for the same product is reported as uncovered; list the common spellings as well, or unify the table's wording. `requiredCategories` ships empty, so as delivered the rule reports itself in `skipped`. It checks only whether the category appears, not whether the product suits the project. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《个体防护装备配备规范》 | GB 39800.1—2020（个体防护装备配备规范 第1部分：总则；标准号不带"/T"⇒强制性；2020-12-24 发布、2022-01-01 实施；主管部门应急管理部；条号本次未取得） | GP-001, GP-002, GP-003, GP-004, GP-005, GP-006 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks one **劳动防护用品配置表** for what a table can be held to — that every row
names a product with a specification and a quantity, that the quantity is a positive number, that it
reconciles with the headcount the plan states, that the issue date falls inside the plan period, that an
expiry date follows the issue date, and that the table covers the categories you require. It does **not**
judge whether a given product is the right protection for a given hazard, whether its protection level
suffices, or whether it counts as special protective equipment.

> ### ⚠️ Read this before trusting a citation in the report
>
> **Every `excerpt` in this plugin's rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not
> obtained.** The regime lives in **GB 39800.1《个体防护装备配备规范》** and 《劳动防护用品监督管理规定》.
> The verification pass for this plugin could not retrieve verbatim clause text from them, so rather than
> paraphrase a quotation the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and puts the honest
> reasoning in `note`. Everything is therefore capped at `warn` (principle-derived) or `info` (locally
> configured), and a test asserts that no rule claims a quotation it does not have. **When the texts are
> in hand, two things must be done: replace each `excerpt` with the real clause, and raise `kind` to
> `direct`.**
>
> **The two numbers that would make this plugin powerful are the two it refuses to invent.** How many
> items each person needs (`GP-003` `factors`) and which product categories a job must cover (`GP-006`
> `requiredCategories`) depend on the hazard identification for *your* project, not on a national figure.
> Both ship **empty**, and a rule whose list is unset reports itself in `skipped` rather than passing.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a batch of plans use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `guard_plan_qc` tool. It reads one configuration table — rows keyed by the table's own
column names, plus the plan's headcount and period — and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GP-001` | every row names 品名, 规格型号 and 配置数量 | info | local |
| `GP-002` | the quantity parses to a positive number | warn | principle |
| `GP-003` | the quantity reconciles with headcount × per-person factor (off by default) | info | local |
| `GP-004` | the issue date falls inside the plan period | warn | principle |
| `GP-005` | an expiry date is later than the issue date | warn | principle |
| `GP-006` | the table covers your required categories (off by default) | info | local |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-guard-plan-qc
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-guard-plan-qc'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/guard-plan-qc.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string | `""` | Note appended to every `skipped` reason |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `120000` | Cooperative tool timeout budget |

Rule-level parameters worth knowing:

- `GP-001` `requiredFields` — defaults to `[品名, 规格型号, 配置数量]`; replace it with your form's columns.
- `GP-002` `checkQuantity` — set to `false` to stop checking quantities.
- `GP-003` `factors` — your per-person factors, e.g.
  `[{ match: 绝缘手套, perPerson: 2, tolerance: 0 }]`. `match` is a substring test on 品名.
- `GP

# dsh-repair-order-qc — Motor-vehicle repair work-order register and settlement arithmetic check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-repair-order-qc` reads one motor-vehicle repair work-order register — the vehicle header plus one row per item line — and checks that register's own completeness and arithmetic: that the customer's report and the work done are recorded, that the item name column is filled, that quantity, unit price and amount are parseable, that amount equals quantity × unit price, that the line amounts total the settlement figure, that the settlement figure equals parts plus labour less discount, that the receipt date does not fall after the delivery date, that work-order numbers are unique in the register, and that no template placeholder survives in the item name column.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-repair-order-qc: real output over its RO-001 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-repair-order-qc/main/docs/assets/dsh-repair-order-qc-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `RO-001` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A line says quantity 2, unit price 180, and an amount of 400 — does the check notice? | Yes. `RO-002` reports that row, because 2 × 180 = 360 while the amount cell says 400. The rule runs only when quantity, unit price and amount all parse as numbers, and its tolerance is `0.01` for rounding. It does not judge whether the unit price is reasonable or whether the item should have been charged at all. |
| The line amounts do not add up to the settlement figure written in the header of the material. | `RO-003` adds the `amount` column and compares that total with the settlement figure `total` stated in the material header, reporting how many rows it summed and how large the gap is. The tolerance is `0.01`. It only performs that addition; it does not judge whether the individual charges are reasonable. |
| Our work orders carry no parts total and no labour total — can the plugin still tell me the settlement figure is wrong? | No, and it says so. `RO-004` checks parts plus labour less discount against the settlement figure and reports itself in `skipped` when the material carries no `partsTotal` and `laborTotal` totals, instead of assuming a composition. Its discount column means a reduction amount; a register that records a discount rate should disable the rule or use another check. |
| The delivery date is earlier than the receipt date. | `RO-005` reports that row: it compares the receipt date with the delivery date and reports the row when receipt falls after delivery. The same day counts as not later, a date it cannot parse is reported on its own row rather than passed over in silence, and it does not judge whether the repair took a reasonable length of time. |
| The same work-order number appears on two rows. | `RO-006` reports the repeated number, because it would double-count the fees and break the link between a work order and its archive; whitespace is ignored when comparing. One work order spread over several item lines is a legitimate shape — distinguish those rows in the item name column instead of repeating the number. The rule checks uniqueness only. |
| The item name cell still reads 【】 or 待填. | `RO-007` reports the residual placeholder, because a work order with no real item cannot be settled. The `terms` list it looks for is the one in its own rule pack and can be adjusted to your template. It only checks whether those literal strings appear, not whether the wording is apt. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《机动车维修管理规定》 | 交通运输部令2021年第18号（2005 年公布，经 2015、2016、2019、2021 年四次修正，自 2005 年 8 月 1 日起施行） | RO-001, RO-002, RO-003, RO-004, RO-005, RO-006, RO-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **机动车维修工单** for arithmetic and completeness — that the customer's
report and the work performed are recorded, that a line's amount equals quantity × unit price, that the line
amounts total the settlement figure, that the settlement figure equals parts plus labour less discount, that
delivery does not precede receipt, that work-order numbers are used consistently, and that no placeholder
survives. It does **not** decide whether a repair was necessary, whether a charge is reasonable, whether there
was over-servicing, or whether the work was done properly.

> ### ⚠️ It checks arithmetic, not the repair
>
> A work order with perfectly consistent figures for work that should never have been sold passes this plugin.
> Judging necessity and price needs the vehicle's actual condition, the technical standards and the repair
> contract — this plugin has none of them.
>
> **The labour rate comes from the register or your configuration.** No rate standard is built in. The plugin
> does not check whether a part is genuine either; it reports what the register says.
>
> Two arithmetic rules read the register's composition, and **both say so when they cannot run**:
>
> - `RO-002` verifies `金额 = 数量 × 单价`, and reports itself in `skipped` unless all three cells parse. Its
>   tolerance is `0.01`, for rounding.
> - `RO-004` verifies `配件费合计 + 工时费合计 − 折扣 = 结算总额`. The subtraction is expressed as a **per-term
>   sign** in the rule pack (`signs: [1, 1, -1]`) rather than a negative scale, so the finding reads like the
>   arithmetic a person would write. A register with no parts/labour breakdown leaves the rule unrun instead of
>   assuming a composition.
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The regime
> lives in 《机动车维修管理规定》 and GB/T 16739. The verification pass could not retrieve verbatim clause
> text, so the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and keeps every rule at `warn` or `info`.
> **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the real clause and raise `kind` to `direct`.**

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a month of orders use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `repair_order_qc` tool. It reads one repair-order register — the vehicle header plus one row per
item line — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RO-001` | the report and the work performed are recorded | warn | direct |
| `RO-002` | a line's amount equals quantity × unit price | warn | direct |
| `RO-003` | line amounts total the settlement figure | warn | direct |
| `RO-004` | the total equals parts + labour − discount | warn | direct |
| `RO-005` | delivery does not precede receipt | warn | principle |
| `RO-006` | work-order numbers are used consistently | warn | principle |
| `RO-007` | the item column holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |
## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-repair-order-qc
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-repair-order-qc'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/repair-order-qc.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string | `""` | Note appended to every `skipped` reason |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `120000` | Cooperative tool timeout budget |

Rule-level parameters worth knowing:

- `RO-002` `resultField` / `factorFields` / `tolerance` — the line arithmetic.
- `RO-003` `field`

# dsh-nurse-record-check — Nursing record timeliness, sign-off and assessment-form completeness check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-nurse-record-check` reads a machine-readable export of one inpatient episode — nursing entries, medical orders and completed assessment forms — and checks the timeliness, sign-off and assessment-form record of that nursing documentation (护理记录), reporting literal mismatches against cited clauses: that every nursing entry leaves a traceable recorder and a time, that every date and time is written in 24-hour form and can be read, that a rescue record's time is precise to the minute and its note is written up within 6 hours of the rescue ending, that a temporary order carries an execution time and the executing nurse's signature and that a cancelled order records its cancellation, that the first nursing assessment and the documentation frequency meet the thresholds the institution configures, that fall-risk and pressure-injury assessment forms are on file, and that the rounds interval matches the graded-nursing guidance for the care level the record states. A check that cannot run is listed in `skipped` instead of passing.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-nurse-record-check: real output over its NR-007 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-nurse-record-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-nurse-record-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `NR-007` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A nursing entry came out of the ward system with no signing nurse. Is that reported? | Yes. `NR-001` reports every nursing entry that leaves no recorder identifier, and also a `nurseId` that does not match the configured staff-number pattern. It checks that the material leaves a recorder mark and a time, not how the electronic signature is technically implemented. |
| One time value in the export will not parse. What does the rule do with it? | `NR-002` reports the value and expects a time written in 24-hour form and readable as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`. A record whose time cannot be parsed is then left out of the later time-window comparisons, so it surfaces here rather than as a deadline finding — the rule checks that the time can be read, not that it is the true time. |
| Our rescue record gives the date of the rescue but no clock time. | `NR-003` reports a `rescue` record whose time is precise only to the day, because the time of a rescue must be precise to the minute. The pack notes that the two documents it cites do not require the same thing — one requires 抢救时间 to the minute, the other the 记录时间 — and presents them together with each source marked separately. |
| The rescue note was written up the next morning. Is that late? | `NR-004` compares the recorded time with `rescueEndedAt` and reports a gap longer than 6 hours; a note written before the rescue ended is reported too. With no `rescueEndedAt` there is nothing to compare, and the check reports that it could not run instead of passing. |
| A temporary order was carried out, but the executing nurse's signature column is blank. | `NR-005` reports a temporary order whose execution record is missing the execution time or the executing nurse's signature. It applies to 临时医嘱 only — the long-term order sheet carries different content items and must not be read alike — and it does not check how long after execution the signature was made, because the pack found no signature deadline. |
| Some rules come back as `skipped` rather than passing. What does that mean? | It means the check did not run, not that it passed. `NR-008` and `NR-012` ship with their thresholds empty (`maxAfterAdmission`, `intervalHours`), because the pack found no national threshold it could apply to nursing records — and it records that the 24 hours it did find belongs to the 入院记录 written by a physician and must not be carried over to the first nursing assessment — while `NR-011` likewise reports itself in `skipped` for 特级护理, where the guidance states no interval, and when there are fewer than two `rounds` entries to compare. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《电子病历应用管理规范（试行）》 | 国卫办医发〔2017〕8号 | NR-001, NR-006, NR-010 |
| 《病历书写基本规范》 | 卫医政发〔2010〕11号 | NR-002, NR-003, NR-004, NR-005, NR-007, NR-010, NR-012 |
| 《医疗质量安全核心制度要点》 | 国卫医发〔2018〕8号 | NR-003, NR-004 |
| 《卫生部办公厅关于在医疗机构推行表格式护理文书的通知》 | 卫办医政发〔2010〕125号 | NR-005 |
| 《护理分级标准》 | WS/T 431—2023（全部代替 WS/T 431—2013；推荐性卫生行业标准，2024-02-01 施行） | NR-008 |
| 《进一步改善护理服务行动计划（2023—2025年）》 | 国卫医政发〔2023〕16号 | NR-009 |
| 《三级医院评审标准（2020年版）》 | 国卫医发〔2020〕26号 | NR-009 |
| 《综合医院分级护理指导原则（试行）》 | 卫医政发〔2009〕49号 | NR-011 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks the timeliness, sign-off and assessment-form record of **nursing**
documentation (护理记录) in an **inpatient** episode. It is not `dsh-medrec-qc` (which checks the
front sheet of the medical record and its internal contradictions), not a nursing-quality
scorecard, and not a clinical decision aid. It reads a machine-readable export and reports literal
mismatches against cited clauses; it never decides whether an episode of care was appropriate.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a directory of episodes use `ptc` to pay schema cost once |

## What it does

Registers the `nurse_record_check` tool. It reads one patient episode — nursing entries, medical
orders and assessment forms — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report whose every
finding names the clause it came from.

| Rule | Check | Severity |
|---|---|---|
| `NR-001` | every nursing entry carries a traceable recorder (id and time) | error |
| `NR-002` | every date/time in the material is written in 24-hour form and is readable | error |
| `NR-003` | rescue-note times are precise to the minute | error |
| `NR-004` | a rescue note is written up within 6 hours of the rescue ending | error |
| `NR-005` | a temporary order carries an execution time and the executing nurse's signature | error |
| `NR-006` | an execution time is not earlier than the order's placement time | info |
| `NR-007` | a cancelled order records its cancellation and signature | error |
| `NR-008` | the first nursing assessment meets the **locally configured** window | info |
| `NR-009` | fall-risk and pressure-injury forms are on file | warn |
| `NR-010` | a record's timestamp is not earlier than the event it documents | info |
| `NR-011` | the rounds interval matches the graded-nursing guidance for the care level | error |
| `NR-012` | documentation frequency meets the **locally configured** policy | info |

Two rules ship unconfigured on purpose, because no national threshold exists for them. They report
themselves in `skipped` and never silently pass.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-nurse-record-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-nurse-record-check'
```

## Configuration

Every tunable lives in the Schemastery schema in `src/config.ts`, so it can be changed from
`cordis.yml` without editing code.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/nurse-record.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string | `""` | Note appended to every `skipped` reason |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `120000` | Cooperative tool timeout budget |

## Material format

The

# dsh-skill-labels **为 DeepSeek Harness 技能目录中的每项技能添加一个简短的中文标题，置于描述之前。** `html-ppt` → `【写PPT】HTML PPT Studio — author professional static HTML presentations …` [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0e7490?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.2-informational?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![dependencies: none](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-none-success?style=flat-square)](#兼容性与运行要求) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/Siloet-phy/dsh-skill-labels) [English](README.en.md) | **简体中文**
--- ## 目录 - [概述](#概述) - [效果](#效果) - [特性](#特性) - [与同类插件的区别](#与同类插件的区别) - [安装](#安装) - [配置](#配置) - [让 AI 帮你补标签](#让-ai-帮你补标签) - [工作原理](#工作原理) - [兼容性与运行要求](#兼容性与运行要求) - [安全与隐私](#安全与隐私) - [已知限制](#已知限制) - [常见问题](#常见问题) - [开发](#开发) - [卸载与升级](#卸载与升级) - [许可证](#许可证) ## 概述 DeepSeek Harness 的技能目录有两个出口：一是模型在会话中看到的 `available_skills` 列表，二是输入框 `/` 唤出的技能菜单。两者默认只提供技能名与英文描述——技能名多为 `office-xlsx`、`vision-skills` 这类标识符，英文描述又是面向模型的完整句式，人在列表里逐条辨认成本较高。 本插件在每条技能描述之前添加一个 4–7 字的中文标题，形如 `【写Excel】Read, create, and modify Excel workbooks (.xlsx) …`，用于快速识别技能用途。**英文原描述完整保留**，不改动任何面向模型的触发信息。 ## 效果 输入框 `/` 菜单里的实际效果（同一份目录数据，模型侧与菜单侧一致）： ![技能菜单中的中文标题](docs/skills-menu.png) | | 技能名 | 描述 | |---|---|---| | 安装前 | `html-ppt` | HTML PPT Studio — author professional static HTML presentations in many styles, layouts, and animations … | | 安装后 | `html-ppt` | **【写PPT】** HTML PPT Studio — author professional static HTML presentations in many styles, layouts, and animations … | 其余示例： ```text - `office-docx`: 【写Word】Create, read, edit, and check Word documents (.docx) … - `office-xlsx`: 【写Excel】Read, create, and modify Excel workbooks (.xlsx) … - `vision-skills`: 【看图还原界面】把截图或设计图还原为 UI … - `dsh-deepread`: 【精读文章】Evidence-first deep reading for books, articles, PDFs … ``` ## 特性 - **中文标题前置** — 标题位于描述之前，默认排版为 `【标题】原描述`，可通过 `format` 调整。 - **两个出口同时生效** — 模型技能目录与 `/` 菜单读取同一份数据，无需分别适配。 - **标签表是活的** — 内置表、包内表、用户表、行配置四级覆盖；标签文件按修改时间懒加载，保存即生效，无需重启或重装。 - **AI 能自己补标签** — 插件注册一个 `skill_labels` 工具：让模型列出未标注的技能，并把标签直接写进你的用户标签表。**这是同类插件没有的能力**（见下节）。 - **标签不限于中文** — 标签就是一段前缀文字，emoji、英文短名、编号都可以（例如 `🎨 画图`、`excel`、`① 常用`）。 - **零依赖、零配置** — 无第三方依赖、无 `peerDependencies`、无构建步骤，安装后默认启用。 - **未登记技能不作改动** — 标签表中没有的技能保持原样，并仅在宿主日志中保留一条 debug 记录。 - **可安全卸载** — 卸载时恢复被包装的注册表方法，技能目录回到插件未安装时的状态。 ## 与同类插件的区别 技能菜单方向已开源的项目主要有两个（截至 2026-10-11）： | | [dsh-skill-source-label](https://github.com/lingyired/dsh-skill-source-label) | [dsh-skill-manager-ytxue](https://github.com/YTxue/dsh-skill-manager-ytxue) | **本插件** | |---|---|---|---| | 解决的问题 | 标出技能来源（项目/个人/内置） | 技能管理面板：启停、批量导入、规范自检 | 中文标签，一眼看懂技能用途 | | 展示内容 | 括号里的来源标记 | 设置页里的管理界面 | 每条技能描述前的中文标题 | | 标签可自定义 | 否（来源是枚举值） | 否 | **是**，四级覆盖 + 文件热更新 | | 模型侧技能目录 | 否 | 否 | **是**，与 `/` 菜单同一份数据 | | 让 AI 维护标签 | 否 | 否 | **是**，`skill_labels` 工具 | | 依赖 | — | — | 零依赖、不联网 | 一句话：它们改的是「技能从哪来」和「技能怎么管」，本插件改的是「技能叫什么、一眼能不能看懂」；而且这套标签**是你自己的**，随时能改，也能交给 AI 补。 ## 安装 需要先在 profile 中安装本插件，再由 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 启用。以下命令任选其一。 **从 GitHub 安装（推荐）：** ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:Siloet-phy/dsh-skill-labels ``` 桌面版（Desktop 应用使用的 profile）将 `web` 替换为 `desktop`： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Siloet-phy/dsh-skill-labels ``` **从本地目录安装（开发调试）：** ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add file:/绝对路径/dsh-skill-labels ``` **不安装，直接挂载（改动立即生效，适用于源码调试）：** 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加一行 `insert`，`name` 指向本地 `index.js` 的绝对 URL（Windows 使用 `file:///C:/…` 形式）： ```yaml - insert: - id: skill-labels name: 'file:///C:/path/to/dsh-skill-labels/index.js' config: {} ``` > 三种方式**只应保留一种**，同时存在会使插件被挂载两次。 > 安装完成后需重启对应 profile 的 DSH；直接挂载方式无需重启。 ## 配置 默认配置即可使用。标签依次从以下四处读取，**后者覆盖前者**： | 顺序 | 来源 | 用途 | |---:|---|---| | 1 | 内置 `DEFAULT_LABELS` | 12 条常用技能的默认标题 | | 2 | 包内 `labels.json` | 随包分发的公共标签表 | | 3 | `~/.dsh/skill-labels.json` | 用户私有标签表，**升级插件不会覆盖** | | 4 | 行配置 `config.labels` | 直接写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中 | 用户私有标签表格式如下（Windows 路径为 `C:\Users\<用户名>\.dsh\skill-labels.json`）： ```json { "my-own-skill": "我的技能", "html-ppt": "做幻灯片" } ``` 标签表在文件修改时间变化后自动重新读取，保存后无需重启。 标签不限于中文——它就是一段前缀文字，emoji、英文短名、编号都可以： ```json { "html-ppt": "🎨 画图", "office-xlsx": "excel", "my-own-skill": "① 常用" } ``` 行配置项： | 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 | |---|---|---|---| | `format` | string | `【{label}】{description}` | 排版模板，必须包含 `{description}`；`{label}` 为中文标题 | | `labels` | object | `{}` | 名称到标题的映射，优先级最高 | | `labelsFile` | string \| false | `~/.dsh/skill-labels.json` | 用户标签表路径；`false` 表示不读取该文件 | ```yaml - insert: - id: skill-labels name: 'dsh-skill-labels' config: format: '【{label}】{description}' labels: html-ppt: 写PPT labelsFile: 'D:/my-labels.json' ``` > profile 的 patch 层中，同一 `id` 的 `config` 是**整块替换**而非深合并，覆盖时需写出完整配置。 ## 让 AI 帮你补标签 手写 JSON 太麻烦，所以插件自带一个 **`skill_labels` 工具**（装完重启 DSH 后出现在模型的工具列表里）。你只要在会话里说人话： > 看看哪些技能还没有中文标签，都加上吧，标签短一点，4–7 个字，能一眼看出用途。 模型就会： 1. 调 `skill_labels { action: "list" }` —— 拿到每个技能的现有标签、标签来源（`builtin` / `package` / `user` / `config`）以及**未标注清单**（附技能描述，方便起标题）； 2. 按描述拟好中文短标题，调 `skill_labels { action: "set", labels: { "some-skill": "某个技能" } }` 写进 `~/.dsh/skill-labels.json`； 3. 下一次读取技能目录时新标签就生效（模型侧目录也会在下一个步骤刷新）。无需重启、无需手动编辑文件。 写入行为是保守的： - **合并**而不是覆盖 —— 你已有的标签一条不动； - **原子写入** —— 先写临时文件再改名，不会写坏文件； - **只写这一个文件** —— 标签表路径由 `labelsFile` 决定，不碰任何其它文件； - **表损坏就拒绝写** —— 已有标签文件不是合法 JSON 时，工具报错而不是覆盖你的数据； - **非法条目跳过并回报** —— 名字不是 kebab-case、标签为空或超过 32 字的条目会被列出来。 想自己看当前状态（不想让模型动手），直接问它「列一下技能标签」即可，`action: "list"` 只读不写。 ## 工作原理 ### 单一数据源 技能目录的所有消费者都经过同一处：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` 的 `SkillRegistry.snapshot()` / `list()`。 | 出口 | 调用链 | |---|---| | 模型技能目录 | `dsh-tool-skill` → `ctx.skills.snapshot()` → 渲染为 `` - `名称`: 描述 `` | | 输入框 `/` 菜单 | `dsh-client-ui-skill` → Remote `skills/list` → `sessionSkillCatalog.list()` → `skillRegistry.list()` | ### 实现方式 插件在技能注册表的**原型**上包装 `snapshot()` 与 `list()`，在结果交付前改写每条 summary 的 `description`。 - **幂等**：已处理的 summary 记录在 `WeakSet` 中，因此 `list()` 内部再次调用 `snapshot()` 时不会重复添加标题，同一文件被挂载两次也不会叠加。 - **影响面最小**：仅改写 `description`。技能名、`invocation` 策略、`path`、`source`、`provider` 均不变，技能正文的加载路径（`get()`）完全不受影响。 - **失败降级**：若目标方法不存在或改名，插件只记录一条 warning，技能目录保持原样，不会中断会话。 - **可还原**：包装函数随 `ctx.effect` 的清理函数一并撤销。 ### 工具那半 `skill_labels` 工具按 `tools.register()` 的契约直接构造（`{ name, description, parameters, output: { schema, render }, execute }`），因此**不需要** `import @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`，插件的依赖表仍然是空的。它做两件事： | action | 作用 | 是否写盘 | |---|---|---| | `list` | 读 `ctx.skills.list()`，逐项比对四级标签表，回报标签、来源与未标注清单 | 否 | | `set` | 把 `{技能名: 标签}` 合并进用户标签表（原子写入） | 只写标签表这一个文件 | profile 没有 `tools` 服务、或注册抛错时，插件只记一条日志，标签功能照常工作。 ### 设计取舍 - **保留英文原描述**：描述中的触发语句（如 `Use when the user asks for …`）是模型选择技能的依据，翻译会降低命中率，因此只做前缀标注。 - **不接入机器翻译**：自动翻译会让每次目录读取都依赖网络与一次模型调用，延迟与结果均不可控；改用人工维护的标签表。 - **不是官方扩展点**：DSH 的技能注册表未提供描述装饰钩子，因此实现依赖上述方法签名。这也是插件保持极小体量的原因。 ## 兼容性与运行要求 | 项目 | 要求 | |---|---| | DeepSeek Harness | 在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 实测通过；仅使用 `ctx.skills`、`ctx.tools`（可选）与 `ctx.logger`，预期兼容 0.1.x 及以后版本 | | Profile | `web` / `desktop` / `headless`——只要该 profile 挂载了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` 与 `dsh-tool-skill`（基础组合均包含） | | 操作系统 | Windows / macOS / Linux，纯 JavaScript，无原生模块 | | Node.js | `>= 20`（跟随 DSH 自带运行时即可） | | 第三方依赖 | 无；`peerDependencies` 为空，不导入任何 DSH 包 | | 工具可见性 | `skill_labels` 在**重启 DSH（或新开会话）后**出现在工具列表里；标签渲染本身不需要重启 | ## 安全与隐私 - **网络**：不发起任何网络请求，无遥测与上报。 - **文件系统**：默认只**读取**两个可选的 JSON 标签表；唯一的写入发生在你或模型调用 `skill_labels { action: "set" }` 时，且只写标签表这一个文件（先写临时文件再改名）。 - **会话与提示词**：不追加会话事件、不注入提示词；技能目录的改写发生在读取返回的那一刻。 - **工具**：只注册一个 `skill_labels`，只读写标签表；不需要任何额外权限。 ## 已知限制 1. 仅对**经由技能注册表读取**的技能目录生效；绕过注册表自行渲染技能列表的插件不受影响。 2. 标签为人工维护，不提供自动翻译；未登记技能保持原样。 3. 标签按技能名匹配，同名技能只能共用一个标题。 4. 输入框 `/` 菜单的目录由客户端按会话缓存，标签变更后需**刷新页面**才可见。 ## 常见问题 **安装后没有变化？** `/` 菜单的目录由客户端缓存，刷新页面即可生效；模型侧会在下一个步骤收到替换后的技能目录。 **会影响技能加载速度或成功率吗？** 不会。插件不参与技能正文加载（`get()`），只在 `snapshot()` /

plugins.description: Windows 全局划词助手：Cherry 同款取词基础，复用 DSH 模型翻译、解释与总结。MIT 开源。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Selection Assistant · 划词助手

[![Verify](https://github.com/bjcdeshu/dsh-selection-assistant/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/bjcdeshu/dsh-selection-assistant/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**让常开的 DeepSeek Harness 顺便接管全局划词，不再为这一个功能多留一整套聊天软件。**

Windows 划词工具条：**翻译 / 解释 / 总结**。复用 Cherry Studio 所用的 MIT `selection-hook` 取词基础，但界面、提示词和 DSH 集成均独立实现。

> **开发预览版。** 当前目标是 Windows 10/11 + DSH Desktop **0.2.0-rc.2**。依赖版本刻意锁定，其他 DSH 版本需要验证。已接入真实宿主，三种模型操作完成，用户确认自动划词和译文正常。自动化测试不等于各类应用都兼容；详见[验证记录与资源实测](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。不宣称零进程或固定内存占用。

## 界面预览

以下截图由纯示例文字生成，没有真实选区、模型请求或私人数据。

![划词工具条](docs/images/toolbar.png)

![原生结果窗](docs/images/panel.png)

[设置窗口预览](docs/images/settings.png)

## 设计

- 选中文字只弹工具条，**点击动作后才调用模型**。
- 非激活原生工具条不抢原窗口焦点；结果窗可选中文本、复制、停止、置顶、拖动和缩放。
- 通过 `ctx.llm.stream` 使用 DSH 已配置的模型；不复制 API Key，不启动完整 Agent，不开放文件/命令工具，不创建一堆“未分组”会话。
- 单次无历史请求，英文默认译成中文、明显中文默认译成英文；解释/总结默认中文，也可固定输出语言。
- 自定义三类提示词，支持 `{{targetLanguage}}`。显式独立模型或跟随 **DSH 全局默认模型**，不是跟随当前打开的会话。
- 首次加载处于暂停状态。用户在设置中勾选后才开始监听；托盘可暂停，`Ctrl+Alt+D` 可手动取词。
- 剪贴板兜底默认关闭，密码管理器和终端默认排除。只处理选区，不主动读附近段落。
- 无公开 HTTP 端口、无网页脚本桥、无遥测、无原文/结果历史文件。仅用继承的 stdio JSONL 连接私有子进程。

## 运行结构和资源取舍

```text
DSH Host 插件                  Node 取词伴生进程              C# WPF 原生界面
模型/设置/取消  ← stdio →  selection-hook 2.1.1  ← stdio →  工具条/结果/设置/托盘
```

**增加两个辅助进程，不增加 Chromium/WebView2 进程。** 取词 native addon 不装入 DSH 主宿主，异常的 UIA provider 不应拖住整个 DSH。WPF 使用 Windows 现有的 .NET Framework 4.x，首次加载用系统 C# 编译器从本仓库源码构建，输出缓存到插件数据目录；不下载编译器、不要求管理员、不修改 DSH 安装包。

窗口只做 UI，不联网；辅助进程环境采用 OS 字段白名单，不继承模型 API Key、DSH 认证变量或 `NODE_OPTIONS`。模型凭据只留在 DSH。

## 安装（确认兼容后）

优先通过 DSH 的 **插件 → 添加插件**，输入：

```text
github:bjcdeshu/dsh-selection-assistant
```

仓库不需要 JavaScript 构建步骤。`selection-hook` 包含 Windows 原生预编译依赖；不同包管理器可能询问是否允许其 `node-gyp-build` 安装脚本。请先审阅再决定，**不要授权不相关的生命周期脚本**。源码开发可以先 `pnpm install --ignore-scripts`，本项目已通过直接加载 prebuild 验证，不要求自动重编译 native addon。

CLI 示例（仅在你的运行实例确实使用此 profile 时）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:bjcdeshu/dsh-selection-assistant
```

应用自有 profile 可能不同，优先在当前实例的插件页面安装，不要盲目修改其他 profile。宿主提示需要重启时，请先保存当前任务再重启；本插件不会自行重启 DSH。

首次加载会出现托盘图标和设置窗口：

1. 确认 DSH 已配置可用模型。
2. 阅读隐私说明，勾选“启用全局划词监听”，保存。
3. 在普通文本应用或浏览器中选中文字，点击翻译、解释或总结。
4. 取不到时先试 `Ctrl+Alt+D`；需要模拟复制的应用才显式打开剪贴板兜底。

### 停用 / 卸载

- 临时停用：托盘 → 暂停全局划词（停止 hook 和全局热键）。
- 完全停止：在当前 DSH 插件页面关闭或卸载本插件；卸载清理自有进程。
- 设置保留在 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/dsh-selection-assistant/settings.json`（未定义 DSH_HOME 时为用户目录的 `.dsh` 下同一路径）。这里仅有偏好和自定义提示词，没有模型密钥、选区或结果。
- 原生编译缓存位于同级 `native-cache`。希望清除设置时先停用插件，再自行删除这个明确的插件数据目录，不要删除整个 DSH 数据目录。

## 隐私与边界

选区本身可能含敏感数据。应用黑名单与明显凭据格式拦截只是一层辅助，**不是全面密码/隐私检测保证**。不需要时暂停；不要把敏感选区提交给云模型。模型服务的计费、存储及 DSH 自身诊断策略仍适用。

开启剪贴板兜底可能模拟复制并短暂接触剪贴板，无法保证所有第三方应用都完全无副作用。默认关闭。不开管理员权限来绕过 UIPI；提权应用、图片/扫描 PDF、canvas 和特殊编辑器可能无法取词。首版不包含 OCR、原文替换、翻译历史、自动上传、自动联网搜索或自动执行工具。

结果支持安全的轻量 Markdown（标题、列表、引用、粗体、行内码、代码块）；不执行 HTML、不自动打开链接。复杂表格/公式不是浏览器级排版。

## 开发与验证

需要 Node 22.19+；原生 UI 构建在 Windows 使用已安装的 .NET Framework 4.x（精简版 Windows 可能缺失）。

```powershell
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm verify              # JS 语法 + 无 hook / 无模型调用的单元测试
pnpm build:native        # 系统 csc 编译原生 UI
pnpm demo                # 仅示例 UI 的冒烟测试和本地截图；不监听真实选区
```

示例截图仅写入 gitignored 的 `.local/`。`demo` 不加载取词库、不注册全局快捷键、不访问剪贴板、不调用模型。CI 在 Linux/Windows 运行纯逻辑测试，并在 Windows 编译 UI。

### 发布前手动验收

- [ ] 真实 DSH 加载/停用/重启，确认没有孤儿进程。
- [ ] Chrome/Edge、记事本、常用文档/PDF 的真实取词。
- [ ] 点击动作后原文不串、切换选区不覆盖已显示结果。
- [ ] 三种动作的真实模型结果、停止、失败和重试流程。
- [ ] 高 DPI、多显示器、负坐标、贴屏幕边缘。
- [ ] 暂停、黑名单、无剪贴板兜底时剪贴板保持不变。
- [ ] 统计两个辅助进程的总工作集与空闲 CPU，不只看主进程。

## 开源与许可

本项目 **MIT**。第三方许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。`selection-hook` 为 MIT；Cherry Studio 主程序为 AGPL-3.0。这里没有复制 Cherry 的应用源码、图标或长提示词，也不宣称由 Cherry/DeepSeek 官方开发。

问题反馈：[Issues](https://github.com/bjcdeshu/dsh-selection-assistant/issues)。请不要上传 API Key、私人选区、聊天日志或完整本机配置。

plugins.description: Adapts everything-claude-code to DeepSeek Harness: 11 skills, an ECC agent preset, adapted Claude Code hooks, and a Chinese Settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-everything-claude-code

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Adapts [WorldFlowAI/everything-claude-code](https://github.com/WorldFlowAI/everything-claude-code)
(ECC) into a DeepSeek Harness bundle: 11 skills, 15 prompts, 9 personas, 8 rules, an
adapted Claude Code hook set, an **agent preset**, and a Chinese Settings page.

Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, profile `desktop`.

## Blocking rules

Five `PreToolUse` rules deny a tool call outright. Two are ported from ECC; three
were added for this port.

| Rule | Denies |
|---|---|
| `block-dev-server` | starting a dev server in the foreground, where its log is unreachable |
| `block-destructive-command` | force push, `reset --hard`, `clean -f`, forced branch delete, remote branch delete, and a recursive delete of an unscoped or out-of-workspace path |
| `block-hardcoded-secret` | writing a real credential into source, config, or docs |
| `block-stray-docs` | a loose `.md`/`.txt` outside the conventional locations |
| `confirm-git-push` | not a deny — it raises an approval prompt before a push |

### What is deliberately allowed

A blocking rule that fires on ordinary work gets switched off, and then it
protects nothing. So each rule has explicit exemptions, asserted by tests:

- **`.env`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `credentials.*`** are writable. A key store is where
  a real key belongs; flagging it would train the user to bypass the hook. The
  other half of that bargain is `.gitignore`, which covers every path the hook
  treats as a key store.
- **Secrets are matched by credential shape, never by variable name.** This
  bundle ships nine secret-shaped placeholders in its own ported security
  guidance (`const apiKey = "sk-proj-xxxxx"`), so a name-keyed rule would block
  edits to the plugin's own docs. What is matched is a known issuer prefix with a
  real body — OpenAI `sk-`, GitHub `ghp_`/`github_pat_`, AWS `AKIA`, Google
  `AIza`, Slack, Stripe, npm, PyPI, GitLab, Hugging Face, PEM headers, JWTs — or
  a mixed-case-plus-digit literal assigned to a secret-like name.
- **`tests/`, `fixtures/`, `examples/`** are exempt by path: a fixture with a
  plausible-looking key is correct, not a leak.
- **Ordinary git and ordinary deletes pass**: `git push`, `git reset HEAD~1`,
  `git branch -d`, `git clean -n`, `rm -rf ./node_modules`, and
  `rm -rf <workspace>/dist` are all allowed.
- **`--dry-run` and `-n`** are respected, so a command can be reviewed before it
  is trusted.

Every rule is one script under `hooks/scripts/`, so a rule can be removed by
deleting its entry from `hooks/hooks.json` without touching the others.

## The agent preset (the "mode")

`presets/everything-claude-code.patch.yml` declares a selectable session mode named
**Everything Claude Code**, listed in Settings → Agent presets and in the new-session
picker. Selecting it composes:

- a **persona** stating the ECC working agreement — TDD first, verify before claiming
  done, never hardcode a secret, immutable data, focused files, security review — and
  naming the skills to load;
- the standard agent plane (filesystem and search, skill loading, plan mode,
  compaction, delegation, todos, web, present);
- `agent-instructions`, so the project's `AGENTS.md` still reaches the model.

Why a preset instead of a global row: a preset is the only seat that composes a
session's persona, tools, and context. Mounting ECC globally would change every
session; a preset lets one session opt in. `order: 4` places it after the shipped
standard(1)/ptc(2)/minimal(3), so it reads as an opt-in mode, not a replacement default.

To declare an extra patch file, `dsh.bundle.patch` takes a **list** of paths.

## Settings page

Settings gains an **Everything Claude Code** entry showing what the plugin actually
publishes: the 11 registered skills, every hook point with its matcher, the resource
counts, and the migration caveats. It is Chinese by default and follows a language
switch in place.

- Registered in the `settings.section` slot — a top-level settings page. Do **not**
  file it under `settings.plugins.tab`: that is the read-only "Built-in plugins"
  inventory of what the deployment ships, so a third-party page does not belong there.
- Data comes from `GET /api/everything-claude-code/status` under the authenticated
  `/api` fence; counts are read from the package directory at request time.
- Styled only with `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so light and dark both work.

**The client half needs a DSH restart the first time it appears.** The client-module
scan runs once at process start and caches each package's manifest in a write-once
`pkgMeta` map with no invalidation path (`dsh-client-modules/lib/index.js`). A package
that gains `dsh.client` while the Host is already running stays invisible until DSH
restarts. Later edits to `client.js` do hot-reload.

## Install

```powershell
# 1. Clone through the mirror (direct GitHub is unreachable on this host)
git clone --depth 1 https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/WorldFlowAI/everything-claude-code.git

# 2. Adapt the sources into this bundle
node scripts/adapt-skills.mjs skills
node scripts/adapt-resources.mjs resources

# 3. Install into the profile (via the plugin manager, not the CLI —
#    the desktop profile is owned by the Electron app)
```

Then install with the `plugin_manager` tool, `action: install_bundle`,
`target: <absolute path to this directory>`.

## What maps to what

| ECC | DSH | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `skills/` (11) | runtime skill registry | Needs `name` + `description` frontmatter |
| `commands/` (15) | prompt documents | DSH commands are human-facing and never reach the model |
| `agents/` (9) | persona prompts | DSH has no per-file agent registry |
| `rules/` (8) | `SessionStart` context | Three rules are injected; the rest load on demand |
| `hooks.json` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` | Matchers renamed to DSH tools |
| `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` | `package.json` + `dsh.bundle.patch` | Different manifest contract |

## Three bugs that a naive port hits

**1. Skill frontmatter is required, and its absence is silent.**
Three ECC skills (`eval-harness`, `project-guidelines-example`, `verification-loop`) ship
without frontmatter. `dsh-skill-filesystem` drops such a skill with a warning the model never
sees, so the skill simply is not there. `scripts/adapt-skills.mjs` adds `name` and `description`.

**2. `baseUrl` in a bundle patch is the PROFILE ROOT, not the patch's directory.**
`new URL('hooks/hooks.json', baseUrl)` resolves to `<profile>/hooks/hooks.json`, which does not
exist. The bridge then logs a warning and runs **no hooks at all** — no error surfacing to the
user. Anchor on the installed package instead:

```yaml
configPath: !!js "...new URL('node_modules/dsh-everything-claude-code/hooks/hooks.json', baseUrl)"
```

**3. Blocking through exit code 2 does not work in this bridge.**
Claude Code documents exit 2 + stderr as a block, and `dsh-hook-protocol` maps exit 2 to
`decision: 'block'`. In `0.2.0-rc.2` the bridge instead recorded it as `exitCode: 1,
decision: 'pass'` and **let the tool run**. Observed directly in a session log: the hook's block
message reached stderr while the call was not stopped.

The channel that does work is structured stdout with a clean exit:

```json
{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"…"}}
```

All blocking hooks in this bundle use it and exit 0. `blockByExitCode` is kept for a real
Claude Code host.

## Tests

```powershell
node tests/run-all.mjs
```

| Suite | Checks | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| `hooks.test.mjs` | 23 | Each hook's decision against the contract this bridge honors |
| `blocking-hooks.test.mjs` | 24 | The risk hooks deny through the channel this bridge honours |
| `risk-detection.test.mjs` | 41 | The detection logic, including the cases it must NOT flag |
| `dual-version.test.mjs` | 15 | Correct behaviour under both the 0.2.0 and 0.2.1 directory contracts |
| `preset.test.mjs` | 15 | The preset satisfies the agent-preset schema and names the ECC practices |
| `client-bundle.test.mjs` | 14 | The browser factory loads, exports, and renders the page |

plugins.description: Speech blips while the assistant's answer streams - audible even when the window is in the background; swappable voices, or shape your own.
plugins.readme_text:
# 说话音效 / Speech Blip

模型**回答**时逐字发出音效，音色可换，也可以自己调。
进入对话时不发声，模型说完立刻停；窗口最小化、被挡住、或者切到别的标签页时**照常发声**。

## 安装

插件市场（dshmarket）里搜**说话音效**，点一下安装；或者直接装 npm 包：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-typewriter-blip
```

也可以从仓库装源码（内容和 npm 包一致）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nsswkj/dsh-typewriter-blip
```

装完刷新一次 Harness 页面即可，无需重启。

## 用法

1. 插件安装后（profile：`desktop`），刷新一次 Harness 页面。
2. 输入框上方会出现一个 **♪ 说话音效** 按钮。
3. 点它打开面板：

| 控件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 启用 | 总开关（关闭后不再发声，也不排队） |
| 音色 | `柔和`（三角波，默认）/ `打字机`（锯齿 + 噪声瞬态）/ `自定义` |
| 自定义音色 | 两种来源：**合成音色**（波形 `方波/三角/锯齿/正弦` + 基频 + 音长 + 亮度）或**音频文件**（本地 `audio/*`，可调播放速度，每个字最多播 0.6 秒）。动这里的任何一项会自动切到「自定义」 |
| 音高 / 音量 | ±12 半音升降调；0–100% 音量 |
| 最小间隔 | 两个音之间的最小毫秒数；流式输出很快时用它控制密度 |
| 说完即停 | 最后一个字之后多久掐掉还响着的音（默认 140 ms，且不会短于一次唤醒的间隔）。还没播的队列不会整段丢掉：前台最多 6 个字、不到三分之一秒就播完；后台按下面「后台也要发声」的规则只留最后 0.3 秒 |
| 跳过空格 | 空格、换行不发声 |
| 只对回答发声 | 只对助手回答的文字发声；工具调用、思考过程（`reasoning`）和你的消息都不响。默认开 |
| 随机音高 | 每个音随机偏移的半音数，让声音更自然。滑条到 `2`，右边的输入框可以直接填到 `24`；**自定义音频也生效**——音频文件没法改音高，插件用同一份半音偏移换算成播放速度（重采样），所以调高时那个音也会短一点 |
| 随机音量 | 每个音随机改变多少音量，滑条到 `±50%`，输入框可以直接填到 `±100%`。随机量加在每个音自己的增益上，不动总音量开关 |
| 试听 | 连播几个字试听当前音色。**一次只能听一遍**：按下后按钮变灰显示「试听中…」，最后一个字播完才解锁，中途再点无效 |
| 恢复默认 | 回到出厂设置 |

设置即时生效并自动保存（`localStorage`，键 `dsh:typewriter-blip:v1`）。
按钮上只有 `♪ 说话音效` 两个元素，不再显示发声计数。
「随机音高」和「随机音量」右边的数值框可以直接输入，超过滑条上限也照收（上限是
`settings.js` 里的 `JITTER_MAX` / `VOLUME_JITTER_MAX`）；输入即生效，还解析不出数字的
半截文本（空框、只有一个 `-`）不会被写进设置。

面板开在按钮**上方**（输入框贴着窗口底边，下方没有地方放），并且高度只取按钮上方
到窗口顶边之间的空间，内容多就在面板里滚动；只有按钮靠近窗口顶部、上方确实放不下时
才会翻到下方。出现时用 ease-out 缓动淡入（180 ms，从按钮那一侧滑进来），关闭时先播
完 140 ms 的淡出再从 DOM 里移除，`prefers-reduced-motion` 下两个动画都会关掉。

## 什么时候响，什么时候不响

用户要的是"说话"的感觉，而浏览器里只有一个越来越长的 DOM，所以下面三件事必须分开：

- **进入对话 / 历史消息整段挂载**：一律不响。第一次看到的容器只建立基线。
- **宿主复用了行元素**（换会话、虚拟滚动、Markdown 重新渲染）：新文本不再以旧文本开头、
  或者变短了，就当成换了一行内容，重新建立基线，不发声。
- **一次刷新里整块出现**：那是挂载，不是打字（首次增长 > 24 字、之后单帧 > 160 字都按挂载处理）。

反向的两个规则让声音跟得上说话：

- **回答停止**：最后一个字之后超过「说完即停」的窗口没有任何新字符，就 `cut()` 掉所有
  已排程的音——否则队列里剩下的字会继续说，用户听到的就是"说完了还在响"。**队列本身
  不丢**，只裁到还剩最后 0.3 秒（`PLAYOUT_MS`）：前台队列最多 6 个字（`MAX_PENDING`），
  按「最小间隔」算不到三分之一秒就播完，所以一个字都不会少；以前一次性丢掉整个队列，
  才是"换完音效第一句断断续续、只响了一半"的根因。
- **跟得上说话**：音效速率上限就是「最小间隔」（默认 45 ms ≈ 每秒 22 个音），而模型一次
  chunk 能吐几十个字，所以队列只存得下最新几个字（溢出丢**最旧**的，前台 6 个、后台按
  `lead` 放宽）。队列长了不会让声音更丰富，只会让声音落后文本一两秒——而这份落后迟早
  会被整段丢掉。
- **只对回答发声**：`data-chat-flow-kind` 必须是 `assistant-step`，且 `data-chat-group-part`
  不是 `reasoning`；代码块、JSON 块、按钮、时间戳等 UI 部分一律不计入。

## 后台也要发声

最小化、被别的窗口盖住、或者切到别的标签页时，浏览器会**停止产生动画帧**（`requestAnimationFrame`
一次都不再触发），并把定时器压到大约一秒一次。排程原来完全挂在动画帧上，所以窗口一进后台就彻底
没声了。现在：

- **两个时钟**：动画帧照旧是主时钟（页面可见时它总是先醒，定时器不参与）；另一个 250 ms 的定时器
  盯着帧，超过 400 ms 没有帧就接管排程。它不看 Page Visibility API，因为被遮挡的窗口可能既不产生
  帧、也不肯说自己隐藏了。
- **按唤醒间隔缓冲**：driver 用两次唤醒之间的间隔算出 `lead`（提前排到音频时钟上的秒数），队列容量
  也由它决定——前台的 lead 是 0.02 秒（⇒ 6 个字），后台是 1.25 秒（⇒ 30 个字，上限 `MAX_QUEUE` 48）。
  音频时钟不受页面可见性影响，所以只要声音已经排在它上面，就一定响得出来。
- **收到文字本身就是一次唤醒**：后台定时器可能被压到一分钟一次，那时答案早就结束了，所以每个字符
  批次进来都会直接 tick 一次；页面一隐藏也会立刻把 lead 抬上去，而不是等第一次粗唤醒才发现。
- **说完即停仍然成立**：文字停了以后队列会被裁到只剩最后 0.3 秒（`PLAYOUT_MS`）再播完。前台队列本来
  就短于 0.3 秒，所以「换完音效第一句断断续续」那个 bug 不会因为这次改动回来；掐音的窗口也不会短于
  一次唤醒的间隔——一秒宽的时钟判断不了 140 毫秒的安静，否则 chunk 之间的每个停顿都会被当成"说完了"，
  把刚填好的缓冲整段掐掉。
- 回到前台时 lead 立刻降回帧级并重新开始测量——否则前台会拖着后台那一整秒的积压说话。

## 音色怎么来的

内置音色由 `src/voices.js` 的 `PRESETS` 决定波形、基频、时长、滤波与按字符类别的移调：
`柔和` 是三角波、`打字机` 是锯齿加一段高通噪声瞬态。
"自定义"音色由设置里的 `custom` 字段决定（`CUSTOM_DEFAULTS` 是出厂值）：
`source: "synth"` 时用 `wave/freq/duration/filter` 合成，`source: "sample"` 时播放用户载入的音频。
要加一个内置音色：在 `PRESETS` 里加一条，再把 id 加进 `PRESET_ORDER`（`PRESET_ORDER[0]` 就是新装
默认音色）；删掉一个音色不用管旧设置，`normalizeSettings` 会把认不出来的 id 收回默认值。

## 结构

```
package.json        清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（web）
cordis.patch.yml    插入 id 为 typewriter-blip 的 Loader 行
index.js            Host 半：空实现（功能全在页面里）
src/settings.js     设置与 localStorage 持久化（含自定义音色）
src/voices.js       音色预设表 + 自定义音色的出厂值与波形表
src/audio.js        Web Audio 合成、采样播放、cut()
src/observer.js     回答文字 → 字符增量 → 排程发声 → 说完即停（音频时钟 + 自适应唤醒间隔）
src/client.js       输入框上方的按钮与面板（React）
build.mjs           把 src/ 拼成单文件 client.js
client.js           生成产物（浏览器模块图每个包只加载一个 ./client）
test.mjs            离线测试台
LICENSE             MIT
```

## 开发

页面里的模块图每个包只加载一个 `./client` 产物，所以 `client.js` 是**生成文件**：
改 `src/`，然后

```
node build.mjs          # 重新生成 client.js
node test.mjs           # 离线检查（语法、设置、音色、音频、观察器、节奏、端到端）
node build.mjs --check  # 只检查产物是否过期
```

本机没有独立的 Node 时，可用 Electron 当 Node：

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1
& "C:\Program Files\DSH Desktop\DSH Desktop.exe" build.mjs
```

改完 `client.js` 需要刷新页面（或重启 DSH Desktop）才会加载新产物。

## 实现要点

- 插件通过 `conversation.composer.dock` 这个 slot 把按钮挂到输入框上方，样式只用
  Harness 的 `--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsw-specific-*` 主题变量，跟随明暗主题。
- 面板底色用的是 DSH 自己那套浮层表面，而不是随手挑的灰：`--dsw-specific-menu`
  （浅色 `#f8f9fa94`、深色 `#43454a73`）+ 同一支 `--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter`
  （`blur(40px) saturate(150%)`）毛玻璃 + `--dsw-elevation-prominent` 投影，和 DSH 的
  `stats` 面板、各种菜单完全一致。原先用的 `--dsw-alias-bg-overlay` 是**徽标**底色
  （浅色 `#e9ecf2`、深色 `#61666b`），深色主题下面板会是一块偏亮的灰板，跟界面里其它
  表面都对不上——"背景色不随主题"就是这么来的。
- `随机音高` / `随机音量` 是逐字生成的：`src/audio.js` 的 `pitchJitter()` 给每个音一份
  随机半音，`volumeScale()` 给每个音一份随机增益（加在这个音自己的 gain 上，不碰总音量）。
  合成音色直接改频率/峰值；**音频文件没法改音高，用的是同一份半音偏移换出来的
  `playbackRate`（重采样）**——"随机音高对自定义音频没用"就修在 `#playSample` 里。
  `blipSeconds()` 取最慢的那一档，所以试听的锁定时间不会短于任何一次实际发声。
- 面板是 `.twb-root` 里的 `position:absolute`，所以 `top`/`left` 必须是**相对按钮**
  的偏移。一旦把窗口坐标当成局部偏移写进去，等于又叠了一次按钮自身的偏移——面板就会
  掉到屏幕外面去。这段换算抽成了纯函数 `placePanel()`，离线测试直接钉住它的算术。
- 量面板尺寸只能用 `offsetWidth/offsetHeight`（布局盒），**不能用
  `getBoundingClientRect()`**：入场动画带 `scale(.97)`，rect 返回的是动画中的视觉盒，
  拿它算位置会让面板低约 3%（底部压住按钮），直到下一次重新摆放才弹回去——就是"点一下
  面板才回到该在的位置"那个 bug。`measurePanel()` 固定了这条规则。
- 逐字音效需要一个"新出现了几个字符"的信号。`conversation.chat.node` 的 props 里
  `hookContext` 只有 `{ turnData, disclosureReset }`，拿不到流式文本，所以插件观察
  Conversation 层已经打好的 `data-chat-flow-kind` 容器。
- 发声在 Web Audio 的时钟上排程：每个音之间至少隔 `最小间隔`，一次唤醒最多补满 `lead` 那么长的
  一段（可见时是一帧的量，后台是一整秒），所以既不会在长时间隐藏后炸出一串音，也不会在两次唤醒
  之间静音。driver 不假设帧率，它只按自己观测到的唤醒间隔调整。
- 排程是一次同步跑完的，所以后台那一下会把一整秒的音全部记进 `voices`——它们都还没轮到结束。因此
  "超额就掐掉最旧的一个"是错的（最旧的那个正是此刻在响的，会被拉成一秒长的音）：`#reap` 只回收
  音频时钟已经越过的音，`onended` 照旧负责正常回收。
- 试听不走 driver 的字符队列，而是直接把音排到音频时钟上，所以在它看来"一直没有任何
  新字符"＝"模型说完了"，说完即停会在第一个音之后就把它掐掉。`BlipDriver.hold(秒)`
  在试听期间压住这个掐音；试听时长由 `BlipAudio.blipSeconds()`（单个音最长多久）加上
  排程跨度算出，同一段时间也用来锁住试听按钮。
- 生成文件里的 loader 契约：`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) })`，
  factory 的第一个参数才是加载器的 `require`（`react` 只能从这里拿）。factory 里的任何
  异常都会落在启动批次里，会白屏整页，所以 `build.mjs` 给整段加载套了 try/catch。

plugins.description: Double-click any of your own messages to rewrite it and resend from that point; the original conversation is untouched.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reedit

Double-click any of your own messages to rewrite it and resend from that point.
The original conversation is untouched.

## What it does

Hovering one of your messages shows the hint; **double-click** it to open an
editor prefilled with that message. Confirming:

1. forks the session at the event **before** the original message, so neither it
   nor any later message is carried into the new branch,
2. sends the edited text into that branch, and
3. opens the branch in the **main panel**.

Clicking anywhere outside the editor leaves edit mode without saving.

The original session is never modified — nothing is rewritten in place, because a
session log is append-only. Editing message *n*-1 is therefore the reason message
*n* does not appear in the new branch: the branch starts before *n*-1.

Your messages also get a faint blue bubble, so a user message cannot be mistaken
for an assistant reply.

## Why it owns the user bubble

Double-click and the hover hint need the bubble's own DOM, and the shipped
renderer keeps its action row internal and exposes no hook. This plugin
registers `conversation.chat.node` for key `user` at `priority: -1`, shadowing
that renderer.

A keyed cell accepts a second registration only at a **different** priority; at
priority 0 it throws
`keyed slot ... already has an entry for key "user" at priority 0`, and a throw
in a client entry makes the web boot audit refuse to mount the whole GUI. The
priority is load-bearing.

The replacement reproduces text, reference labels, image attachments (through
the shared `renderMessageImages` owner prop), extra blocks and the time/copy row;
file cards and bubble styling are hand-written and may differ slightly from the
host. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` is read behind a `try/catch`, so a
missing kit degrades to plain text instead of blanking the conversation.

## Install

    dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Arbeiter-bit/dsh-reedit

Pinned:

    dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Arbeiter-bit/dsh-reedit#v0.1.0

## Verification

The web boot audit (`assertEntriesActive`) refuses to mount the **whole GUI**
when any client entry fails to activate, so every release is checked by loading
the composed profile in a fresh browser page with an empty module table and
reading the console:

    v0.1.0  title: DeepSeek Harness   console errors: 0

## Known limitations

- The bubble colour is a literal blue (`#2563eb` at 12%), mixed against the
  layered surface so it stays readable in light and dark themes. The theme
  exposes no blue alias token — `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` resolves to the
  neutral primary-action colour, which mixes to grey.
- The action row is a reimplementation; file cards and spacing are hand-written.
- Editing cannot edit a message in place, because session logs are append-only.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Open symlinks and junctions in the DSH sidebar, with targets outside the workspace gated by workspace trust · 让 DSH 侧边栏能展开、打开符号链接（含 Windows junction），指向工作区外的需工作区已信任
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-symlink-passthrough

让 DSH 侧边栏「文件」树能展开、打开工作区里的符号链接（含 Windows junction）。指向工作区外的链接，需要工作区已信任才能访问。

DSH 默认按链接的真实路径判断是否在工作区内，所以链接到别处的目录和文件都会报错：展开时报 `outside-workspace`，打开时报 `not-regular-file`。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:RicardoYan/dsh-workspace-trust#v0.1.0
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:RicardoYan/dsh-symlink-passthrough#v0.1.0
```

Web 端把 `desktop` 换成你的 profile 名（一般是 `web`）。装完重启 DSH。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-symlink-passthrough`

## 规则

按链接**指向的真实路径**判断：

| 链接指向 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 工作区内 | 放行 |
| 工作区外 | 工作区已信任、且不在禁止访问列表里才放行 |

- 工作区 = 从会话目录往上最近的含 `.dsh/settings.yml` 或 `.git` 的目录；信任和禁止访问列表都由 [dsh-workspace-trust](https://github.com/RicardoYan/dsh-workspace-trust) 管理（`/workspace-trust trust` 信任当前工作区）
- 被拒绝时，侧边栏显示原因，例如「需要先信任工作区」「路径在禁止访问列表中」
- 只处理工作区里的链接本身；带 `..` 的路径、直接写的工作区外路径照旧按 DSH 原规则处理
- 只影响侧边栏，agent 的读写权限不变

## 注意

- 没装 dsh-workspace-trust 时，插件不放行任何链接，等同 DSH 原行为
- 依赖 DSH 的内部方法（`fs.contains`，`workspaceFiles` 的 `confine` / `locateFile` / `feed.follow`），适用于 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`；缺失时启动日志出现 `[symlink-passthrough] ... missing` 告警，对应功能不生效，普通文件不受影响
- 在 bundle 配置里写 `enabled: false` 可以关闭插件

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: orchestrate a user-owned DeepSeek web history -> local knowledge base sync pipeline. No credentials, no network of its own.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-kb-sync

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：把**你自己已有的同步流水线**搬到一个同源控制页——一键运行、看状态、看日志、跑完整性体检。

典型的流水线是「网页端对话历史 → 本地知识库」，但插件本身不关心你同步什么。

> **定位：一个插件，两半能力。**
> **① 自己拉取**：用你存在 DSH 凭据服务里的网页端 `userToken` 调 chat.deepseek.com，把对话规范化落到本地知识库，并在插件内检索 —— 这一半**读凭据值、会出网**（见下方能力披露，`dsh-trust-check` 判为**红线**）。
> **② 编排**：起你已有的同步/体检命令、读状态与日志 —— 这一半不读凭据、不出网。
> 两半都不注入提示词、都不改核心 bundle、都没有安装脚本。

![dsh-kb-sync 用法与边界：浏览器 → 插件路由 → 你的同步命令 → 状态文件与你的产物](docs/architecture.svg)

<sub>整张图就是它的全部作用域：虚线框内是插件（只提供 5 个同源路由、只读状态文件），出网与凭据都在绿色框里 —— 你自己那条命令中。</sub>

## 它做什么 / 不做什么

| | 说明 |
|---|---|
| ✅ 做 | 用 DSH 的 `subprocess` 起你配置的命令；读状态文件与日志展示进度；跑你指定的完整性体检命令；全部通过一个本地控制页操作 |
| ✅ 做（拉取半） | 用 DSH 凭据服务里的 `userToken` 调 chat.deepseek.com：拉会话列表 → 只取新增/续聊的线程（`chat_session.current_message_id` 权威定位末端）→ 规范化成 `conversations/*.md` + `conversations.jsonl` + `catalog.json` → 插件内检索 |
| ✅ 做（编排半） | 用 DSH 的 `subprocess` 起你配置的命令；读状态文件与日志展示进度；跑你指定的完整性体检命令 |
| ❌ 不做 | 不把 token 写进任何文件/日志/响应（只进凭据服务）；不访问 chat.deepseek.com 之外的任何地址；不读凭据文件（那个会过期的 `.token`）的正文、只 `stat` 它的修改时间；不注册提示词段落；不改核心 bundle；无安装脚本、无运行依赖 |

## 目录结构（一个自包含的文件夹）

```
dsh-kb-sync/
├─ lib/                  插件代码：index（路由）/ deepseek（接口）/ export（回填）/ store（落盘）/ page（界面）
├─ docs/                 能力披露与架构图
├─ test/                 单测（node --test，25 例）
├─ tools/                发布脚本（publish.ps1 / publish.cmd）
├─ config.example.json   配置样例 —— 复制成 config.json 就生效（配置跟着代码走）
├─ data/kb/              **知识库默认就落在这里**（不入库；可配 outDir 改到别处）
├─ package.json / cordis.patch.yml / README.md / LICENSE
```

## 适配你的流水线

插件对你现有的脚本只有**一个硬要求**：一个可执行的同步命令。其余都是可选的，缺了对应功能自动降级、不会报错崩掉：

| 你提供的东西 | 插件用它做什么 | 缺失时 |
|---|---|---|
| 同步命令：`sync/sync-daily.{cmd,ps1,sh}`，或 `syncScript` 显式指定 | `/run` 按钮 | `/run` 返回 `sync-script-missing`，其余功能照常 |
| 日志目录（默认 `sync/logs/`） | `/log` 与「最新日志」 | 状态里不显示日志 |
| 进度文件（默认 `sync/LAST-SYNC.txt`） | 状态里的「最近几次结果」 | 跳过该栏 |
| 一个会过期的凭据文件（默认 `.token`） | **只读它的 mtime**，换算成「年龄天数 / 是否偏旧」 | 跳过该栏 |
| 体检命令（默认 `<kbDir>/tools/kb.mjs doctor`） | `/doctor` 按钮 | `/doctor` 返回 `doctor-script-missing`，或把 `doctorScript` 留空即禁用 |

> 这些默认值都来自一条真实流水线（`sync/sync-daily.cmd`、`sync/logs/`、`LAST-SYNC.txt`、`.token`、`knowledge-base/tools/kb.mjs`），
> 但它们**只是默认值**：每一项都能用配置改成你自己的路径与命令，体检命令也可以是任何可执行脚本（`doctorScript` + `doctorArgs`）。

## 安装

标准 `dsh.bundle` 插件（host 半部、**零依赖**、无客户端构建步骤）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-kb-sync
```

装完重启 DSH。要求：DSH 提供 `webServer` 与 `subprocess` 服务（0.2.x 默认都有），Node ≥ 20。

## 配置

插件不猜你的目录：没配置时它照常加载，控制页会直接告诉你缺什么。

**方式一：profile patch**（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`，按 id 覆盖）

```yaml
- id: dsh-kb-sync
  name: 'dsh-kb-sync'
  config:
    root: 'D:\path\to\pipeline'          # 流水线根目录；下面几项都能由它推出来
    # syncScript:   '...\sync\sync-daily.cmd'   # 默认自动发现 sync\sync-daily.{cmd,ps1,sh}
    # logDir:       '...\sync\logs'
    # lastSyncFile: '...\sync\LAST-SYNC.txt'
    # tokenFile:    '...\.token'                # 只读 mtime，不读内容
    # tokenOldDays: 21                          # 超过就标「token 偏旧」
    # kbDir:        '...\knowledge-base'        # 体检脚本的默认落点
    # doctorScript: '...\tools\kb.mjs'          # 任何可执行脚本都行
    # doctorArgs:   ['doctor']
    # nodeBin: 'node'
    # timeoutMs: 3600000
```

**方式二：插件文件夹里的 `config.json`**（推荐——配置跟着代码走，整包拷走也不丢）

```jsonc
// <插件目录>/config.json   （可先复制 config.example.json 改名）
{ "root": "D:\\path\\to\\pipeline", "outDir": "data/kb", "tokenOldDays": 21 }
```

**方式三：设置文件**（有些 profile 会在重启时重写自己的 `cordis.patch.yml`，手写的 loader 行会丢；设置文件不会）

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/.dsh-kb-sync.json    （未设 DSH_HOME 时即 ~/.dsh/.dsh-kb-sync.json）
{ "root": "/srv/pipeline", "tokenOldDays": 14 }
```

**方式四：环境变量** `DSH_KB_SYNC_ROOT` / `DSH_KB_SYNC_OUT_DIR`。

**优先级**：loader `config` → 环境变量 → 用户设置文件 → **插件文件夹里的 `config.json`** → 内置默认。文件缺失或 JSON 坏掉都按空处理（不影响加载），读到哪些会在 `/status` 的 `configFile` 字段里报告（`used` / `localUsed`）。

### 数据落在哪（自包含）

**默认就是插件文件夹内**：`<插件目录>/data/kb/`（`conversations/*.md` + `conversations.jsonl` + `catalog.json`）。
所以插件不与别的脚本共用知识库目录、也不会互相覆盖 —— 想复用别人的库才需要显式配 `outDir`。

```jsonc
// 例：把知识库放到别处（或复用一个已有库）
{ "outDir": "D:\\dsh\\knowledge-base" }
```

POSIX 示例（`syncScript` 指向 `.sh` 时用 `/bin/sh` 执行）：

```jsonc
{ "root": "/srv/kb-pipeline", "syncScript": "/srv/kb-pipeline/sync/daily.sh", "logDir": "/srv/kb-pipeline/sync/logs" }
```

## 使用

打开 **`http://127.0.0.1:<你的 DSH Web 端口>/__dsh-kb-sync/`**（与 GUI 同一个端口）。页面分三步，另有编排区：

**① 网页端登录态** —— 粘贴一次 `userToken`，它只进 DSH 凭据服务（不落明文文件、不进日志/响应）。

**② 拉取**
- **拉取新对话（增量）**：会话列表 → 只取「新增 / 续聊」的线程 → 写 `conversations/*.md` + `conversations.jsonl` + `catalog.json`；续聊就地更新、文件名不变。
- **全量回填**：走官方导出包（`export_all` → 轮询到就绪 → 下载 zip → 解析 `conversations.json`）。只在第一次需要完整历史时用；已有会话仅在导出内容更多时才更新。服务端生成导出可能要几分钟，所以它在后台跑，页面每 3 秒刷新阶段：`trigger → waiting-export → downloading → parsing → merging → done`。

**③ 检索** —— 关键词搜标题与正文，可勾「只看用户说的话」；每条命中都可点「展开全文」，直接在页面里读那个会话的完整 Markdown（思考过程与联网检索记录都在）。编排区三个按钮仍是：运行已有同步脚本 / 跑知识库体检 / 刷新状态。

| 路由 | 方法 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/` | GET | 控制页（单文件 HTML，无外部请求） |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/status` | GET | 状态 JSON：路径、凭据文件年龄、进度文件末 8 行、最新日志尾部、拉取/回填进度 |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/token` | GET / POST | 查 / 存 userToken（GET 只回「配没配」，**永不回值**） |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/token/clear` | POST | 清除已存的 userToken |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/pull` | POST | 增量拉取，同步返回本轮摘要 |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/backfill` | POST | 启动全量回填，立即返回 202（进度看 `/status`） |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/kb` | GET | 知识库状态（条数 / 大小 / 最近一次拉取） |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/search?q=&role=` | GET | 检索；`role=user` 只看用户发言 |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/conversation?id=` | GET | 取一个会话的完整 Markdown（超过 400 KB 截断并标注） |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/run` | POST | 启动你已有的同步命令；已在运行时返回 409 |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/doctor` | POST | 运行体检命令，返回 stdout / stderr / 退出码 |
| `/__dsh-kb-sync/log?name=` | GET | 读日志目录下某个文件的尾部（文件名白名单 + 越界拒绝） |

## 安全模型

- **只监听环回**：`Host` 必须是 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `::1`（挡住 DNS rebinding）；`Sec-Fetch-Site` 非同源一律 403。
- **写操作要自定义头**：POST 必须带 `x-dsh-kb-sync: 1`，跨站表单设不了自定义头。
- **日志读取白名单**：`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,120}$`，且解析后必须落在日志目录内。
- **argv 全显式**：`cmd.exe /c <脚本>`（POSIX 走 `/bin/sh`），不做字符串拼 shell。
- **凭据文件只 stat 不读**：状态里只有「是否存在 / 修改时间 / 年龄天数」，正文永不进响应（有单测守着）。

## 能力披露（`dsh-trust-check`）

代码判定、可复现、零 token：

```sh
npx dsh-trust-check --dir /path/to/dsh-kb-sync --exit-code
```

```
1 plugin(s) · 1 red · 0 accepted · 0 review · 0 expected · 0 clear

dsh-kb-sync 0.1.0 — red                    (退出码 2 = 有红线)
  Stop by default; confirm the risk in Settings if you still want to keep it.
  why be careful:
    · Detected in code: reads credential values and has network access
    · May touch secrets or sensitive env vars
    · Execute system commands
  capabilities: shell, fs-write, fs-read, network (outbound), credentials, env
  destinations (literal):
    … + 2 allowlisted/loopback destination(s)
  secret touches:
    read: creds.resolve(
  source: unpinned | git+https://github.com/<owner>/dsh-kb-sync.git
  evidence: 40 hit(s)
```

怎么读这份报告（**这次是真有红线，别跳过**）：

- **红线：读凭据值 + 有网络** —— 这是"自己拉取"那一半的必然结果：`credentials.resolve('DEEPSEEK_WEB_TOKEN')` 取出 token，再用 `fetch` 发给 chat.deepseek.com。
  这条无法通过改代码消除（除非不做拉取）；能做的只有**约束范围**：token 只进 DSH 凭据服务、只在这一次请求里用、永不写进文件/日志/响应；出网目标只有 chat.deepseek.com 一个域名。
- `fs-write`：写知识库（`conversations/*.md`、`conversations.jsonl`、`catalog.json`），全部落在配置的知识库目录内，越界即拒（有单测）。
- `network (outbound)`：命中来自 `lib/deepseek.js` 里那两个接口调用；外加控制页在浏览器里的同源 `fetch`。
- `credentials` / `env`：前者是上面那条红线；后者是可选的根目录环境变量。
- 按该工具的规则，**红线默认应挡住**；你要继续用就得在 **设置 → 插件体检** 里对该插件点"确认风险"（指纹随代码变化会失效，需要重新确认）。
- 未检出不等于安全：静态扫描看不到运行时行为。逐条核对与局限见 [`docs/CAPABILITY-DISCLOSURE.md`](docs/CAPABILITY-DISCLOSURE.md)。

## 已知限制

- **纯 host 半部**：没有设置页内的分节 UI（那需要 React 客户端半部 + 构建步骤），控制页是独立 URL。
- 需要宿主提供 `subprocess` 服务；缺失时 `/run`、`/doctor` 会明确报错，而不是静默失败。
- 状态是轮询（运行中 3 秒一次），不是推送。
- 界面文案目前是中文。
- 已在 Windows + DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上实测：控制页、`/status`、`/doctor`、越界与跨站拒绝；POSIX 执行分支已写但未实测；`/run` 的**成功路径**未在真机点过（它会真的跑一次同步，可能耗时并消耗你自己的额度）。
- **拉取有两条路**：日常用**增量**（列表接口游标在服务端失效，最多只回最新 100 条，所以增量只保证「往后每天长」）；要**完整历史**用**全量回填**（官方导出包）。回填的解析器已对着真实导出包实测：2446 条会话全部解析，最后一条是助手回复的占 **2442/2446**（若按时间戳找叶子，会有几百条停在提问上、丢掉最后一条回答——这正是导出包的已知坑）。
- `userToken` 会过期（数小时~数天）：过期后拉取报错，重新粘一次即可；它是你的账号凭据，不要外传。
- **默认不共用知识库目录**：插件的库在它自己的 `data/kb`。只有你显式把 `outDir` 指到与别的脚本同一个目录，才会出现两边互相重写 `catalog.json` / `conversations.jsonl` 的情况（各自读-改-写）。
- 检索是**直接扫 JSONL

# dsh-plugin-desktop-notify

上下文感知的桌面通知插件，给 DSH 补上官方客户端缺失的通知能力。

已验证环境：DSH Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`（Electron 44）· Windows 11 · `desktop` profile。
页面 origin 是 `dsh-app://app/`（安全上下文），通知权限由桌面壳自动授予，
`new Notification()` 直接出 Windows 通知中心 Toast，显示名 **DeepSeek Harness**，
声音用 Windows 自带提示音（`silent` 保持默认 false，不加自定义音效）。

## 它解决什么

客户端最小化、或被别的窗口盖住时（比如你正在看浏览器 / ComfyUI），你既看不到
「需要你授权」的审批卡片，也不知道回合什么时候跑完了。本插件在这两类时刻弹一条
**系统通知**，并且正文里带上**任务摘要**，让你一眼知道要做什么。

| 情况 | 通知标题 | 正文 |
|---|---|---|
| 需要授权执行命令（`pwsh` / `bash` 等） | `有任务需要授权` | 工具名 + 该操作用途（审批理由，已剥掉 `escalate sandbox to <mode>:` 机器前缀） |
| 需要授权改文件（`write` / `edit` 等） | `有文件需要修改` | 工具名 + 该操作用途 |
| 其它工具需要确认 | `有任务需要你确认` | 工具名 + 审批理由 |
| 模型提问等你回答 | `有问题需要你回答` | 问题原文 |
| 回合结束 | `任务已完成` | 会话名 + 提示回客户端看结果 |

## 什么时候**不**打扰你

- 客户端在前台（窗口获得焦点、页面可见）时：一律不弹，只在 UI 里照常显示；
- 子代理（subagent）会话的回合结束：不弹，只有主会话完成才提醒；
- 冷启动时本就处于 idle 的会话：不弹，只有观测到 `running: true -> false` 这个真实边沿才提醒；
- 同一事件 1.5 秒内重复投递：只弹一次。

用法提醒：**先在客户端发消息，再立刻切走**。回合是从你按下发送开始的，
切走之后事件才会发生在你不在场的时候；反过来（先切走再回来打字）会把你带回前台，
按设计就不弹了。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本目录>
# 或从仓库装：
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:LeeRolling/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify
```

本目录已声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`，装完**重启客户端**生效。
因为装的是 `link:`，改 `lib/client.js` 后重启即可，无需重装。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-desktop-notify
```

## 结构

```
package.json            dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client.platform=web
cordis.patch.yml        向 profile 插入一行 host 加载项
lib/paths.js            诊断文件位置（可覆盖，无机器相关绝对路径）
lib/index.js            宿主半：常驻诊断通道（报告接收 + 自检开关 + trace 轮转）
lib/client.js           浏览器半：三个 watcher + 分类 + 通知
test/client.test.mjs    假 DOM 冒烟测试（npm test，不需启动 DSH）
tools/trace.mjs         读 trace 打印摘要
```

浏览器半订阅三个客户端事件：

| 事件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `approval/request` | 审批瀑布，只观察不消费（`return next()` 原样放行） |
| `user-questions/request` | 模型提问瀑布，同上 |
| `api-session/status` | 会话 running 状态，取 `true -> false` 边沿 = 回合结束 |

## 诊断通道（**长期保留**）

浏览器里发生的事对外部完全不可见，所以两个半之间有两条专属通道，**永久开启**，
以后任何时候通知行为不对，先看这里，不用改代码、不用加日志：

| 端点 | 方向 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/desktop-notify/report` | 浏览器 → 宿主 | 上报每个决策：事件是否到达、被哪道闸拦下、`new Notification()` 是否抛异常、环境快照 |
| `GET /api/desktop-notify/selftest` | 浏览器 → 宿主 | 返回自检开关状态、trace 与开关的实际路径 |

### 文件在哪

默认写在 `<DSH_HOME|~/.dsh>/desktop-notify/trace.jsonl`，用环境变量 `DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_TRACE`
可以整体改到别处（自检开关 `selftest.flag` 始终与 trace 同目录）。目录不存在时自动创建，
**代码里没有任何写死的机器路径**。把 `DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_TRACE` 设成 `off`（或
`0` / `false` / `none` / `no`）则**完全关掉**写入，端点与自检仍然可用。

trace **自轮转**：超过 512 KB 自动裁掉前半、只保留最近 256 KB（按行边界裁，JSONL 始终可解析），
长期开着也不会涨到失控。

### 怎么读

| kind | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `host-apply` | 宿主半装载（pid / Electron / Node 版本 / trace 路径） |
| `client-apply` | 浏览器半装载，附环境快照（origin / 安全上下文 / 权限 / hidden / hasFocus） |
| `event` | 事件真的到达了浏览器半 |
| `suppressed` | 被闸门拦下，`reason` 是 `window-in-front` / `duplicate` / `no-permission-api` |
| `shown` | 通知真的弹了（`forced:true` 表示自检强制弹） |
| `threw` | `new Notification()` 抛异常，`message` 是原因 |
| `apply-failed` | 浏览器半**装载时**就抛了（典型原因：DSH 升级把服务或事件改名）——这条能避免"插件装着但永远不响"被误判成没装好 |

```sh
node tools/trace.mjs          # 统计 + 最近 15 条
node tools/trace.mjs --all    # 全量
```

### 自检

在同目录放一个 `selftest.flag`（即 `<DSH_HOME|~/.dsh>/desktop-notify/selftest.flag`），
下次页面加载 2 秒后，会**无视前后台**强制弹一条标题为「通知自检」的 Toast —— 用来区分
「代码没跑」和「系统不显示」。自检完记得删掉，否则每次加载页面都会弹。
