plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gotify-notify

DSH 的 Gotify 通知插件：**每轮会话结束**时向你的 [Gotify](https://gotify.net/) 服务器推送一条通知，可在 DSH 的插件管理页里直接配置，无需手改配置文件。

## 功能

- 监听会话的 `turn/end` 事件，按「成功 / 其它结果」分别使用两套标题模板。
- 支持占位符：`{id}`（会话短 id）、`{title}`（会话标题，与侧边栏一致）、`{turn}`（轮次）、`{reason}`（结束原因的**中文标签**）、`{reasonRaw}`（结束原因的原始标识）、`{error}`（失败原因，仅在出错时有内容）、`{cwd}`（工作目录名）、`{time}`（本地时间）；未知占位符原样保留。
- 默认跳过子 Agent 会话，可开关。
- 可只在失败/中断时通知（`notifyOnErrorOnly`）。
- 推送失败只写日志，绝不影响会话本身。
- 插件管理页提供「发送测试通知」按钮，配好之后可以先验证再启用。
- 口令存在 **DSH 凭据库**里（和模型设置页写 API Key 是同一个地方），配置文件里只留一个引用名（`passwordEnv`，默认 `GOTIFY_PASSWORD`），所以 `cordis.patch.yml` 里不含任何机密；用户名不是机密，仍放在设置里。详见下面的「凭据」一节。

## 安装

### 通过 dshmarket 安装

```text
市场 → 搜索 gotify → 安装 → 重启 DSH
```

安装后 DSH 会读取本包的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，把下面这条行插进 Loader 树（行内容由本包的 `cordis.patch.yml` 提供）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: gotify-notify
      name: dsh-gotify-notify
```

### 从本地目录安装（开发调试）

在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）里：

```powershell
pnpm add file:C:\path\to\dsh-gotify-notify
```

然后在该 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里补上 `dsh-gotify-notify`，重启 DSH。

### 从旧的手工挂载迁移

如果你之前是手工挂在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（形如 `name: './gotify-notify/index.js'` 的相对路径 insert 行），**必须先删掉那条旧行**再安装本包，否则同一条通知会推送两次：

1. 打开 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`，删掉 `id: gotify-notify` 且 `name` 指向相对路径的整条 insert 行。
2. 删除旧目录 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/gotify-notify/`。
3. 把原来的 `url` 等设置好在插件管理页里重新填一遍（面板保存会写回 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`）。
4. 重启 DSH。

## 配置

打开 **设置 → 插件 → 找到 `dsh-gotify-notify` → 配置**（插件管理页的行内配置卡）。

| 字段 | 说明 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | Gotify 服务器地址，必须以 `http://` 或 `https://` 开头 | `https://gotify.21zys.com` |
| `user` | Gotify 用户名（用于自动创建/复用名为 `DSH` 的应用并换取 token）；留空则读启动环境变量 `GOTIFY_USER` | 空 |
| `passwordEnv` | **口令的凭据引用名**：口令存在凭据库的哪个名字下（同时是环境变量名） | `GOTIFY_PASSWORD` |
| `token` | 直接指定应用 token，填了就不再需要账号密码 | 空 |
| `titleCompleted` | 正常结束时的通知标题模板 | `DSH 任务完成` |
| `titleOther` | 非正常结束时的标题模板 | `DSH 轮次结束（{reason}）` |
| `message` | 通知正文模板 | 见下 |
| `priority` | 优先级，0–10 的整数 | `5` |
| `notifyOnErrorOnly` | 只在非正常结束时通知 | 关 |
| `includeSubagents` | 连子 Agent 的轮次结束也通知 | 关 |

### 凭据

口令**不写进配置文件**。插件管理页里的口令控件走
`ctx.remote.credentials.set(ref, value)` 把值写进 DSH 的凭据库
（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`，与模型 API Key 同一个库），配置文件里只留下
`passwordEnv` 这个引用名。是否已配置由 `describe()` 回读判定 —— 值永不回传。

插件求值时按下面的顺序找口令，前一条拿到就用前一条：

1. 凭据域按 `passwordEnv`（默认 `GOTIFY_PASSWORD`）解析 —— 凭据库与启动环境都走这一条；
2. 凭据域缺席、拒绝解析、或未命中该引用时，直接读启动环境里与 `passwordEnv` 同名的变量。

凭据域是**软探测**的：profile 没组合凭据服务时插件照常工作，直接从启动环境读，
不会因为缺一个服务就起不来。

默认正文：

```text
会话 {title} 第 {turn} 轮已结束
结果：{reason}
目录：{cwd}
时间：{time}
```

> **模板里的换行怎么写？** 设置面板是单行输入框，换行请写成两个字符 `\n`，插件会还原成真正的换行。

`{reason}` 输出中文标签，`{reasonRaw}` 输出 DSH 的原始标识：

| 原始标识 | `{reason}` |
| --- | --- |
| `completed` | 成功 |
| `error` | 失败 |
| `aborted` | 已中止 |
| `interrupted` | 已中断 |
| `blocked` | 被阻断 |
| `max-tokens` | 超出长度上限 |
| `forked` | 分支继承 |

`turn/end` 的原因集合在 DSH 里是**可扩展**的（`TurnEndReasonMap` 允许后端新增取值），未收录的标识会原样显示，不会编造中文。

`{error}` 只在 `error` 结束时才有内容：它取自 DSH 的失败快照 `reason.error`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 的 LlmFailure，含非空的 `message` 与 `code`），优先用 `message`，消息为空时回落到 `code`；其余结束原因渲染成**空串**，所以像 `结果：{reason}\n{error}` 这样的正文在成功时是干净的，不会残留 `{error}` 字面量。

配置保存在当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中，由 DSH 的配置编辑器自动维护；本包的 `cordis.patch.yml` 不预置 `config:`，避免出现两份互相覆盖的配置。

## 行为细节

- 只处理 `turn/end`；子 Agent 判定同时看 `header.origin === 'subagent'` 与 `header.parentSession`。
- token 只在内存里缓存，进程重启后重新换取；获取失败会清空缓存，下次重试。
- 推送是 fire-and-forget：失败时只在 DSH 日志里记一条 `推送失败：…`。
- 「发送测试通知」由宿主侧路由 `/gotify-notify/test` 处理，围栏是「回环 socket + 回环 Host」：DSH 桌面壳转发页面请求时会删掉 `Origin` 与 `Sec-Fetch-Site`，所以不能靠浏览器同源标记判定，只能以回环连接本身为权威边界（带了 `Origin` 时仍要求与 `Host` 同权威，`Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` 一律拒绝）。

## 开发

```powershell
# 宿主半自检：Config / url / 凭据 / 模板渲染
node selfcheck.mjs

# 浏览器半自检：槽位注册 / 注入面 / 表单投影 / 保存与 secret
node selfcheck-client.mjs

# 清单自检：package.json 字段、exports/files 指向、bundle patch 形态、icon 与 locale
node selfcheck-manifest.mjs
```

自检脚本需要能解析 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`，在未安装本包的目录里跑时可临时建目录联接：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery `
  -Target "$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery"
```

## 发布（上架 dshmarket）

dshmarket 只允许安装 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 精选列表里的来源，因此上架需要两步：

1. **发布 npm 包**（市场优先使用经仓库验证的 npm 包，比 GitHub 源码安装更快更稳）：

   ```powershell
   npm publish
   ```

2. **向 awesome-dsh-plugin 仓库提 PR**，在插件列表里加一条，`url` 指向本包仓库、`npm` 指向包名（本包已配置 `publishConfig.access = public`）。

条目生效后，用户在 dshmarket 里搜索 `gotify` 即可一键安装。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Command Code balance and quota panel for DeepSeek Harness: balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as a status row under the composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-commandcode-quota

A **Command Code balance and quota panel** for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

The plugin renders a compact status row directly underneath the DSH composer:

- **5-hour, weekly and monthly usage windows** as live percentages
- **Available balance**
- Click the row to expand the full breakdown: used / limit / remaining / reset time, total spend, tokens, success rate, subscription and account information

It is **single-account by design**. There is no account switcher, and your API key never reaches the browser.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web client (`dsh web` or the desktop app)
- Node.js 20 or newer
- A Command Code API key

## Install

### From npm (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-commandcode-quota
```

DSH expands the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` into your profile, so no manual patch editing is needed.

### From a local checkout

```bash
dsh plugin add file:/path/to/dsh-commandcode-quota
```

### Manual junction (desktop app)

The Electron desktop profile is managed by the application and does not run the `dsh plugin add` reconciliation, so register it yourself.

Link the package into the shared resolution pool:

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\dsh-commandcode-quota" `
  -Target "C:\path\to\dsh-commandcode-quota"
```

Then add this to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-commandcode-quota
      name: 'dsh-commandcode-quota'
      config:
        apiKeyEnv: COMMANDCODE_API_KEY
```

> The junction name must be exactly the package name, otherwise the host cannot resolve the import.

After installing or changing the plugin, reload the plugin tree (the plugin page's refresh action, or a client restart).

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` | Credential entry resolved through DSH's credentials service |
| `fallbackEnv` | — | Optional second entry, used only when the first one is missing |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.commandcode.ai` | Command Code API origin |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request timeout in milliseconds |

Credentials live in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, or in DSH Settings → Credentials. Never commit them.

## How it works

The package has two halves:

- **Host half** (`src/index.js`) resolves the key through the DSH credentials service and registers a read-only HTTP endpoint that fans out to the Command Code API, then aggregates the responses into a single payload. The key is read on every request and never serialized to the client.
- **Client half** (`src/client.js`) registers a status row into the composer dock slot, polls the host endpoint, and renders it with DSH theme tokens so light and dark themes both work.

Data comes from four Command Code endpoints, each called with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`:

| Endpoint | Used for |
|---|---|
| `GET /alpha/billing/credits` | Balance and the 5-hour / weekly limits |
| `GET /alpha/usage/summary` | Spend, tokens and success rate |
| `GET /alpha/billing/subscriptions` | Subscription status and period boundaries |
| `GET /alpha/whoami` | Account information |

The monthly window is composed from the usage total plus the remaining credits, with the reset time taken from the subscription period.

### Behaviour under failure

- The four requests run in parallel, so total latency is the slowest one rather than the sum.
- A connection-level failure is retried once; a deliberate timeout is not retried.
- On failure the panel falls back to the last successful value (kept in-process for 6 hours) and reports it as stale.
- An HTTP 401 is never masked by cached data, because it means the credential itself is wrong.

## Development

```bash
npm test                        # host and client unit tests; no network, no DSH process
node --check src/index.js       # host half syntax
node --check src/client.js      # client half syntax
```

The tests stub the credentials service, the web server, `fetch` and React, so they run offline and never touch a live DSH instance.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 同时显示AI模型和供应商
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-show

A [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) client plugin for the Web UI: the composer's model
selector shows **Provider/Model** instead of a bare model name, so a selected model always names
the provider it comes from.

| | Composer trigger |
|---|---|
| Before | `Example Chat · High` |
| After  | `Example Provider/Example Chat · High` |

The dropdown menu is untouched: rows stay plain (`Example Chat`) under their provider
headings, and search keeps matching plain model names. The hover tooltip and ARIA label carry the
same `Provider/Model` text as the visible trigger.

![Composer trigger reading OpenCode Zen/DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Default](docs/composer-trigger.png)

A real trigger: provider `OpenCode Zen`, model `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash`; the trailing `Default` is the
thinking-effort suffix DSH already appends.

## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1 < 0.3.0-0`, `web` client platform (developed and tested against the Desktop
  runtime `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- The built-in model selection plugin (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`) must stay
  enabled. This plugin reuses its `modelDirectories` service and only shadows the composer seat.
- Provider names are whatever your own model configuration declares (`displayName` of each
  provider row), e.g. `Example Provider`, `Example Vendor`.

## Install

### Plugin market

Open the plugin market in the target DSH app, search for the package name `dsh-model-show`,
install it, then enable it.

### Desktop CLI

The Desktop app ships its own CLI (the reserved `desktop` profile is managed only by it):

```console
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-model-show
```

From GitHub, or from a local checkout:

```console
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:<user>/dsh-model-show
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\dsh-model-show"
```

Remove it with `plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-model-show`.

### From a DSH session

Ask the agent to install the bundle from this directory (`plugin_manager` with
`action: install_bundle` and the package directory as `target`).

Reload the page after installing. Replacing an already-loaded plugin with a different build needs
an application restart.

## Verify

1. The composer trigger reads `Provider/Model` (plus `· <effort>` when the model reports a
   reasoning effort).
2. Hovering it shows the same text.
3. The menu still lists plain model names under provider headings, and searching a provider name
   does not match models.

## How it works

- `lib/index.js` is the plugin's (empty) node half, so the bundle can be mounted by the profile's
  layer stack; the browser half is discovered through `dsh.client` + `exports["./client"]`.
- `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one row (`id: model-show`, `name: dsh-model-show`).
- `lib/client.js` is the built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` browser bundle with
  six documented edits (`scripts/vendor-from-asar.mjs`, each marked with an `EDIT:` comment in
  the generated file). The two that produce the visible change are the provider-prefixed
  `choices[].model.name` and registering the composer seat at `priority: -1`, which shadows the
  built-in seat because the lowest priority renders. The upstream `inject` list is left untouched
  (see Limitations — the seat resolves its catalog through the consuming context).
- The label is prefixed where the trigger reads it (`currentChoice?.model.name`), so the menu's own
  `groups` — and therefore search — stay untouched.

## Development

```console
npm test                 # offline checks: manifest, the six edits, and the label behaviour
npm run vendor           # re-extract the upstream bundle from the installed app and re-apply the edits
npm run vendor:check     # exit non-zero when the shipped bundle is not the vendored one
```

`npm run vendor` reads
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar` →
`dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection/lib/client.js`, or a client bundle
passed with `--from <client.js>` / an archive with `--asar <app.asar>`.

If upstream moves an anchor, vendoring fails loudly (`anchor not found (<label>) — upstream
bundle changed?`) instead of shipping a broken bundle; review the edits against the new bundle and
update the script, then re-run `npm test`.

Line endings are normalised to LF by `.gitattributes`. `lib/client.js` is compared byte for byte
against the vendored output, so a CRLF checkout would fail both `npm test` and `npm run vendor:check`.

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | Bundle and client manifest (`dsh.bundle.patch`, `dsh.client`) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row into the profile layer stack |
| `lib/index.js` | Node half (empty `apply`, so the row can mount) |
| `lib/client.js` | Vendored browser bundle with the six edits |
| `scripts/vendor-from-asar.mjs` | Vendoring: extract from an installed DSH, apply and verify the edits |
| `tests/verify-bundle.test.mjs` | Offline verification of the shipped bundle |
| `icon.svg`, `locale/*.json` | Plugin Manager card metadata |
| `screenshots.json`, `docs/composer-trigger.png` | Storefront screenshot, declared in-repo so the market reads it from here |

## Limitations

- `lib/client.js` is a vendored copy of a built-in bundle, so it also requires
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, and
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` from the browser module table (declared in
  `dsh.client.external`). A redesign of the built-in model selector in a future DSH release can
  break this bundle; `engines.dsh`, the vendoring script, and `npm test` are the guard rails.
- The plugin inherits the built-in control wholesale, including its stylesheet and its
  `min(360px, 45cqw)` trigger width; a long `Provider/Model` label is ellipsized rather than
  wrapped.
- The vendored bundle deliberately keeps the built-in plugin's whole service list (`commandUi`,
  `locale`, `sessions`, `slots`, `remote`, `remote.session`). The seat resolves its per-session
  catalog through the *consuming* context, so trimming the list to the services this plugin visibly
  uses throws `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject` on the first render after a
  launch; the slot registry then retires the crashing entry and the built-in seat renders instead —
  with no error shown anywhere. `npm run vendor` and `npm test` guard against that edit returning.
- No configuration: the format is fixed to `Provider/Model`.

## License

MIT. `lib/client.js` is derived from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` (MIT,
Copyright (c) DeepSeek). See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a 5px dot left of the model name in the composer tool row — yellow for DeepSeek peak hours, green for off-peak (half price). Rendered only when the session's model provider is DeepSeek.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator

**See the current DeepSeek API pricing window at a glance in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web GUI.**

A single 5px dot sits in the composer tool row, **just left of the model name** (**rendered only when the
session's selected model provider is DeepSeek**):

| Color | Window | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🟡 Yellow `#f2b705` | Peak hours | Standard |
| 🟢 Green `#22c55e` | Off-peak hours | Half price |

Nothing else is rendered — no text, no icon, no placeholder copy (the dot carries an
`aria-label` for screen readers). No build step, no third-party dependencies: the whole
plugin is one file.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

## When it shows

The dot renders only while the session's selected model provider is DeepSeek; otherwise it
renders nothing at all and takes no space:

| Provider | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `deepseek-official` (DeepSeek API key) | ✅ |
| `deepseek-account` (DeepSeek account) | ✅ |
| Anything else (Anthropic, an OpenAI-compatible gateway, a self-hosted proxy, …) | ❌ hidden |
| Unknown (model directory still loading) | ❌ hidden |

The provider is what counts, not the model name — a third-party gateway serving a DeepSeek
model does not get DeepSeek's time-of-day pricing. The rule lives in `isDeepSeekProvider()`;
change that one function to change the policy.

The session's model directory is resolved **after mount, with retries**: a freshly switched
session has not registered its scope yet, so the lookup legitimately fails for a moment. The
dot therefore appears a fraction of a second after a session switch instead of staying hidden
for the whole session.

## How the window is decided

Per DeepSeek's official pricing page
([Models & Pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing)):

- **Peak**: Beijing time **Monday–Friday** (excluding Chinese statutory holidays),
  **09:00–12:00** and **14:00–18:00**;
- **Off-peak**: everything else, **including weekends and statutory holidays all day**
  (off-peak = half of the peak price).

Intervals are half-open: 12:00 and 18:00 sharp already count as off-peak, while 09:00 and
14:00 sharp count as peak. All comparisons use `Asia/Shanghai`, so the machine's own time
zone does not matter.

> **Make-up workdays.** The official wording is "Monday to Friday … all other periods,
> including weekends and Chinese statutory holidays, are off-peak all day". A Saturday or
> Sunday that the government designates as a make-up workday therefore stays off-peak
> (green) here. Change the `WORKDAYS` check in `client.js` if you disagree.

## Installation

Requires a working DSH profile (desktop app or `dsh web`).

The recommended way is to **paste a GitHub address into the Plugins page** — no clone and no
commands:

1. Open the **Plugins** page from the sidebar (the plugin icon in the panel list).
2. Click **Add plugin**.
3. Paste this address into the field (it accepts a package name, a GitHub repository address,
   or a local directory path):

   ```
   https://github.com/cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator
   ```

   The shorthand `github:cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator` works too; add a branch or
   commit to pin a revision, e.g.
   `github:cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator#<commit-sha>`.

4. It is live as soon as it finishes: the result reads `application: applied` and the open
   page needs no refresh. If it reports `restart-required`, restart Harness.

The installer writes the package into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` and dependencies,
and inserts the loader row declared by this repository's own `cordis.patch.yml` — you never
edit a config file by hand.

### Installing through the agent (equivalent)

```
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=github:cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator
```

Before installing, the manager runs a `git ls-remote` reachability check against the
repository (public repos need no credentials).

### Installing from a local directory (when editing the code)

1. Clone the repository:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator.git
   ```

2. Paste the **absolute path** of the clone into the same field (or hand it to the agent):

   ```
   plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=/absolute/path/to/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator
   ```

   The profile records a `link:` dependency, so re-installing after an edit is enough.

**Update**: re-installing the **same source** does **not** take effect — the dependency is
unchanged, so the installer reports `ambiguous-install`. Uninstall on the Plugins page first,
then add the same address again:

```
plugin_manager  action=remove_bundle  target=dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle target=github:cumthugo/dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator
```

The host re-reads the bundle and pushes it to the open page, so no restart is needed. (The
local-directory flavour works the same way — swap the second target for the clone path;
switching to a different source, e.g. from a local path to the GitHub address, also avoids
the ambiguity.)
**Disable / uninstall**: toggle the row on the GUI Plugins page, or use `plugin_manager`'s
`remove_bundle` with the package name `dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator`.

> The package name matches the repository (`dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator`) and is not
> published to npm — install it by local path or from GitHub as shown above. The name must
> match the `id` in `client.js`'s `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` and the entry `name`
> in `cordis.patch.yml`: change one and all three must change, followed by a reinstall.

## Holiday data and automatic refresh

Holidays are only used to exclude statutory days off from the peak windows. Three sources,
in priority order:

1. **Local cache** — `localStorage` key `dsh-deepseek-offpeak-indicator:holidays:<year>`, considered
   fresh for 30 days;
2. **Network refresh** — the year JSON from
   [holiday-cn](https://github.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn) (which scrapes the State Council
   holiday notices), trying `raw.githubusercontent.com` then `cdn.jsdelivr.net`, with a 6 s
   timeout;
3. **Built-in fallback** — `BUILTIN_HOLIDAYS` in `client.js` (currently 2026, 33 days off).

So **next year's schedule takes effect automatically once published**, with no code change,
provided the machine can reach one of those two hosts. Fully offline, the built-in table is
used; for a year with neither cache nor built-in data the plugin degrades to a
weekend-only rule (that year's holidays would be misread as peak during 09:00–12:00 and
14:00–18:00).

To refresh the built-in table offline:

```bash
node tools/update-holidays.mjs            # existing years + this year and the next
node tools/update-holidays.mjs 2027       # only the given years
```

Run the remove → install flow above afterwards, so the page picks up the new built-in table.

## Layout

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Bundle manifest: `dsh.bundle.patch` and the `dsh.client` declaration |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `deepseek-offpeak-indicator` loader row |
| `index.js` | Host half, empty `apply()` (it exists so the loader has a host row) |
| `client.js` | Browser half: window logic, the dot component, slot registration (one file, no build) |
| `tools/update-holidays.mjs` | Regenerates the built-in holiday table |
| `tools/test-classify.mjs` | Regression tests: peak windows, the provider gate, and the session-switch resolve/retry path (31 assertions) |

## Customizing

Everything lives at the top of `client.js`: `PEAK_WINDOWS`, `PEAK_COLOR` /
`OFFPEAK_COLOR`, `DOT_SIZE` (default `5`), `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_IDS` /
`isDeepSeekProvider()` (which providers count as DeepSeek), plus the slot and its placement —
the dot registers into `conversation.input.right`, which renders immediately left of the model
name, and `nudgeX` / `nudgeY` shift it by a few pixels (currently `16` / `1`). To move it
elsewhere change `name` in `ctx.slots.register` (e.g. `conversation.input.left`,
`conversation.composer.dock`) and adjust `id` accordingly.

## Development

```bash
node tools/test-classify.mjs   # window-logic regressio

plugins.description: Stop & delete DeepSeek Harness sessions from the sidebar menu — cancels the running turn, subagents, background jobs and reminders, then removes the log, projection cache and workspace record. 「停止」与「删除」会话：先停工作，再删日志、缓存与工作区记录，并在有新版本时提示。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-remove **Stop and permanently delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar — plus a notice when a new release is out.** **给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的会话菜单补上「停止」与「删除」，并在有新版本时提示更新。** [中文](#中文) · [English](#english) --- ## 中文 DSH 的会话行菜单只有 **重命名 / 分叉 / 归档** —— 归档只是把会话藏起来，日志一个字节都没少； 而想停掉一个会话的工作，你得先打开它、再按停止。这个插件把这两件事都放回你最常点的位置 （会话行的 `⋯` 菜单）。 ``` ⋯ 菜单 → 停止会话… 取消运行中的回合、子代理、后台任务与定时提醒 → 删除会话… 永久删除该会话的本地数据（不可恢复） ``` 安装后不需要重启 DSH，也不需要刷新页面。 ### 为什么不是又一个 DOM 补丁 同类插件普遍靠注入 DOM 或沿 React fiber 取行数据来塞菜单项，核心 UI 一改就可能失效。 本插件走的是官方开放的扩展点： - 菜单项注册进官方 slot **`sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`** —— Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive 本身就是这个 slot 里的注册项，插件行按 `order` 排序； - 停止走官方的 **`workspace/session-stop`** 准入（`ctx.workspaceRegistry.stopSessionActivity()`）， 由 `dsh-agent` / `dsh-subagent` / `dsh-jobs` / `dsh-schedule` 四个 provider 分别停掉回合、子代理、后台任务与提醒； - 删除通过 **`ctx.workspaceRegistry`** 与 **`storageDomain`** 的公开 API 完成，不 shell 出 `rm`； - 删完 emit 官方事件 **`api-session/removed`**（会话被销毁时会话控制器自己发的那条），侧栏该行当帧消失； - 只删能自证身份的目录：日志路径由持久化后端的 `locate()` 给出，并要求 `basename(dir) === sessionId`， 否则直接拒绝而不是猜。 ### 安装 ```sh # 桌面版：侧栏 → 插件 → 添加插件 → 填包名 dsh-session-remove # 其它 profile（web / tui / 自建） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-remove ``` > **中国用户注意**：如果你的 npm 默认源是 `registry.npmmirror.com`，新发布的包在镜像上可能有 > **同步延迟**。若安装时报「`declares no dsh.bundle`」，请在安装对话框里把**安装源**改成 > **npm 官方源**，或改用 tarball 地址： > `https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-session-remove/-/dsh-session-remove-<版本号>.tgz` 升级：本插件带更新提示（见下），也可以在插件页卸载后重新安装。 ### 用法 鼠标移到侧栏任意会话行 → 点 **⋯**： | 菜单项 | 做什么 | |---|---| | **停止会话…** | 取消运行中的回合，并停掉该会话的子代理、后台任务与定时提醒 | | **删除会话…** | 永久删除该会话的本地数据 | **停止的一个要点**：这条停止路径与归档用的是同一条（`workspace/session-stop`）， 它**丢弃排队中的输入**（界面上的停止按钮会保留）。确认框里写明了这一点。 **删除**遇到仍在跑的工作时，弹窗会说明原因并多给一个 **停止并删除** 按钮，一步完成。 ### 删除的是什么 | 位置 | 内容 | |---|---| | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<项目>/<会话id>/` | 会话日志（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`）与写租约，整个目录移除 | | `session_projcache` 存储域 | 该会话的投影检查点记录 | | `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json` | 工作区成员位置、置顶、归档记录 | | 页面 | `api-session/removed` 事件让该行立即消失，无需刷新 | 搜索索引不需要额外处理：它按持久化列表对账，会话从列表消失即被清理。 ### 安全边界 | 情况 | 行为 | |---|---| | 仍有回合 / 子代理 / 后台任务 / 定时提醒 | 拒绝，并提供「停止并删除」 | | 停止后仍在收尾（有界等待内未清零） | 拒绝，提示稍候再试 | | 会话仍被进程持有 | 先释放它再删（见下） | **为什么删除前要先释放**：一个还活着的写句柄会在下一次 flush 时把刚删掉的日志重新创建出来。 注册表的归档流程把释放交给会话的登记方，而 seam 没给第三方留受支持的入口，所以插件调用 存储服务的公开方法 `detachEntered(entry)`，并在删除文件前跑一次持久化屏障： ``` 释放会话 → 停止工作 → 等待清零 → flush 屏障 → 删除文件 ``` 两处顺序都不能颠倒：**先释放再停止**，否则被停止的会话会唤醒 agent 去处理被杀任务的结果、 甚至重新启动新的工作，那份新工作会活过删除变成孤儿；**先释放再删文件**，否则写句柄会把日志写回来。 取不到释放凭据（不同版本）时会退化为拒绝并提示先切换会话——功能降级，但绝不会留下半删状态。 > 删除**当前正在查看**的会话后，主区域会自动回到空状态（与官方归档当前会话的行为一致）， > 不会停在已经不存在的旧页面。 ### 更新提示 插件会定期问一次注册表（默认 npm 官方源，失败回退 npmmirror）自己是不是最新版。 **只提示，不静默替换**：右下角出现一条可关闭的提示，点「更新」才通过 profile 自己的插件管理器 安装。替换已安装的包需要重启才能加载新的宿主模块，所以提示里会写明「重启后生效」。 包名取自自身的 `package.json`，默认即可工作；只有把包部署成别名时才需要覆盖 `updatePackageName`。 ### 工作原理 | 半边 | 文件 | 职责 | |---|---|---| | Host | `index.js` | 在 `/api` 鉴权围栏内注册 6 条精确 Fetch 路由：`session-delete.delete` / `.stop` / `.update-state` / `.install-update` / `.client-ready` / `.status` | | Client | `client.js` | 注册两个菜单项与一个 `shell.overlay` 条目（确认框 + 更新提示），中英双语跟随界面语言 | 浏览器半与宿主半同源通信，凭据由浏览器会话自动携带。 ### 兼容性 - 实测 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2**（DeepSeek Harness Desktop） - 需要组合里存在 `connection` / `sessionPersistence` / `workspaceRegistry`（Web profile 默认满足） - 零依赖、零构建 ### 排查 插件会写一行/次操作到 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-session-remove.log`： ``` host half active (build r5-unified@1.0.0, 6 routes, update mode notify) client half mounted (features=stop,delete,update+menu=sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item,overlay=shell.overlay) update check: current 1.0.0, latest 1.0.1 (update available) stop session-…: asked job (settled: true) released session-… from the live store deleted session-… (session-dir:…, projection-cache) refused session-…: session-held ``` - 没有 `client half mounted` → 页面半没装载（检查插件是否启用、页面是否刷新过） - `refused : ` → 宿主拒绝了这次操作，代码含义见「安全边界」 - 安装时报 `declares no dsh.bundle` → 见「安装」里的镜像同步说明 ### 已知限制 - **删除不可恢复**：没有回收站，也没有撤销。 - 附件是内容寻址去重的，不做按会话回收。 - 删除**正被界面打开**的会话时会被先释放（主区域回到空状态）。 - 「停止」会丢弃排队中的输入，这是它所复用的官方停止路径的语义。 - 更新需要重启才生效；旧版本的宿主模块会一直留在内存里直到重启。 ### 测试 零依赖，用 Node 内置的测试运行器（Node ≥ 22）： ```sh node --test test/host.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs # 41 项 ``` `test/host.test.mjs`（28 项）用模拟的 `ctx` 驱动真实的 `apply()`：删除与停止的完整链路、 释放顺序、拒绝码、路径护栏、更新检查的每条分支与 semver 排序。 `test/client.test.mjs`（13 项）用最小 React 运行时真实渲染两个菜单项、两个确认框与更新提示， 模拟点击并核对请求载荷与文案。 测试**不会**进入 npm 包（`files` 白名单里没有 `test/`），只随仓库分发。 --- ## English DeepSeek Harness's session row menu only offers **Rename / Fork / Archive** — archiving hides a session but keeps every byte on disk, and stopping a session's work means opening it first and pressing Stop. This plugin puts both back where you already click: the session row's `⋯` menu. ``` ⋯ menu → Stop Session… cancels the running turn, subagents, background jobs and reminders → Delete Session… permanently removes that session's local data (no undo) ``` No DSH restart and no page reload needed after installing. ### Why not another DOM patch Comparable plugins inject DOM nodes or walk React fibers to add a menu row, so a change to the core UI can break them. This one uses open extension points only: - the row registers into the official slot **`sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`** — Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive are registered entries in that same slot, so a plugin row is ordered by its own `order`; - stopping goes through the official **`workspace/session-stop`** admission (`ctx.workspaceRegistry.stopSessionActivity()`), answered by `dsh-agent` / `dsh-subagent` / `dsh-jobs` / `dsh-schedule` for the turn, subagents, background jobs and reminders; - deleting uses the public **`ctx.workspaceRegistry`** and **`storageDomain`** APIs — it never shells out to `rm`; - the deletion emits the official **`api-session/removed`** event (the one the Session controller itself emits when a live Session is disposed), so the row disappears on the spot; - only a directory that can prove its identity is removed: the log path comes from the persistence backend's `locate()`, and `basename(dir) === sessionId` must hold, or the plugin refuses instead of guessing. ### Install ```sh # Desktop: sidebar → Plugins → Add plugin → enter the package name dsh-session-remove # Other profiles (web / tui / custom) dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-remove ``` > **Behind the npmmirror registry?** A freshly published package can lag on the mirror. If the > install refuses with `declares no dsh.bundle`, switch **Install source** to the official npm > registry in the dialog, or install the tarball URL > `https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-session-remove/-/dsh-session-remove-.tgz`. Upgrading: this plugin offers an update notice (below), or uninstall and reinstall in the Plugins page. ### Usage Hover any session row in the sidebar → click **⋯**: | Menu row | What it does | |---|---| | **Stop Session…** | cancels the running turn and stops that session's subagents, background jobs and reminders | | **Delete Session…** | permanently removes that session's local data | **One thing to know about stopping**: this is the same path archive uses (`workspace/session-stop`), and it **discards queued input** (the in-conversation stop button keeps it). The confirmation dialog says so. When a **delete** meets running work, the dialog explains why and offers a **Stop and delete** button that does both in one step. ### What gets deleted | Location | Content | |---|---| | `$DSH_HOME/sessions///` | the session log (`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`) and its write lease — the whole directory | | the `session_projcache` storage domain | that session's projection checkpoint record | | `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json` | workspace membership, pin and archive entries | | the page | the `api-session/removed` event removes the row without a reload | The search index needs no help: it reconciles against the persistence listing, so a session that leaves that listing leaves the index too. ### Safety boundaries | Situation | Behaviour | |---|---| | A turn / subagent / background

plugins.description: Get记忆插件：DSH 的外置大脑——对话开始自动拉取 GitHub 仓库内容注入上下文，对话结束提取值得长期记住的新信息按文件写回并提交；左栏面板 + 原生设置页全图形化配置。Get 记忆 + Git 记忆。
plugins.readme_text:
# Get记忆（dsh-get-memory）— DSH 记忆插件

给 DeepSeek Harness 配一个「外置大脑」：对话开始前，它把 GitHub 仓库里的记忆文件装进上下文的脑子；对话结束后，它把值得长期记住的新事写回仓库并提交。跨设备、跨前端、跨重启，记忆都活在同一份文件里。

名字是个双关：**Get** 记忆（取回记忆）+ **Git** 记忆（GitHub 仓库里的记忆）。

## 快速开始（装好就能跑）

1. 安装插件（插件市场搜 `dsh-get-memory`，或 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-get-memory`）；
2. 生成细颗粒度 PAT：**只勾目标仓库的 Contents 读写**，别的权限一律不选（旧仓库、空仓库、新仓库都行）；
3. 打开左栏「Get记忆」面板（或设置页）→ 粘贴令牌 → 保存 → 插件自动列出令牌能看到的仓库 → **单选一个**作为记忆仓库；
4. 空仓库？设置页点「**一键初始化**」——插件自己用令牌创建 `长期记忆账本.md`，不用你去 GitHub 手动建任何东西；
5. 正常聊天：对话开始自动读；想开自动写回再打开「自动写回」开关（默认关，保护你的模型额度）。

没选仓库之前，插件不注入任何东西、也不写回任何东西——陌生的默认配置零风险。

## 它到底在干嘛

打个比方：你有一个 GitHub 仓库，里面躺着几份 Markdown 文件——人设、规则、长期记忆账本，随便你写什么。这个插件就是那个仓库的「管家」：

- **每次对话开始**（新建或恢复会话），管家自动把仓库里的文件拉下来，注入当前对话的上下文——所以模型一睁眼就知道「我是谁、发生过什么、有什么约定」；
- **每次对话结束**（回合停摆 30 秒，或会话关闭），管家自己调用模型，从刚才的对话里挑出「值得长期记住的新信息」，按文件写好、取最新 SHA、提交回仓库。没有实质变化就什么也不动；
- 断网了也不慌：拉取失败自动回退磁盘缓存，绝不把对话搞崩。

> 适配说明：本插件只适配 **DSH 软件端**（桌面应用）。DSH 的网页界面是软件端的镜像页面，插件能力跟随软件端生效，不提供独立的 web 插件。

## 特性

- 🧠 **自动拉取注入**：对话开始自动拉取指定仓库文件注入上下文（排序号默认 100，位于所有运行时上下文之前）；注入内容自动花括号消毒，仓库文件里带 `{{User}}` 这类模板语法也不会炸。
- 🗂️ **文件权限中心**：设置页「同步文件列表」一键拉取仓库当前文件，每个文件「只读 / 读写」可视化勾选（新文件默认读写）；「注入读什么、写回写什么」全由这张表说了算。每次拉取还会自动盘点——新文件自动加入，含模板语法的自动跳过。
- ✍️ **多文件自动写回**：对话结束提取「值得长期记住的新信息」，对所有「读写」文件逐个产出变更、逐个 SHA 锁提交；某文件冲突就重取重试一次。跨端「传话文件」也支持——只在有需要传话/回话时才动它，绝不灌水。
- 💗 **左栏快捷面板**：一颗小心心图标，实时看拉取状态、写回结果、令牌状态，一键「立即拉取」，自动写回开关，内置最近操作记录。
- ⚙️ **原生设置页（宁少勿多）**：DSH 设置里新增「Get记忆」专属页面——令牌、仓库选择器（由令牌驱动的仓库列表，单选）、文件权限、自动写回、触发范围、全局提示；高级字段（分支、注入顺序、转录上限、提取模型等）藏在底层配置里，不干扰新手。
- 🔁 **触发与范围**：每 N 次对话写回一次（N 可填，1 = 每次）；应用于「全部会话 / 排除列表 / 仅列表」。
- 🛡️ **安全默认**：默认仓库为空、默认不自动写回；不配置就不会注入/写回任何东西；令牌只用于你自己选的仓库。
- 🧰 **一键初始化**：选了个空仓库？设置页点一下，插件自动创建 `长期记忆账本.md`（友好模板），全程不用碰 GitHub 网页——工具适应人，不让人适应工具。
- 🔄 **检查更新**：设置页「检查更新」实时读 npm 最新版本，对照当前版本给提示和一条更新命令。
- 🔔 **回合写回指示 + 全局小条**：每回合结束，消息下方一行小字——「记忆已写回 ✓ / 整理中… / 无新记忆 / 写回失败」，悬停看详情；输入框下方的小胶囊全程跟踪写回——整理中常驻（橙色呼吸点，直到写完）、提交后「记忆已更新 ✓」、没有新内容则灰点「无新记忆」。都能在设置里关。

## 原理

### 令牌是怎么用的

插件按以下顺序找令牌，找到即止：

1. **DSH 凭据库**（`AIRE_MEMORY_GITHUB_TOKEN`，面板保存的令牌就存在这里，推荐位置）；
2. **环境变量**（同名）；
3. **插件配置的 `githubToken` 字段**（引导用：一旦在配置里填了，插件首次加载时自动把它迁移进凭据库）。

令牌只会被用于「读取 / 写入你配置的那一个仓库」，**绝不写入仓库任何文件**；写回前还会对内容做密钥形态脱敏。

### 读取链路

`agent/created` 事件（每次「上岗」）→ 并行拉取仓库文件（GitHub Contents API）→ 更新内存缓存 + 磁盘缓存（`~/.dsh/cache/aire-memory/snapshot.json`）→ 通过 `systemPrompt.context()` 在每次模型组装时注入最新内容。拉取失败不报错：回退缓存（标注过期），缓存也没有就注入「暂不可用」占位。

### 写回链路

`agent/turn-stopping`（回合结束）→ 防抖 30 秒（期间有新消息就取消）→ 或 `agent/disposed`（会话关闭）立即执行 → 插件自行调用模型（用当前会话模型 / 默认模型）提取新记忆，按「读写」文件逐个产出更新后的完整内容 → **先 GET 拿最新 SHA** → **PUT 提交（SHA 锁）** → 409 冲突自动重取重试一次 → 成功后本会话立刻看到新内容。

只对**根会话**（主对话）写回；子代理 / 工作流会话不写。所有失败仅记日志，绝不打断对话。

### 界面分工：左栏快捷面板 vs 原生设置页

| 左栏快捷面板（日常用） | 原生设置页（详细配置） |
|---|---|
| 状态一览（仓库 / 令牌 / 最近修改记录） | 令牌、仓库选择器、文件权限、一键初始化 |
| 立即拉取 | 自动写回、触发与范围、全局提示模式 |
| 自动写回开关 | 检查更新、关于 / 问题反馈 / 更新记录 |
| 设置引导 | 设置引导 |

## 配置（均有默认值，可直接用）

设置页只露新手需要的字段；下表是完整配置（含底层字段，插件列表的配置入口可改）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `repo` | 空 | 记忆仓库（owner/repo）；留空 = 未配置，不注入不写回。设置页通过令牌选择 |
| `branch` | `main` | 分支 |
| `fileModes` | 旧字段自动迁移 | 文件权限表 `[{file, mode: 'ro'/'rw'}]`：注入取全部，写回只取 rw；设置页「文件权限」卡片管理 |
| `ledgerFile` | `长期记忆账本.md` | 主账本（多文件写回时排最前） |
| `injectOrder` | `100` | 上下文排序（数字小靠前；运行时上下文从 110 起） |
| `tokenRef` | `AIRE_MEMORY_GITHUB_TOKEN` | 凭据库 / 环境变量名 |
| `githubToken` | 空 | 引导令牌（secret），首次加载自动迁移进凭据库 |
| `autoDiscoverFiles` | `true` | 每次拉取盘点仓库新 .md 并加入权限表（读写），含 `{{` 模板语法的跳过 |
| `writebackEnabled` | `false` | 自动写回开关（默认关，保护模型额度） |
| `writebackEveryN` | `5` | 每 N 条对话写回一次记忆（1 = 每条都写） |
| `sessionPolicyMode` | `all` | 应用范围：`all` / `exclude` / `include` |
| `sessionPolicyIds` | 空 | 排除 / 仅限的会话 id 列表 |
| `maxWriteFiles` | `5` | 每次写回最多处理的「读写」文件数 |
| `writebackDebounceMs` | `30000` | 回合结束后的写回防抖（毫秒） |
| `maxTranscriptChars` | `16000` | 送入提取器的转录上限（取尾部） |
| `minConversationChars` | `80` | 低于此长度不提取 |
| `extractProvider` / `extractModel` | 空 | 提取模型覆盖；留空用会话模型 / 默认模型 |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `15000` | 拉取 / 写入超时（毫秒） |
| `showPanelIcon` | `true` | 显示左栏快捷面板图标 |
| `showTurnIndicators` | `true` | 显示回合写回指示 |
| `showGlobalNotice` | `true` | 写回变动时输入框下方的小条提示 |
| `historyLimit` | `50` | 面板内操作记录保留条数 |

设置页与快捷面板里改动以上任意字段（图标/指示开关除外）都会保存为运行时覆盖，即时生效、重启保留。

## 更换令牌

1. GitHub 生成新的细颗粒度 PAT（仅目标仓库 Contents 读写）；
2. 面板或设置页令牌框粘贴新令牌保存（自动覆盖凭据库旧值，保存时即做仓库读验证），或直接改 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 里 `AIRE_MEMORY_GITHUB_TOKEN` 的值（重启 DSH 后生效）；
3. 旧令牌在 GitHub 上单独作废，互不影响。

## 本地开发

```bash
# 客户端半边是拼接式 ModuleLoader bundle（无构建依赖）：
node scripts/build-client.mjs   # 由 src/client/*.js 生成 client.js
node --check lib/index.v8.js    # 宿主半边语法检查
```

宿主半边入口见 package.json 的 `main`（纯 JS ESM）；客户端半边声明见 `dsh.client` 与 `exports["./client"]`。

## 许可

MIT

Keeps the DeepSeek Harness composer's context-usage ring honest: an empty usage
sample during a retry no longer collapses it to `0%`, and its percentage is
typeset at the size of the figures beside it.

[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin that repairs two defects in the composer's **context-usage ring** — one in
the value it shows, one in how large that value is drawn:

1. the ring stops dropping to `0%` while a model request is being retried — the
   host half; and
2. the ring's percentage renders at the size of every other figure on its own
   line — the browser half, one stylesheet rule.

## The two bugs it repairs

```
One line, in the composer footer:

  182 steps · 238 tok/s      33.4M tok · Cache hit 94%      ◯ 30%
                                                             ↑
              the ring's 30% was one pixel larger than every other figure

Mid-retry, the same ring read 0% instead of holding the last real reading:

  ◯ 0%   →   ◯ 6%
```

### The ring collapses to `0%` while a request is being retried

The ring renders the session projection `contextPressure`. That projection takes
the **newest usage sample** as the current prompt size and publishes:

```text
pressureTokens  = usage.inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens
projectedTokens = max(0, pressureTokens + surfaceTokens - sampledSurfaceTokens)
```

A model call that fails before the provider reports anything — a `429`, a rate
limit, a timeout, a transport error, or a user cancellation — still ends its
stream with a `usage` chunk:

```jsonc
[ { "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "usage",  "usage": { "inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 0, "totalTokens": 0 } } },
  { "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "finish", "reason": { "kind": "error",
      "failure": { "code": "RATE_LIMIT", "message": "429: token_capacity_exceeded" } } } } ]
```

The adapter's accumulator starts at zero and nothing ever overwrote it, so this
sample is *empty*, not a measurement. But it is the newest sample, so
`pressureTokens` becomes `0`, and because the sample is stamped at the current
surface total the projection publishes `projectedTokens: 0`. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`
then retries the same step — six times in the session this plugin was written
from — and the ring reads `0%` for the whole storm, misreporting a context that
never changed.

Measured against the shipped `contextPressure` fold, replaying that session's
real events (`test/fold.spec.ts`):

| Replay | `pressureTokens` | `projectedTokens` | Ring |
|---|---|---|---|
| after the last successful call, before the retry | 64 389 | 64 389 | `6%` |
| the failed attempt, **unguarded** | 0 | 0 | `0%` ← the symptom |
| the failed attempt, **guarded** | 64 389 | 64 389 | `6%` |
| the retried step finally succeeds | 64 575 | 64 575 | `6%` |

### The percentage is one pixel larger than the figures beside it

The same footer band holds the session statistics and the ring, and the two
shipped stylesheets disagree by one pixel about how big a figure is:

```css
/* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat — StatsPills.module.css, the pills */
.bOPqQW_root    { font-size: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) - 1px) }

/* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation — ContextMeter.module.css, the ring */
.JObwrW_trigger { font-size: var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) }
```

Both prefixes are content-hashed per build — the pair above is what the
`0.2.0-rc.2` packages installed here carry; the *declarations* are what matters,
and `test/meter-typography.spec.ts` re-reads them from the installed packages
rather than trusting this block.

So `30%` renders about 8% larger than the `182 steps`, `238 tok/s`, `33.4M tok`
and `Cache hit 94%` beside it, which reads as a different typeface. Measured on a
screenshot of that line: every other figure has a 12 px cap height, the ring's
has 13–14 px — a ratio of 1.08, exactly `13 ÷ 12`. The meter's own breakdown
panel is already `12px`, so the trigger is the outlier.

## What the plugin does

| Half | Surface | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `llm/stream` waterfall | one listener that withholds an empty usage sample belonging to a failed attempt, so the projection keeps its last real reading |
| Browser | the document `head` | one self-tagged stylesheet rule that puts the meter's percentage at the statistics pills' figure size |

Neither half adds a page, a route, a settings section or a stored file. The host
half declares `inject: ['llm']`, so the LLM service must exist first, and it
registers inside `ctx.effect`: cordis runs the disposer on unload, when the
profile patch disables the row, or at shutdown — a bare `ctx.on` would leak the
listener past unload.

One rule, applied to the chunk stream of every model call:

> A usage sample whose **every reported count is zero** measures nothing. When it
> belongs to an attempt that ended in `error` or `aborted`, it is dropped, so the
> previous real reading stands.

Everything else passes through untouched:

- **a successful completion**, whatever it reports — `stop`, `tool-calls` and
  `max-tokens` are authoritative provider answers, so a zero there is left for
  the consumer to judge;
- **a failed attempt that did report something** — a partial call can carry real
  input counts, so no billed counter is ever discarded;
- **stream shape, order and timing** — the withheld sample is the only chunk that
  moves; visible deltas keep their order and the terminal `finish` the retry
  executor reads is preserved.

## How the fix works

### Host half: the sample that decides the reading never lands

The wrapper holds **at most one** `usage` chunk and releases it immediately
before the next chunk, so the only chunk whose position can change is the sample
that decides the outcome. A stream that ends without its terminal `finish` still
releases a held sample — the guard never swallows information it did not
positively decide to drop. Withholding the chunk is legal in the stream protocol:
`usage` may appear at most once and is never required, `BlockAssembler.usage`
stays `undefined` without it, and the agent loop already omits the durable
event's `usage` field rather than failing. Token accounting is unaffected — the
projection's usage fold adds an empty sample's buckets as zero anyway, which
`test/fold.spec.ts` pins directly.

### Browser half: one stylesheet rule

The browser half adds one stylesheet rule that repeats the statistics
declaration verbatim:

```css
button[aria-haspopup="dialog"]:has(> svg > circle) {
  font-size: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) - 1px);
}
```

- **Structural selector, not a class name.** The meter's button is the only
  dialog-opening control whose icon *is* the ring — an inline `<svg>` with
  `<circle>` children — while the statistics pills draw `<path>` icons. A build
  that re-hashes every class

plugins.description: ADHD-friendly output style for DeepSeek Harness: a system-prompt hook, a live switch, and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-adhd-mode

ADHD-friendly output style for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). It puts a ruleset in the system prompt that makes replies easier to act on: the next action first, numbered steps, state restated each turn, no preamble. You can switch it on and off while a session is running.

A port of [ayghri/i-have-adhd](https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd) (MIT). The ruleset in `skills/adhd-mode/rules.md` is upstream's text with one paragraph replaced: upstream is turned off when the reader says a phrase, and this bundle has no phrase to say ([what changed](#changes-from-upstream)).

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

## What this replaces

Upstream is a set of glue scripts, one per runtime. On Claude Code it registers a `SessionStart` hook that pastes the ruleset into the session, and keeps an "always on" flag file at `~/.claude/.i-have-adhd-always`. DSH has no session-start hook, so all three pieces live in one bundle here:

| Piece | Upstream | Here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| hook | `SessionStart` hook | an `agent.ctx`-scoped `systemPrompt.section()` with a dynamic `text` |
| switch | flag file under `~/.claude/` | a `.volatile()` config field, live and persisted |
| page | none | a settings page and an icon+label trigger in the composer tool row |

## Changes from upstream

One paragraph of the ruleset is not upstream's: `## Persistence`. Upstream turns the mode off when the reader says "stop adhd mode", and its `SessionStart` hook re-pastes the ruleset whenever a session starts, resumes or compacts. Neither can happen here — the Host half matches no text — so that paragraph now says the switch lives outside the conversation and that nothing said in the conversation changes the mode. Everything else in `skills/adhd-mode/rules.md` is upstream's text, frontmatter included; the `disable-model-invocation` flag is inert because this bundle never registers the file as a skill.

Upstream's ruleset moves slowly (the project is mostly per-runtime glue), so there is no sync workflow: this copy is a fork, edited by hand.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:letterk/dsh-adhd-mode
```

That is the whole install. `dsh plugin` forwards the rest of the line to pnpm inside the profile, and the next boot promotes any new dependency that declares `dsh.bundle` to a profile layer on its own — there is no second step. Restart the profile afterwards.

Other specs pnpm accepts:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-adhd-mode
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-adhd-mode
```

The name `dsh-adhd-mode` is free on npm, but this project is not published there, so install by repository spec.

Installing from a working tree you intend to edit takes one extra step: see [live-edit install](#live-edit-install).

## Use

Two places, both in the Web UI:

| Where | What |
| --- | --- |
| the `ADHD` button in the composer tool row | click to flip |
| Settings → ADHD output mode | the switch on the page |

The change lands on the next model step and is written to the profile's config, so it survives a restart. There is no command, no tool and nothing to type — the UI is the only control, and the only place to look when the mode is not doing what you expected.

The switch is profile-wide, not per session. DSH's `PromptSection` takes no session key, so there is nowhere to store whether the mode was on in one particular session.

What *is* scoped is the injection. The section is registered on the agent's own context rather than the plugin's, so the ruleset reaches the agent the reader is talking to and stops there. A delegated child — anything spawned with a delegation depth, which includes Agent Teams teammates — joins its parent's preset and assembles with its own persona and tool set, never with this section. A session forked from another is a top-level agent the reader opened on purpose, so it does get the section.

## Config

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `false` | volatile; the switch the UI writes |
| `order` | `15` | position of the section in the system prompt |

## Files

```
index.js                        host half: the system-prompt hook
client.js                       client half: composer trigger and settings page
cordis.patch.yml                loader row that inserts the plugin
skills/adhd-mode/rules.md       the ruleset, from upstream
locale/{en,zh}.json             bundle title and description
icon.svg                        bundle icon
test/host.mjs                   host self-test
test/client.mjs                 client self-test, stub React
test/loader-hooks.mjs           points the schemastery import at the stub in a bare checkout
test/schemastery-stub.mjs       minimal stand-in for @deepseek-ai/schemastery
scripts/release.mjs             version bump, changelog freeze, tag; CI uses verify/notes
```

## Versions

[Semantic versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html). The compatibility surface is small — the loader row id and the settings namespace, the two strings a profile stores — so the rules are about what an existing install would have to do:

| Bump | When |
| --- | --- |
| MAJOR | an install has to be redone: the loader row id or the settings namespace changes, a config field disappears, or the bundle needs a newer DSH |
| MINOR | the reader gets something new, or the injection changes: a new seat, a new config field, a new language, a different prompt section |
| PATCH | a fix nobody has to react to: ruleset wording, docs, tests, internal refactors |

`package.json` holds the version, `CHANGELOG.md` records what is in it, and `[Unreleased]` accumulates until it is frozen. Cutting a release is one command:

```sh
npm run release -- patch    # or minor / major
```

That bumps the version, turns the `[Unreleased]` entries into a dated section, runs the tests, commits, and pushes the tag. `.github/workflows/release.yml` then publishes the GitHub release from that section. CI refuses a tag that disagrees with `package.json`, and a `doctor` job refuses a version that no changelog section explains.

The plugin market reads the version out of `package.json`, so the number here is what a listing shows. This project is not published to npm, so nothing depends on the number for resolution — but the tag is the only immutable pointer to "the code a reader had".

## Development

```sh
npm test
```

`test/host.mjs` loads `index.js` against a fake Cordis context and checks that exactly one section registers per top-level agent, that a delegated child gets none while a fork still gets one, that the ruleset appears only while the switch is on, and that the Host half exposes no command, tool or phrase matching. `test/client.mjs` loads `client.js` against stub browser globals and a stub React, then renders both seats in `zh` and `en`.

Neither test needs DSH, a browser, or `npm install`.

The host test uses the real `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` when it resolves, and `test/schemastery-stub.mjs` when it does not — which is the case in CI, a fresh clone, and any checkout without the profile's packages linked in. Take the stub path on purpose with:

```sh
DSH_ADHD_MODE_STUB=1 npm test
```

### Live-edit install

`file:` installs a copy, so the profile keeps the revision it was installed from. To have the profile read your working tree directly, link it instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-adhd-mode
```

A linked bundle is imported from its own directory, so its bare imports resolve there and not in the profile. Give the checkout a `node_modules` that reaches the harness packages:

```sh
cd /path/to/dsh-adhd-mode
mkdir -p node_modules
ln -sfn ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai node_modules/@deepseek-ai
```

Without it the row installs and then fails to import: `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'`. The link is in `.gitignore`, so a fresh clone has to repeat this once.

`client.js` is not hot-reloaded in every setup; reload the Web UI page after editing it.

Live inspection, from a session inside the harness:

```
cordis_inspect_query host/Config  listConfigs  {"entry":"include:adhd-mode"}
cordis_inspect_query client/Slots listSubTree {"root

plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）网页版的划词引用插件：选中任意文本 → 就地写批注 → 变成带编号的引用胶囊落进输入框，原文同时留下高亮与编号。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-selection-ask · 划词提问

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

> 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）网页版用的**划词引用**插件。
> 在对话里选中一段文字 → 就地写批注 → 它变成**带编号的引用胶囊**落进输入框，
> 原文上同时留下**高亮和编号**；删掉胶囊，高亮和编号一起走。

选中之后（那片底色是插件自己接管的，不是浏览器的原生选区）：

![选中后的就地输入栏](docs/images/pending-light.png)

回车提交之后（原文上有高亮 + 右上角编号，输入框里有胶囊）：

![引用进去之后的原文标注](docs/images/annotated-light.png)

深色宿主下同一套控件（配色走宿主 design token，插件不自己判主题）：

![深色主题](docs/images/annotated-dark.png)

---

## 它解决什么

读 AI 的长回答时，你经常想指着其中**某一句话**追问：

> "这里为什么这么写？" / "展开讲讲第三点" / "这句翻译成中文是什么？"

没有这个插件，你得手动选中 → Ctrl+C → 点输入框 → Ctrl+V → 再打字；
而且粘进去的是一段**没有形状**的裸文本，模型分不清哪句是你说的、哪句是你引的。

有了它，引用是一步动作，而且**引用是有身份的**：每一条引用有编号，原文上有对应的
高亮与编号牌，悬停胶囊能看回原文。模型收到的仍然是 markdown 引用块：

```markdown
> 一句话对照：上面那串"往下压"是递，撞到出口后"往回收"是归——两个动作合起来才叫递归。

（这里接着写你的问题，光标已经在这了）
```

---

## 一次引用的生命周期

**唯一事实源是"输入框里的胶囊"** —— 只有一套状态说了算，三个地方才不会各说各话：

```
胶囊在   →   原文的高亮在、编号在
胶囊没了  →   原文的高亮走、编号走
还没提交  →   那片选区由插件高亮接管（你永远看不到自己的选区凭空消失）
```

这就是为什么删掉输入框里的胶囊，原文上的高亮和编号会**跟着一起消失** ——
它们不是三份各自独立的记录，而是同一件事的三种呈现。

---

## 用法

1. 在网页里**选中一段文字** —— AI 的回答、你自己发过的话、工具输出、代码块，哪都行；
2. 光标旁浮出一条就地输入栏 —— 就地写批注，或者什么都不写；
3. `Enter` 写进输入框 / `Ctrl`（macOS 上 `Cmd`）`+ Enter` 写进输入框**并直接发送**。

| 动作 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 选中正文 | 浮出就地输入栏；同时那片文字的底色**不会消失**（换成插件的同族高亮） |
| 就地输入栏里按 `Enter` | 写进输入框，**不发送** —— 你还能接着改、接着补 |
| 就地输入栏里按 `Ctrl/Cmd + Enter` | 写进输入框**并立刻发出去** |
| 写批注后提交 | 输入框里是 `[胶囊] 你的批注`（胶囊在前） |
| 悬停胶囊 | 浮出这条引用的原文 |
| **在输入框里删掉胶囊** | 原文的高亮与编号**同时消失** |
| 点别处 / 按 `Esc` | 收起浮层，不动输入框 |
| 在**输入框里**选中文字 | **不出**浮层 —— 那是在编辑，不是在引用 |
| 连续引用多段 | 每段各成一块，追加而不是覆盖 |
| 选中的内容超过 8000 字 | 截断，并提示「内容过长，已截断」 |

**编号的粒度**：一个页面生命周期内全局递增（`选中文本 1`、`2`、`3`…）；
同一段文字被再次引用时**复用原来的编号**（同一处标注不该有两个号）。

---

## 已知边界（说清楚，免得踩空）

1. **同一段文字在转录里出现多次时，高亮取第一处。** 锚定方式是"按原文文字找回来"
   （不存字符偏移 —— 转录是 React 按会话日志重渲染的，偏移一定会漂）。
2. **引用的原文必须落在单个文本节点内**（跨元素的选区锚不到）。
3. **转录虚拟化时，滚出屏幕的那段暂时不亮**，滚回来就恢复。这是这套锚定方式的边界，
   不是 bug。
4. **高亮依赖浏览器的 CSS Custom Highlight API**（Chromium 105+；DSH 桌面版与
   `dsh web` 都是 Chromium，实测可用）。不支持时高亮与编号**静默缺席**，
   但引用本身照常工作，并在控制台留一条告警。
5. **⚠ 侧边提问（未完成，封存中）**：浮层上那个「侧边提问」按钮能开出右侧栏面板、
   能把选中的那段带进去，**但面板里的发送按钮收不到真实鼠标点击**（已定位到原因：
   面板内 `pointerdown` 被 `preventDefault` + `click` 在冒泡到 React 根容器之前被拦，
   修法已写进 `项目档案`）。所以**它现在发不出问题**，默认别用它。
6. **热更新不可靠**：改完产物请**刷新页面**（`Ctrl+F5`）再看效果 ——
   HMR 在这台机器上实测不稳定（页面手里的 combo `rev` 会 404）。

---

## 安装

⚠️ 先纠一个坑（不少插件文档在这里是错的）：**DSH 的 CLI 会直接拒绝 `--profile desktop`** ——

```
$ dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Eos010/dsh-selection-ask
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

桌面版的 profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理。所以按你实际在用的版本二选一：

### 桌面版（Electron 应用）

在 DSH 应用内安装。也可以手动两步（**下面这套是实测跑通过的**）：

```powershell
# 1) 把仓库放进 profile 的 node_modules
git clone https://github.com/Eos010/dsh-selection-ask `
  "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-selection-ask"

# 2) 在 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组里加一行：
#      "dsh-selection-ask"

# 3) 重启 DSH，然后刷新网页（Ctrl+F5）
```

### 命令行版 `dsh web`

```bash
npm i -g pnpm        # dsh plugin 是 pnpm 的转发器，PATH 上得先有 pnpm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Eos010/dsh-selection-ask
```

（从本地工作副本装，就把 `github:…` 换成 `file:<你的工作副本路径>`。）

**两种方式装完都要重启一次 DSH**，然后刷新网页（`Ctrl+F5`）。
为什么必须重启这一次：安装会把本包登记进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，
而那个清单**只在启动时读一次**。

卸载就是反过来：从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 删掉那一行、删掉 `node_modules` 下的目录，重启。

---

## 怎么实现的

### 两半结构

```
index.mjs          宿主半边：一个流式问答端点（+ 两道安全门）
client.js          浏览器半边：全部交互（源码）
ask-panel.js       浏览器半边：侧边提问面板（源码，与 client.js 拼进同一个 bundle）
selection-ask.css  全部样式
build.mjs          ask-panel.js + client.js + CSS → lib/client.js（产物已提交）
lib/client.js      构建产物，宿主真正加载的就是它
```

宿主半边**不声明任何 `inject` 服务**。这是刻意的：DSH 的插件是宿主 Cordis 树上的一个
entry，客户端半边由这个 entry 带出来 —— 所以纯 UI 插件也得有 node 半边；但**声明一个
拿不到的服务**会让 fiber 停在 PENDING，启动器的 `assertEntriesActivated` 会因此
**丢掉整棵插件树**。少声明一个，就少一条把宿主搞挂的路。

### 为什么挂在 `conversation.input.right` 这个插槽上

要把字写进输入框，只有一条正路：DSH 公开的输入动作。而它只作为**会话作用域插槽的
标准属性**发给插槽组件。所以本插件在输入框工具行里占一格，那一格本身只画一个
`display:none` 的锚点 —— 它的意义有两件：拿到 `inputActions` / `useInput`，
以及**用锚点反查输入框编辑器**（从锚点往上走，第一个包含 `contenteditable` 的祖先）。
**不写死任何宿主类名。**

锚点还有第三个用途：**数输入框里现在还剩几个胶囊** —— 这是"引用的生命周期"的判据
（见上）。判据与悬停预览取 label 的方式**逐字相同**，两处判据不一致会出现
"悬停能看原文、但高亮判定说这个胶囊不存在"这种自相矛盾的行为。

### 引用胶囊：借的是官方机制

DSH 的输入框是 Lexical，`@文件` / `@对话` 插进去的就是**原子引用胶囊**。本插件注册一个
自己的引用源，`codec.serialize(ref)` 决定**发送时这条引用展开成什么文本** ——
所以胶囊只是**显示形态**变了，模型收到的仍然是 `> 引用原文`。

三个踩出来的硬知识（都在 `项目档案` 里有完整记录）：

- **`ctx.emit` 没有返回值，要用 `ctx.bail`**。输入机的四个事件声明是 `@mode bail`；
  用 `emit` 的返回值判成败 ⇒ 明明插进去了却判成失败 ⇒ 兜底的全文替换再把刚插好的
  胶囊抹掉。表象是"胶囊永远不出现"。
- **`InputState.draft` 是剪贴板投影，不是编辑坐标**。胶囊在编辑坐标里几乎不占位，
  在投影里占一大段。拿前者的长度去定位后者，永远定位不到。
- **插入位置不能只算一个，要"候选逐个试、让返回值挑"**。投影与坐标换算**并不总是
  对得上**：一旦对不上，唯一的候选会被拒，第二次引用就**静默失败**（兜底又因为
  "草稿里已有胶囊"拒绝写入，用户看到的是"点了没反应"）。所以有胶囊时还会补一层
  小整数阶梯（`胶囊数+1 … 0`，降序）—— 实测追加位置总落在这个范围里。

### 原文高亮与编号

- **高亮走浏览器原生的 CSS Custom Highlight API**（`CSS.highlights` + `Highlight`，
  实测色值：待定态 `rgb(212,212,213)`、已标注 `rgb(193,193,194)`，都是宿主 brand token
  按 18% / 26% 混出来的）—— **一个字节的 DOM 都不改**，所以 React 重渲染冲不掉它。
  （插 `<mark>` 再靠 MutationObserver 重挂，在流式输出的转录里会一直和 React 打架。）
- **编号牌放在我们自己的浮层里**，按 Range 位置贴上去，**不插进正文**；找不到就什么都
  不做，异常全吞 —— **绝不允许因为标注失败连累引用本身**。
- **待定高亮是必须的**：就地输入栏一出现就自动聚焦，而"聚焦一个 input"会让浏览器
  **当场清掉文档选区** —— 松手之后那片蓝色就没了，看起来就是"选完就消失"。
  所以我们用自己的高亮**接管**那一片：同族色、比"已标注"浅一档，视觉上是
  **换了个颜色**，不是消失。它用的是**活的 DOM Range**，只在浮层开着时存在。

### 什么时候**不**出浮层

- 选区落在可编辑区（含输入框自己）、`input` / `textarea` / `select` 里 —— 那是在编辑；
- 选区落在我们自己画的浮层里 —— 避免自引用套娃；
- **页面上有模态对话框开着** —— 模态框走浏览器 top layer，盖在所有 z-index 之上，
  让它出现就只是"看得见、点不着"，比不出现更糟。

### 主键还按着就不出浮层（拖拽事故的教训）

**症状**：鼠标按住拖，根本选不中字，一拖就断。
**根因**：选区一变成非空就触发 `selectionchange`，浮层立刻弹出来并自动聚焦输入栏；
而"聚焦一个 input"会让浏览器**当场结束这次拖拽并清掉选区**。
**为什么端到端全绿也没抓到**：`Input.dispatchMouseEvent` 的拖拽是**一瞬间**派发完的，
浮层还来不及插进去 —— **真人手速比测试慢，慢就会被自己的浮层打断**。
修法三条：主键按着时什么都不做、键盘选出来的选区不抢焦点、焦点在自己 DOM 里时
不因"空选区"而收起。量具也改了：**24 步、每步隔一帧**的慢速拖拽成了常驻断言。

---

## 开发

只需要 Node ≥ 22。运行时零依赖 —— React / react-dom 从 DSH 的**平台模块表**里取
（`require("react")`），不打包、不重复引入第二份 React。

```bash
node build.mjs                       # 源码 + CSS → lib/client.js
node test/bundle.test.mjs            # 15 项：产物接线、插槽注册、样式落点、失败不抛
node test/selection.test.mjs         # 36 项：引用块形状、草稿拼接、生命周期、浮层落位
```

`lib/client.js` **是提交进仓库的构建产物**：装插件的人不该被迫先跑一次构建。
`build.mjs` 同时是一道闸门 —— 它会把产物反过来校验一遍（占位符恰好出现一次、
内嵌 CSS 与 `.css` 文件逐字节一致、构建期间源码未被改写），任何"改了源码忘了重新构建"
都会当场报错。

### 端到端验收（真浏览器）

单元测试碰不到 DOM 与真实鼠标事件，所以另有一套 CDP 驱动的验收：它派发**真实**的
鼠标事件序列，读**真实**的 DOM 与**真实的 `CSS.highlights`** 来判定。

```bash
# 1) 起一个独立的测试实例（不要拿你正在用的那个）
dsh web --port 3099 --no-open

# 2) 起一个开了远程调试的 Chrome，打开实例打印出来的那个带 token 的 URL
chrome --headless=new --remote-debugging-port=9223 \
       --user-data-dir=<临时目录> "http://127.0.0.1:3099/?token=…"

# 3) 跑验收（需要在页面上打开一个**有内容**的会话）
node test/e2e/selection-ask.e2e.mjs --cdp-port 9223 --app-url http://127.0.0.1:3099

# 顺带产出 README 用的截图（深浅各跑一遍）
node test/e2e/selection-ask.e2e.mjs --cdp-port 9223 --app-url http://127.0.0.1:3099 \
     --shots docs/images --theme dark
```

**43 条断言**，其中几条只有真浏览器抓得到：

- 浮层中心点 **`elementFromPoint` 命中自己**（没被别的层盖住）、`pointer-events`
  **没有被继承成穿透**；
- **24 步慢速拖拽**中途不出浮层、选区不归零，松手后才出浮层；
- 三个状态的**真实高亮**：选中时待定高亮 `size === 1`、提交后归 0 且标注高亮为 1、
  **删掉胶囊后标注高亮与编号牌一起归 0**；
- **直发**：`Ctrl+Enter` 之后输入框被清空、那条消息出现在正文里；
- 整轮下来**没有未捕获异常** —— 这条是量具的保险丝：只在事件回调里抛的
  `ReferenceError`，页面看着一切正常，坏的只是那一个动作。

> ⚠️ **跑一次 E2E 会真的向模型发一条很短的请求**（验"直发"和"侧边提问"两条路径）。
> 它用的是你在测试实例里配的模型，注意额度。

### 装进正在运行的那份（免重启）

profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 是**被实时监视的**（`patchReload: live`）：

```powershell
# 1) 把包挂进 profile 的 node_modules（目录联接，改工作区源码就是改运行中的那份）
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-selection-ask" `
         -Target "<你的工作副本路径>"

# 2) 往 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 末尾追加：
#    - insert:
#        - id: selection-ask
#          name: dsh-selection-ask
```

改完源码跑一次 `node build.mjs`，**然后刷新页面**（`Ctrl+F5`）。
（`dsh-client-hmr` 会每 500ms 轮询 bundle 的 mtime/size，但它在本机实测不稳定 ——
页面手里的 combo `rev` 可能已经过期，表现为 bundle 404。**刷新才是可靠路径**，
所以这里不承诺热更新。）

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-theme-windowsxp

DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 **Windows XP 体验包**，一个插件两半：

1. **Luna Blue 皮肤** —— 米色面板、渐变按钮、`#7F9DB9` 输入框、圆角蓝色滚动条、Tahoma 界面字体；
2. **完成提醒** —— 一轮跑完时有提示音和弹窗，智能体停下来等你批准时**换一种完全不同的声音**。

配色**完全通过 `--dsw-*` 设计 token 注入**，没有任何一行依赖 DSH 内部的哈希类名——所以 DSH 升级改版式时，这个主题基本不会碎。

```
dsh-theme-windowsxp/
├─ package.json            # dsh.bundle / dsh.client / manifestVersion 声明
├─ cordis.patch.yml        # 把自己插进浏览器插件名册（id = 插件页上的开关行）
├─ lib/
│  ├─ index.js             # 宿主半侧：把 assets/ 里的素材经由同源路由发出去
│  └─ client.js            # 浏览器半侧（由 scripts/build.mjs 生成，已提交）
├─ src/
│  ├─ windowsxp.css        # ★ 皮肤真正的定义
│  ├─ notify.css           # 弹窗卡片（Shadow DOM 内）
│  └─ client.js            # 浏览器半侧的源码模板（皮肤 + 提醒）
├─ assets/
│  ├─ bliss.jpg            # Bliss 桌面壁纸（微软版权，不入 files）
│  └─ chime.wav            # 跑完提示音（微软版权，不入 files）
├─ scripts/
│  ├─ build.mjs            # 把两个 CSS 内联进 lib/client.js
│  ├─ check-tokens.mjs     # 拿真实 token 清单校验，抓拼错的变量名
│  ├─ check-cascade.mjs    # 校验规则优先级顺序
│  ├─ smoke.mjs            # 无浏览器验证协议 / 皮肤 / 两种提醒
│  └─ smoke-host.mjs       # 验证素材路由（含穿越与条件请求）
├─ locale/                 # 插件页显示的中英文标题与介绍
├─ token-inventory.json    # DSH 全部 403 个 --dsw-* token 及其明暗默认值
└─ preview/
   └─ windowsxp-preview.html   # 静态预览页，改 CSS 后刷这个页面看效果
```
