## 一、Luna 调色板

| 用途 | 色值 |
|---|---|
| 面板 / 对话框底色（3D Objects） | `#ECE9D8` |
| Luna 框架蓝 | `#0054E3` |
| 标题栏渐变亮端 | `#3A93FF` |
| 控件深蓝描边 | `#003C74` |
| 选中高亮 | `#316AC5` |
| 热跟踪浅蓝 | `#E4EDFA` |
| 输入框边框 | `#7F9DB9` |
| 禁用文字 / 柔和分隔线 | `#ACA899` |

标题栏那条经典渐变（预览页用的就是它）：

```css
linear-gradient(180deg, #0058ee 0%, #3593ff 4%, #288eff 6%, #127dff 8%, #036ffc 10%,
  #0262ee 14%, #0057e5 20%, #0054e3 24%, #0055eb 56%, #005bf5 68%,
  #0055eb 78%, #0054e3 86%, #0054e3 92%, #0054e3 94%, #0055e9 96%, #0057f0 100%)
```

---

## 二、DSH 主题的三条关键事实

### 1. 颜色住在 `--dsw-*` token 里

权威定义在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme` 的 `design-platform.css`，结构就两句：

```css
body                     { --dsw-alias-bg-base: var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-00); }  /* 浅色 */
body[data-ds-dark-theme] { --dsw-alias-bg-base: var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-950); } /* 深色 */
```

全库共 **403 个 `--dsw-*` token**（`token-inventory.json` 里有逐个的明暗默认值），其中 **119 个是语义 token**（`--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsw-specific-*` / `--dsw-menu-surface-fill`），本皮肤覆盖了 **113 个**——剩下 6 个是 onboarding 与 settings-card，它们从别的 token 派生，会自动跟随。

**两个关键发现**：

- `ui-layout` 的 `.frame` 和 `ui-conversation` 的 `.root` **都读 `--dsw-alias-bg-base`**。所以这一个值是「文件区」的底色，本皮肤设成白色。
- `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` 在 `ui-sidebar` 里是用 **`background:`**（不是 `background-color:`）消费的：

  ```css
  ._2H3hWW_root{ … background:var(--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill); … }
  ```

  这意味着**可以直接塞 CSS 渐变**——XP 那条蓝色任务窗格渐变因此是纯 token 覆盖，不需要任何 DOM 钩子。

### XP Explorer 的三条色带

截图里那个窗口本质是三种材质并排，DSH 能一一对上：

| Explorer | 材质 | DSH 对应 | 实现方式 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 菜单 / 工具栏带 | 米色 `#ECE9D8` | 会话区顶部的 `<header>` | chrome 规则：`body[data-dsh-windowsxp] header` |
| 任务窗格 | 长春花蓝渐变 `#7BA2E7 → #5F78D6` | 侧栏列 `[class*='sidebarCol']` | token：`--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` 塞渐变 |
| 文件列表区 | 纯白 | 会话根 `.root` | token：`--dsw-alias-bg-base: #FFFFFF` |

侧栏里的白色卡片（`File and Folder Tasks` 那种）对应的是侧栏里的 `<button>`：

```css
body[data-dsh-windowsxp] [class*='sidebarCol'] button:not(:disabled) {
  background: #ffffff;                 /* 白卡片浮在蓝色渐变上 */
  border: 1px solid #b8c8ea;
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: #00309c;                      /* XP 任务窗格的深蓝字 */
}
```

**为什么用 `[class*='sidebarCol']` 而不是完整类名**：DSH 的 CSS Module 类名长这样 `._2H3hWW_root`，`_2H3hWW` 这个哈希**每次重建都会变**，但语义后缀不会。`sidebarCol` 来自 `ui-layout`，是官方侧栏列的稳定钩子（另一个成熟皮肤 maid-atelier 也用它）。

**侧栏里踩过的三个坑（都是实测出来的，写下来省得再踩）**：

1. **hover 和 selected 是同一个 token**。`ui-workspace` 里写的是：

   ```css
   .projectRow:hover, .sessionRow:hover, .sessionRow.selected{
     background:var(--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover)}
   ```

   所以「选中」没有任何独立 token——你为 hover 选的颜色，就是选中的颜色。第一版皮肤把侧栏文字翻成白色，又让这个 token 保持浅蓝 `#E4EDFA`，结果**选中行白字白底直接隐身**（「选中了之后看不清了」就是这么来的）。修法：在侧栏作用域里把这个 token 重新绑成浅蓝 `#DCE9F9` 系，配合深色 ink。

2. **不要把 `--dsw-alias-label-*` 在侧栏翻成白色**。那是让文字在蓝底上好看的本能做法，但一旦列表行改成白色卡片，白字立刻又看不见了。**正确做法是让卡片承载文字**（XP 任务窗格本来就是这么做的）：ink 保持深色，行/按钮各自是白卡片。

3. **给行加卡片会把「当前会话」压平**。`ui-workspace` 用 `.sessionRow.selected` 标记当前会话，但那条规则只有 `(0,2,0)`；上面那条行卡片规则是 `(0,3,1)`，直接盖掉它——于是**每一行长得一模一样，看不出自己在哪个会话**（第二轮踩的）。修法：补一条更高特异性的选中规则，**并且放在行卡片规则之后**：

   ```css
   body[data-dsh-windowsxp] [class*='sidebarCol']
     :is([class*='projectRow'],[class*='sessionRow'],[class*='searchResultRow']):is([class*='selected'],[class*='folderActive']) {
     background: var(--xp-highlight);   /* #316AC5 实心选中，一眼就能看见 */
     color: #fff;
     /* 子元素是直接读 token 的（.time 用 --dsw-alias-label-tertiary），
        所以要在「行本身」重绑 token，而不是只设 color */
     --dsw-alias-label-primary: #ffffff;
     --dsw-alias-label-tertiary: #eaf0ff;
   }
   ```

   > 顺带一条选择器经验：白卡片规则必须同时列出 `button:is([class*='...Row'])` 这个变体，因为搜索结果行是 `<button>`，否则它会和通用按钮规则打成平手然后被 Luna 渐变盖掉。

**行与行的区隔**：`ui-workspace` 的行本身 `background` 是透明的、也没有边框，所以一列会话会糊成一整块字。给每行一张白卡片即可：

```css
body[data-dsh-windowsxp] [class*='sidebarCol'] :is([class*='projectRow'], [class*='sessionRow'], [class*='searchResultRow']) {
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #b8c8ea;   /* 用 box-shadow 而不是 border */
  color: #00309c;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}
```

用 `box-shadow` 而不是 `border`：行自带 `height` 和 `padding`，加边框会把布局顶歪，内阴影不会。

弹层都 portal 到 `<body>`，所以侧栏作用域扫不到它们。

### 通用按钮规则的边界（标签页 / 菜单项 / 列表项）

那条 `button:not(:disabled)` 的 Luna 渐变规则是把「大扫把」。它扫到 `role="tab"` 上时，把 `ui-conversation` 的**无边框下划线标签页**（`.tab{background:0 0;border:none;padding:0 0 9px}` 配 2px `:after` 下划线）涂成了一个个厚盒子，还多顶出 2px 高度 —— 就是「对话 / 轨迹 不协调」那一版。

`role="menuitem"` 和 `role="option"` 是同一类东西（8 个包里都有），所以一起排除。**关键是排除，不是覆盖**：

```css
body[data-dsh-windowsxp]
  button:not(:disabled):where(:not([role='tab']):not([role='menuitem']):not([role='option'])) { … }
```

给这些角色强写 `background: transparent` 看着更直接，但会**抹掉全 App 菜单与列表框的选中高亮**——组件自己的 `.item[aria-selected]` 规则比这条弱得多，压不住。

那个 `:where()` 是承重的：`:not([attr])` 每用一次就**加**一个 class 级特异性，直接连写会把这条从 `(0,2,2)` 抬到 `(0,5,2)`，**反超侧栏白卡片的 `(0,3,2)`，把上一轮的修复又干掉**。`:where()` 记 0 分，所以它留在 `(0,2,2)`。

> 因为「新规则悄悄压过老规则」已经栽了三次，所以加了 [`scripts/check-cascade.mjs`](scripts/check-cascade.mjs)：它自带一个特异性计算器（`:is`/`:not` 取最具体参数、`:where` 记 0、`#id` 算数、注释里的 `{}` 先剥掉），并断言下面这几条关键排序，平手时按文档顺序判——
>
> ```
> 侧栏白卡片 (0,3,2) > 通用按钮 (0,2,2)
> 侧栏行卡片 (0,3,2) > 通用按钮 (0,2,2) > ui-workspace 自己的行 (0,1,0)
> 当前会话   (0,4,2) > 侧栏行卡片 (0,3,2)
> ```

### Windows 标题栏那条横条（caption strip）

截图里「应用 / 编辑」所在的那条横条，一开始我以为是网页画的，扒完才发现它是**两半拼起来的**，而且**一半能改、一半完全改不了**：

| 部分 | 谁画的 | 能不能改 |
|---|---|---|
| 40px 横条底色 | Electron `titleBarOverlay.color` | ✅ **能，而且就是通过 token** |
| 「应用 / 编辑」文字与悬停态 | preload 用 **Shadow DOM** 渲的 | ⚠️ 只有 token 能表达的部分 |
| 点开后的下拉菜单 | **原生 OS 菜单**（主进程 `Menu.popup`） | ❌ 完全不行 |

关键链路在 `/lib/preload-app.cjs`：

```js
const probe = document.createElement("span");
probe.style.cssText = "position:fixed;visibility:hidden;"
  + "background-color:var(--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill);"
  + "color:var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)";
document.body.append(probe);
…
const color = nativeColor(getComputedStyle(probe).backgroundColor);  // → 横条底色
const symbolColor = nativeColor(getComputedStyle(probe).color);     // → 标题栏符号色
ipcRenderer.send(DESKTOP_IPC.windowsAppearance, lang, color, symbolColor);
```

主进程收到后就 `mainWindow.setTitleBarOverlay({ color, symbolColor })`。

**也就是说：横条的颜色 = `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` 的 `background-color`。** 早期版本我把这个 token 设成了**渐变**，而 `background-color: linear-gradient(…)` 是**非法值** → 探针读出来是透明 → 横条退回系统默认的 `#f9fafb` 浅灰，跟整个主题格格不入（就是「这里和风格不符」）。

修法：token 必须是**纯色**，渐变改由 chrome 层重新画回侧栏：

```css
--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill: #6c86dc;                    /* 纯色 → 喂给标题栏 */

body[data-dsh-windowsxp] [class*='sidebarCol'] > [class*='_root'] {
  background-image: var(--xp-pane);                      /* 渐变只留给侧栏 */
}
```

`>` 是承重的：只有侧栏自己的根节点直接挂在布局列下，侧栏内部托管的各个面板要保留自己的表面。

**剩下三样改不了**，说清楚免得白折腾：

1. **下拉菜单是原生的**。主进程里 `Menu.buildFromTemplate(items).popup({ window, x, y })` 弹出，坐标由网页提供。CSS 碰不到它，任何主题插件都碰不到 —— 想让它是 Luna 风格，只能改 DSH 自己。
2. **横条的 40px 高度**来自 Electron 的 `titleBarOverlay.height`。
3. **「应用 / 编辑」按钮的 6px 圆角**写死在 preload 的 shadow 样式表里。能通过 token 影响的只有字体、文字色、悬停底色 —— 而这三样本主题**本来就在管**（`--dsw-font-family`、`--dsw-alias-

plugins.description: Remote MCP server for audio stem separation, denoise, and reverb
plugins.readme_text: [Smithery](https://smithery.ai/server/@warmcoding/sonicaura-mcp) # sonicaura-mcp Remote MCP server for audio stem separation, denoise, and reverb. ## What it does SonicAura processes audio using GPU-accelerated AI: - **Stem separation** — split a track into 2, 4, or 6 stems - `2stems`: vocals + no_vocals - `4stems`: vocals + drums + bass + other - `6stems`: vocals + guitar + bass + drums + piano + other - **Denoise** - `music_denoise`: remove noise from music while keeping the instruments and vocals intact - `denoise`: aggressive speech cleanup for podcasts / interviews / voiceovers - **Reverb** — add spatial reverb with presets: `vocal_booth`, `studio_room`, `bathroom`, `concert_hall`, `church` ## Endpoint https://api.sonicaurastudio.com/mcp Transport: `http` (Streamable HTTP) Auth: OAuth 2.0 ## Tools | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `list_audio_tools` | List available task types and metadata | | `check_service_status` | Confirm service availability and credits | | `get_upload_url` | Presigned URL for files larger than 1 MB | | `upload_audio` | Base64 upload for files under 1 MB | | `process_audio` | Submit a task (`music_denoise` \| `denoise` \| `reverb` \| `2stems` \| `4stems` \| `6stems`) | | `check_task_status` | Poll a task | | `get_my_credits` | Check remaining credits | ## Usage Add the server to your MCP client config: { "mcpServers": { "audio-process": { "type": "http", "url": "https://api.sonicaurastudio.com/mcp" } } } Then ask your client things like: - "Extract the vocals from this song" - "Remove the vocals and keep the instrumental" - "Separate this song into 6 stems" - "Isolate the guitar track" - "Denoise this music but keep the background music" - "Clean up the noise in this voice recording" - "Add studio reverb to this vocal" ## Credits Processing uses credits. Get an account and credits at https://www.sonicaurastudio.com ## License MIT

plugins.description: dsh 插件：GitHub 日/周/月热榜监控 + 仓库详情中文描述与 README 节译（全程只读 GET）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-gh-trending

DSH（deepseek HARNESS）的 **GitHub 热榜监控**插件：在侧边栏「插件」下方增加一个入口，盯三件事 ——
**日榜 / 周榜 / 月榜各自怎么变**、**哪些仓库同时在多张榜上**、**本机第一次见到的仓库**。变化只记录在本插件面板里，不推任何外部通知。

对 github.com 全程**只读 GET**（每轮三发 = 三张榜各一发；只有传输类失败——连不上/超时——才对那一榜补发，单榜含补发最多 3 发，成功即停）：不带 key、不带 cookie、不 POST、不下载 zip、不 clone。
★ **第二十三轮（10-09）加的那一路有尾巴**：开了「全站高星」那一档 ⇒ 一轮最坏**四发**（三榜 + `/search/repositories` 一发），那一发**每轮上限一枚、不补发、不重试**，且**出厂关着** ⇒ 关着时上面那句"每轮三发"照旧一字成立；填了 GitHub 令牌时它也走同一条 `Authorization` 请求头那一路（只进请求头，不进 URL）。
★ **同日就地改判（用户裁定「开启的时候默认拉取一次」）**：把开关从关拨到开的那一趟 ⇒ **另加一发、当场花**（它不属于任何检查轮，所以那一轮的"四发"账不因为它变成五发）。口径钉三条：认的是库里的**转换**（已经开着再存一次 `true`、改别的键时顺带带上、连点 ⇒ 一律不派），**回执之前发完**（保存偏好的响应回来时那一批已经在库里也在载荷里，不留"点完了但结果在别处"），**发过就追帧**（坏轮的故障三格同样当场让界面看见）。匿名 search 一小时才 10 发 ⇒ 这一发是用户点下去授权的，不是插件自己起的。
★ **同日第二条裁定（「上次间隔时间范围内已经拉取过就不要拉取了」）**：那一趟从"必发"改成**当场决定发不发** —— 库里**最后一次成功取回**（`ok===true` 的 `at`）距此刻不到一份**检查间隔**（`prefs.intervalMin`，设置页那一格，出厂 60 分）⇒ 0 发，直接把库里那一批端上来（挡下的一趟不写库、不追帧，开关位跟着同一次回执上屏）。窗口不另造常数、界面上看得见的那个数字就是它；⚠️ **上一发是坏的（403 / 超时）时照旧重试** —— 判据吃 `at` 而不是 `lastFetchAt`，不许让用户为了重试去等下一轮检查；这一道闸**只挂在开启那一趟**，检查轮"每轮一发"的节律一字不动。
需要代理时走插件自己的 **CONNECT 隧道**（`lib/services/net.js`）：它不改本机任何代理设置，也不起监听端口，只在需要时向代理发起一条 `CONNECT github.com:443`，之后仍是标准 TLS + HTTPS GET。

**它是什么**

- **三张榜独立闸门**：日 / 周 / 月各一份状态，坏在哪一榜就只冻结哪一榜，绝不连冒横幅。
- **变化流水**：`board_enter / board_exit / board_move / first_on_board / renamed / rising_cross / cooling_cross / source_error / source_recover / baseline`（枚举与中文标签只在宿主侧 `lib/domain.js`，界面只查表）。位次挪动日/周 ≥3、月 ≥2 才记 `board_move`。
- **跨榜同现**：同时出现在 ≥2 张榜 = 持续升温，只剩 1 张 = 热度回落。三张榜在同一次检查里拿到，**这块分析零额外请求**。
- **明星仓库那一屏**（★ **第二十三轮（10-09）新增**，第七个页签）：答「哪些仓库反复上榜、谁在往上走」，原料**全在本地**（三榜这一轮的行 + 观测史 `seen`）⇒ **打开这一签零请求**；七列里「今日新增」只吃日榜、证据不足 3 轮时「在榜」那一列**整列置灰并说清为什么**（不藏列）。另有一档「全站高星」（`GET /search/repositories`）**出厂关着** —— ★ 10-09 改判：**点「开」的那一刻宿主立刻发一发**（不等下一轮检查），之后每轮最多一发、结果进缓存，关掉不删已攒的那批，详见「界面」那节；★ **10-10 第三条裁定**：开着时它那一批行**也参与描述列的现译**（与榜面共享那 12 发，关掉只是不上屏、不删译文）。
- **改名识别**：靠条目里的 `record_id` 认出同一个仓库换了 `owner/name` ⇒ 记 `renamed` 而不是「掉榜 + 新进」两笔假账。
- **仓库详情按需取**：点榜面条目的仓库名才弹出一张详情对话框，并在这一下点击去 `api.github.com` 要元数据 + README，把 GitHub 自己给的字段拼成**一张结构化段表**（`sections[]` 四段：`项目是什么 / 热度与元数据 / 仓库自己怎么介绍它 / 中文摘要`，★ 第十一轮起替代旧的那一整句 `narrative`；段序、段名、哪句摆在哪一段、哪句算小字**全在宿主拼死**，客户端只按 `kind` 摆），并探测仓库**自己写的**中文 README（★ `readmeSource` **五档**：`zh_default` 默认 README 本身就是中文 / `zh_file` 仓库另写了一份中文 README（★ **第十五轮起这一档有两条路**：根目录列表里命中 `README-zh_CN.md` 那类，**或**默认篇首屏那行语言切换里写着的相对路径命中（真机 `docs/i18n/README.zh-CN.md` 那一类，根目录压根没有）—— 两条路共用同一发正文请求，**编排仍是 4 发封顶**） / **`zh_section` 默认篇是外文但整篇里嵌着一段中文小节**（第十一轮新增，吃已经在手的那份正文，**零额外请求**）/ `en_default` 只有英文篇 / `none` 没 README）。
  描述那一句若命中内置离线词表，会在「项目是什么」那一段里**多**一个块「中文描述（内置离线预译 · <日期>，不是现译）」，原文紧跟着另起一块照给；没命中而现译开关开着时，换成「中文描述（<这一行当初是谁译的> · <日期 时刻>）」（`免费接口` / `百度` / `腾讯` / `阿里` / `模型现译` 五选一，库里旧行还可能有历史档名 `官方接口`，§8.4），**原文照样另起一块**（译文不替换仓库自己写的那句）。
- **描述列中文（内置离线预译表，`lib/desc-zh.js`）**：榜面与详情里的仓库描述，命中表里的就给一句**人工预译**的中文，没命中就只显示原文。三条口径：
  **离线**（这份文件是死数据，零 `import`、零 `fetch`、零模型调用，`dz-6` 从源码钉住）；**带来源与时间戳**（卡头与悬停都念「内置离线预译 · 2026-10-06」，界面不自己编日期）；
  **原文改过就不译**（命中判据是「仓库主键 + 原文与表里记的那一句逐字相同」，仓库把描述改了 ⇒ 静默退回原文显示，绝不拿旧译文指鹿为马）。
  表由脚本生成、不是手抄（`tmp/gen-desc-zh.mjs`：`src` 那一列由解析器从真榜面逐字取出，中文那一列是**人工写好**再合并进去的），当前 73 条；★ **覆盖面会随时间衰减** —— 表只认整理那天在榜上的那些仓库，掉榜/新上榜的描述就是原文。
  ★ **第二十二轮（10-08）起，榜面那一列不再只靠这张表**：内置表没命中的那几行由**每轮检查后的补译批次**接上（现译那一路、同一张 `trans` 表、同一把逐字复用判据）⇒ 一列里从此可能两种来源并存，
  所以**落款跟着每一行走**（悬停给「原文 + 这一行自己的来源 + 注」），卡头那句「描述中译为…」换成宿主**按这一张榜**算好的条数（`内置预译 N 条 · 现译 M 条`）。B 那三条口径一个字没动，表命中的行照旧不重发。
  ★ **10-10 第三条裁定起，这一路吃的参与行变成两组**：三榜那一批 ＋「全站高星」那一档**开着时**它那一批（同一张 `trans` 表、同一把逐字复用判据、同一份 12 发共享预算，榜面先吃饱）⇒ 那一屏的描述列从此也可能两种来源并存；关掉那一档就**一行都不进**（已攒的译文留着但不上屏）。"参不参与"这件事的出处**只有一处**（`descZhRows`），视图与批次两处都调它。
- **现译引擎五档（D，2026-10-06 第九轮加三档、同日第十轮扩成五档，`lib/services/web-translate.js` + `lib/services/llm.js`）**：内置表没命中的那一句描述（以及 README 英文节选的摘要），交给你在设置页选的那**一**档现译：
  `免费接口` = Google 网页版翻译（免注册免密钥，★ 不是官方授权接口，且这台机器直连不通、必须经代理）／`百度` = 百度翻译开放平台通用文本翻译（AppID + 密钥，签名 MD5，境内直连可达）／`腾讯` = 腾讯云机器翻译 TextTranslate（Version 2018-03-21、地域广州；SecretId + SecretKey，签名 HmacSHA1 v1，直连可达）／`阿里` = 阿里云机器翻译通用版 TranslateGeneral（Version 2018-10-12；AccessKeyId + AccessKeySecret，签名 RPC V2 的 HMAC-SHA1，直连可达）／`宿主模型` = 第八轮那一路（`lib/services/llm.js`，花宿主的模型额度）。**默认落免费接口**（用户裁定「两条都做，设置页选」+「与宿主模型并存，二选一」+「分段器并排五档」）。★ 三家云**要不要花钱、有多少免费额度以官网计费页为准**（这一轮没能复核到可引用的数字，所以界面上不念数字，只把注册入口摆出来）。五条口径**五档共用**：
  ~~**只在点开详情那一刻、只译当前这一条**（榜面永远零现译，一轮三发榜面照旧）~~　**★ 第二十二轮（10-08，用户回「按C来」）改判这一条**：现译发生在**两处** —— **点开详情那一刻译当前这一条**（原样）＋ **每轮检查之后给榜面上内置表没命中的那几行补一批**（用户三条裁定：「检查轮次后补」／「每轮 12 发 · 并发 2」／「复用「描述现译」这一档」⇒ **设置页不新增开关**）。
  ★ 改判的是**什么时候发**，不是发多少：**读路径恒零发**（打开面板 / 重开面板 / SSE 首帧一发都不派 ⇒ 界面永不"因为翻译而转圈"），配额严格按检查节拍花（出厂 60 分钟一轮，手动「重新取一次」也算一轮，一轮最多 12 发、同时在途 2 发、同一行失败 30 分钟内不再试）；榜面那三发 GitHub 请求照旧（补译不打 github.com）。形状见 `docs/design-spec.md` §8.7；
  **B 优先**（表命中的行压根不派活，两个来源不会在同一屏打架）；
  **三道源侧闸门**（★ 第十一轮加两道、第十九轮补第三道，都排在派活之前：**仓库自己写的描述就是中文** ⇒ 不派描述那一发；**README 已经有中文** ⇒ 不派摘要那一发 —— ★ 第十八轮把这一句点名到三档：`zh_default` 默认篇整篇是中文 / `zh_file` 仓库另写的那份中文篇（根目录名或默认篇里的语言切换行指到的）/ `zh_section` 整篇里嵌一段达标中文小节，**只有默认篇是英文（`en_default`）才译**；`none` 由"没有节选"挡。★ **第十九轮（用户改判「这两种也算有中文」）补第三道 `readmeZhOnScreen(节选)`**：即便档名是 `en_default`，只要**要派出去的那段节选**里 CJK ≥ 8（中英混排篇，真机 `thedotmack/claude-mem` 9 字）或出现「中文」两字（中文篇在子目录没抓到、只剩那行语言切换字样）⇒ 摘要那一发也不派，`self` 段名跟着补那半句实话（「（节选里已有中文）」／「（这行写着有中文版）」）。★ 判**节选**不判档名：`README_ZH_MIN_CJK = 20` 那条一字未动（它管的是「默认 README 本身就是中文」这句**档名**敢不敢说，降到 8 会把只有一行切换标签的英文篇改名成中文）；「日本語」不算中文、国名「中国」不算声明、英文 `Chinese` 不认（挡了就是删了用户在用的那一屏）。三道都在**源**上挡，不是译完了再挑译文。~~★ **第十五轮的第三道闸门不在这里，在那一路服务自己声明的 `kinds()` 里**：免费 / 百度 / 腾讯 / 阿里只有**翻译**能力，「整理成一段简体中文摘要」那一路只派给 `宿主模型` ⇒ 那四档连 `enabled('readme')` 都问不到，设置页那一行开关也跟着不摆~~　**★ 第十七轮（10-07）这一条被用户改判**：那一发放回来了，五档都派两发（原话「我前面是有摘要现译的，你在哪一次改坏了，给我放出来」）；`kinds()` 那道口与三道源侧闸门都还在，只是翻译四档现在也报 `readme`。**保留的只有措辞**：那四档给的是节选的**节译**，段名与设置页那句说明跟着档位走，只有宿主模型那档叫「摘要」）；
  **落库复用**（按「仓库主键 + 原文逐字相同」判，仓库改了描述就重译，绝不拿旧译文指鹿为马。★ 第十一轮把「**换了引擎，旧译文照样复用**」这一条**钉成裁定**：现行行为就是要的行为 ⇒ **零代码改动**，只补判据与文档，落款署的是那一行**当初**的来源，不冒充新引擎）；**两档开关各开各的**（描述出厂开、摘要出厂关，都关掉时那一屏与 C/D 之前逐字相同。★ **第十五轮：那两行不再是写死的两行 —— 摆几行由当前那一路自己声明的 `kinds()` 决定**，载荷从 `descOn` / `readmeOn` / `switchLabels` 三格换成一张 `switchRows[]`。★ **第十七轮（10-07）改判后那份机制一字未动，动的是服务那份声明**：翻译四档现在也报 `readme` ⇒ **五档都摆两行**）。
  ★ **选路只有一处**（`pickTranslator`）：没选中的那四路连"你开着吗"都不问，五路服务互相不知道对方在 ⇒ 不会变成一次点击发五发。
  ★ **落款跟着那一行自己的引擎**：换了引擎不作废旧译文，也不拿新引擎的名字盖它 —— 库里那行署它当初的来源（`trans` 表行内 `engine` 字段）。
  ★ 额度分两本账：`宿主模型` 那一发不打任何 HTTP（走宿主连接）；另外**四发在插件的出网账里**（同一份 `net.js`、同一档 15s 超时），但**不吃 GitHub 那 60 次/小时**（另四个域名）。
  ★ **密钥的边界**（第十轮把这一格从"只有百度一家"扩成三家 × 六格）：密钥本体**只参与摘要那一步**，出网 URL 里只有各家的**标识符 + 一次性数 + 签名**
  （`appid`/`salt`/`sign`、`SecretId`/`Nonce`/`Signature`、`AccessKeyId`/`SignatureNonce`/`Signature`）；密钥**不进 URL、不出网、不回显、不进日志**，
  界面上只看得到「库里已存（留空不改动）」那一句。★ 标识符能进查询串是**翻译域**的例外，**GitHub 那一域默认零凭据**（★ 第二十一轮改判那句"仍然零凭据"：出厂 `ghToken` 空 ⇒ 与旧版一样一发凭据头都不带；填了才带**一条** `Authorization: Bearer`，**只进请求头、绝不进 URL**，且这一把密钥与那三把走**同一套**回显闸门 `PREF_SECRET_KEYS`；`cookie` 那三类头全域仍禁，全程仍只读 GET）。
  失败的话各说各的：模型那八档（开关没开 / 宿主没给模型 / 没设默认模型 / 超时 / 答错 + **回执原话** / 读不出中文 / 太长 / 没存下来）+ HTTP 那四路九档（多出的三档是 `no_credential`、`http`、**`bad_json`** —— 网页接口改了形状必须点得名，不许混进"没中文"），一律**原文照给**。
- **语言过滤**：可配一档语言（`prefs.language`，页面 slug 的小写形式），保存时**就地 GET 一张周榜验 `<title>`**，站点不认这个 slug 就拒收并说明原因。空 = 全站榜。
- **出网方式**：`跟随系统`（先环境变量 `HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY`，再 Windows 注册表的系统代理）/ `自定义地址`（只认设置页那一行，形如 `127.0.0.1:7897`，只支持 http 代理的 CONNECT 隧道）/ `直连`。默认 `跟随系统` —— 这台机器上直连 github.com 会超时，而注册表里就写着 `127.0.0.1:7897`。
- **设置**：检查频率（1 / 3 / 12 / 24 小时）、榜单条数（5~25，默认 15）、事件保留条数（50~2000，默认 300）、~~**详情缓存**（★ 第十二轮：`6 / 12 / 24 / 72 小时` 四档分段器，出厂 **24 小时**，改档下一发详情就按新档判新鲜；失败档那 5 分钟**不进设置页**）~~　**★ 第二十七轮（10-10）整行撤掉**（用户裁定原文「撤掉这一行，改成固定 60 秒防连点（推荐）」）：详情改成「每次点开都问一次、只问验证器」之后那一档没有任何东西会读它 ⇒ 撤档是一条链（domain 那三个名字 + `DEFAULT_PREFS` 那格 + `prefsRecord` 声明 + `clampPrefs` 名单 + `index.js` 的 `getTtlMs` 接线与 `prefsView` 初始格 + `api.js` 的 400 校验 + `hc-11` 键表 + 设置页那一行与 `hc-20` 那条正则），**五个点缺一处就是第二真相**；库里那格 `repoCacheHours` 由 `open()` **静默丢弃**（删格方向由 `tmp/probe-schema-drop.txt` 实测安全 ⇒ **零迁移**、域 `version` 仍钉 **1**），POST 走白名单丢弃（**不 400、不入库、不回显** —— 它什么都不决定，不像 `translateEngine` 的脏值会决定往哪个域名出网、那一路才需要 400）；替代它的是**固定 60 秒防连点**（`DETAIL_RECHECK_MS` 单点在 domain、**不进设置页**）⇒ 界面上少一个控件、多一条出网承诺，语言过滤、出网方式、**现译引擎**（并排五档分段器，出厂「免费接口」；选中「百度 / 腾讯 / 阿里」任何一家时才多出一行那**一家的两格**（标识符 + 密钥，密钥框是 `

plugins.description: Turn LLM responses into live interactive mini-apps, calculators, and themed Mermaid diagrams inside DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# 🪄 Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness English | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-Plugin-emerald.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) > **Turn LLM responses into live, interactive mini-apps directly inside DeepSeek Harness.** **Intelligent UI** is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (Desktop & Web UI) inspired by ChatGPT's Intelligent UI and Claude Artifacts. Instead of generating static walls of text, the model writes markdown embedded with interactive component tags, reactive expressions, and beautiful Mermaid diagrams. The chat interface renders them in-place in real time as the response streams in. --- ## 📸 Screenshots | 🧮 Interactive Pricing Simulator | ⚖️ Interactive Comparison Card | | :---: | :---: | | | |

🎨 Themed Mermaid Diagrams with Rounded Nodes & Semantic Role Colors

--- ## ✨ Key Features - ⚡ **Real-Time Interactive Mini-Apps**: Sliders, number inputs, dropdowns, and toggles recompute formulas, statistics, and charts instantly inside your browser—no backend round-trips needed. - 📊 **Rich UI Component Library**: Over 20 built-in components including KPI tiles (`stat`), bar/line/pie charts (`chart`), responsive layouts (`box`, `row`, `grid`), progress bars, data tables, badges, and segmented controls. - 🎨 **Beautiful Themed Diagrams**: Automatically transforms ` ```mermaid ` fences into styled diagrams with rounded cards, dark/light theme harmony, and hierarchy-aware typography. - 🔁 **Bidirectional Interaction**: Action buttons (`GenUI.issueNewTurn(...)`) let you send configured values back to the agent as your next prompt with a single click. - 🧠 **Context-Aware Triggering**: The model intelligently uses UI only when helpful (e.g., calculations, comparisons, workflows) and answers simple questions in clean plain text. - 🔒 **Secure by Design**: Expressions execute inside a sandboxed AST interpreter without `eval`, DOM access, or network permissions. Form state stays strictly within your local browser session. --- ## 🚀 Installation Requires **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** or later (Desktop app or `dsh web`). ### Option 1: Web UI / Desktop App (Easiest) 1. Open DeepSeek Harness. 2. Navigate to **Plugins** → Click **Add plugin**. 3. Enter either package name or repository URL: ``` @rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui ``` or ``` https://github.com/rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui ``` 4. Click **Install**. The plugin is ready to use immediately without restarting! ### Option 2: CLI Installation Run the following command in your terminal: ```sh # For Desktop app profile (make sure to quit Desktop first): dsh plugin --profile desktop add @rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui # For Web server profile: dsh plugin --profile web add @rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui ``` > **Note**: To temporarily return to plain-text replies, simply toggle off the plugin in **Plugins**. --- ## 💡 Example Prompts to Try Once installed, prompt the model naturally with questions that benefit from interactivity: - **Simulators & Estimations**: > *"Create a SaaS pricing simulator where I can adjust team seats and billing frequency (monthly vs. annual) and see the discount impact."* - **Product Comparisons**: > *"Compare MacBook Pro M3, ThinkPad X1 Carbon, and Dell XPS 13 for battery life, weight, price, and developer workflows with interactive filters."* - **Workflow & Architecture Diagrams**: > *"Draw a flowchart showing how a GitHub pull request goes through CI checks, code review, and deployment."* - **Financial & Planning Calculators**: > *"Build a mortgage repayment calculator with loan amount, interest rate slider, and amortization chart."* --- ## 🛠️ How It Works (What the Model Writes) The plugin injects concise instructions into the system prompt. The model writes standard Markdown enhanced with JSX-like component tags and reactive state declarations: ```md {@body const [seats, setSeats] = useState(25)} {@body const [price, setPrice] = useState(1200)} Team Plan Estimator ``` ### Supported Components & Syntax | Category | Available Elements | |---|---| | **Layout & Structure** | ``, ``, ``, ``, `` | | **Typography & Data** | ``, `<text>`, `<caption>`, `<label>`, `<badge>`, `<icon>`, `<stat>`, `<progress>` | | **Tables & Collections**| `<table>`, `<table-row>`, `<table-cell>` | | **Data Visualization** | `<chart type="bar|line|pie|area" data={...}/>`, Themed Mermaid diagrams | | **Interactive Controls**| `<slider>`, `<input>`, `<checkbox>`, `<radio-group>`, `<radio>`, `<segmented-control>`, `<select>`, `<button>` | | **Expressions & Logic** | `{expression}`, `{#if condition}...{/if}`, `{#each item in list}...{/each}`, `{@body ...}` | --- ## 🛡️ Security & Privacy - **Sandboxed Execution**: Expressions are evaluated via a safe AST interpreter. There is no `eval()`, `new Function()`, access to `window`/`document`, or network fetch access. - **Local State Privacy**: Interactive input state is saved per message in your browser's local storage. Values are never sent to the model until you explicitly click an action button. - **Safe Resources**: External links open via DeepSeek Harness's native safe URL handler. External images only load from model-specified HTTPS URLs. --- ## 📋 Compatibility - **DeepSeek Harness**: `v0.2.0-rc.1` or later - **Tested Models**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet / 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o / GPT-6.1, DeepSeek-V3 / R1 --- ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). Distributed client bundles package [mermaid](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) and [zod](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod). See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for full licensing disclosures.

plugins.description: An eye-friendly green skin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-leafy-skin

An eye-friendly green skin: a leafy palette layered over the official DSH web GUI theme, in a
light emerald and a dark mint variant.

> I wanted the effect of a Minecraft resource pack.

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

## Screenshot

![Screenshot](show.png)

## Features

- **Layered greens** — a mist-green canvas, raised panels, and a deeper sidebar, with emerald
  accents in light mode and mint in dark, instead of one flat wash of green.
- **Comfortable by construction** — no pure white or pure black, a single green hue family, and
  all body text at WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1).
- **Texture** — softer corner radii, green-tinted diffuse shadows, low-contrast hairlines, and
  glassy menu surfaces.
- **Details** — mint text selection, Inter / Noto Sans SC / Cascadia Code font stacks, slim
  scrollbars, and restrained hover and menu motion.
- **Tunable** — the palette is one commented table, a self-check script guards contrast, and the
  style layer has a single on/off switch.

## Install

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-leafy-skin
```

Restart DSH once afterwards so the profile recomposes. After that, colour edits only need a page
refresh (client changes hot-reload within about a second).

## Usage

Install the plugin and load the app. The skin layers itself over the active theme, so light, dark,
and follow-system each pick up their own variant automatically.

## Customize

- **Colours** — the `TOKENS` table in `lib/client.js`, grouped and commented by area.
- **Radii, shadows, fonts, motion** — the same file, plus the small style layer below it.
- **Palette only** — set `ENABLE_CSS_LAYER` to `false` in `lib/client.js` to drop the style layer
  entirely.
- **Check your work** — `node tools/check-palette.mjs` validates token shape, text and syntax
  contrast, and the style layer's three constraints.

## Uninstall

Any one of these, then restart DSH:

1. Comment out the `insert` entry in `cordis.patch.yml`;
2. Drop `dsh-leafy-skin` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`;
3. Run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-leafy-skin`.

## Known limitations

- The native window title bar belongs to the DSH desktop shell, not to this plugin, so it stays
  DSH grey for the instant before the page paints.
- Real see-through glass is impossible on Windows — the sidebar depth and translucent menus are
  colour layering, not blur through the window.
- Components hard-code font sizes and layout in hashed CSS modules, so this skin deliberately
  leaves them alone.

## Changelog

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

## Contributing

Issues are welcome: bug reports, colour suggestions, screenshots of anything that looks off.

**Pull requests are not accepted** — this is a personal skin, and reviewing patches would cost more
than it returns. Please open an issue instead.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Unofficial DSH TUI plugin for Orca terminal readiness and finalized completion
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Orca Terminal Status

An unofficial, independent DeepSeek Harness plugin that reports real DSH TUI
readiness and completion to Orca's existing terminal status channel. MIT licensed.
No modified Orca application is required.

## Why

With Orca 1.4.220, DSH can finish a request while Orca still waits for `tui-idle`:
DSH's Claude-compatible hooks report HTTP events, whereas that readiness check
expects terminal status. See [Orca issue #25257](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/issues/25257)
and [the upstream PR](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26074).

This plugin listens directly to DSH lifecycle events; it does not translate an
HTTP `Stop` into completion. `Stop` can still enqueue continuation work.

- Reports startup readiness only after the TUI's actual child runtime finishes
  activation and the single root agent is idle with an empty inbox.
- Reports `working` for a running root and `done` for finalized idle, using
  ordered OSC 9999 writes to the existing PTY.
- Ignores subagents, ambiguous multiple roots, non-TTY SDK output, and terminals
  without Orca's pane environment. Requires matching frontend/service ownership.
- Leaves Orca's existing HTTP hooks in place for their existing purposes.

## Tested versions

| Component | Version |
| --- | --- |
| Official Orca | 1.4.220 |
| Official DSH / dsh-agent | 0.2.0-rc.2 |
| Community `@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui` | 0.13.0 |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | 4.0.4 |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader` | 1.0.5 |
| Real integration platform | macOS, Apple Silicon |

This implementation depends on TUI/Cordis internals (`internal/status`, fiber
state/parent/store and `dsh-tui-runtime`), in addition to DSH's plugin loader.
Plugin-loader compatibility alone does not guarantee those internals remain
compatible. The manifest declares the tested peer versions; optional peers avoid
automatically installing another DSH or TUI copy. Missing TUI does not provide
readiness. Revalidate upgrades; compatibility with other versions, Windows,
Linux, SSH and multi-root frontend routing has not been established.

## Install

Use Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24` and an existing DSH TUI profile. Install exactly
once: do not combine this bundle with a manually inserted copy of the plugin or
an Orca release that already emits the same DSH PTY status. Installing a bundle
changes every session using that profile; schedule installation between sessions.

Through DSH's official package-management CLI (replace `dsh-tui` with your profile):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add https://github.com/Alex-wangyang/dsh-orca-terminal-status/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-orca-terminal-status-0.1.0.tgz
```

Alternatively, download and extract that release, then ask DSH's native
`plugin_manager` to use `action: install_bundle` with `target` set to the absolute
extracted package directory. This package contains `dsh.bundle.patch`, no runtime
dependencies, no build step and no install/prepare scripts. npm registry publication
is not required. Do not run `npm install` inside DSH's profile yourself.

Restart DSH after package replacement and launch it inside Orca. Verify the
composed plugin row and native `tui-idle` readiness, then run a harmless task and
verify completion. A saved bundle selection alone does not prove runtime health.

Remove the bundle using the same profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui remove dsh-orca-terminal-status
```

This removes the bundle-managed plugin, not an older manually installed home
patch. Preserve Orca-managed hook rows when removing a manual installation.

## Verification

```sh
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

Eight behavioral tests cover delayed/failed frontend activation, root and inbox
guards, child events, Stop continuations, ordered immediate wake, SDK isolation,
disposal and frontend ownership. They need no model credentials or DSH installation.

The same runtime source was exercised against the tested real stack: cold worker
launch and same-process worker reuse both admitted successfully, wrote independently
verified task marker files, and reported native worker completion. Orca's native
`tui-idle` check also passed after completion and on a fresh final-source launch.
The official Orca application bytes were unchanged. These are bounded integration
results, not a guarantee for later releases. Release packaging is separately tested
with DSH's native installer in an isolated profile.

## 中文

这是独立维护的非官方插件。它监听 DSH 的真实状态，把就绪、工作中和完成状态
写入 Orca 已有的终端通路，使官方 Orca 也能正确识别 DSH worker。
它不会把 HTTP `Stop` 直接当作任务完成，也不需要修改 Orca 本体。

安装命令见上方；`dsh-tui` 应替换为实际使用的 profile。请勿重复安装手工副本
和 bundle。已实测的版本组合见表格；插件加载机制保持兼容，并不代表 TUI
内部生命周期永远保持兼容，因此 DSH/TUI 升级后仍需验证。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Independently maintained; not affiliated with or endorsed by
DeepSeek AI, the DSH TUI maintainers, or Stably/Orca.

# DSH Chinese Minimal Custom Mode English | [中文](README.zh.md) Retains the complete `dsh-custom-mode` Settings UI for editing the system prompt, switching the base mode, toggling plugin rows, and managing multiple assistants. This fork changes only the first-install defaults: Minimal base mode and the complete system prompt `你是一个中文助手`.

## Install Install the stable GemChance GitHub release: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/GemChance/dsh-chinese-minimal-mode/tar.gz/refs/tags/v2.3.0 ``` Restart the process that serves the profile. The version on the settings page is the one that is running. Desktop app: install from the in-app Plugins page. The CLI cannot modify `profiles/desktop`. On Windows, `install.sh` is bash and it needs a `dsh` executable on `PATH`. Otherwise use the `dsh` shipped with DeepSeek Harness, or `node node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js`. ## Use 1. Open Settings → Custom mode. 2. Edit the system prompt. Save is directly under the editor. 3. A new session uses this assistant when `settings.yaml` has no `agent-presets.default` yet. An existing value is left as it is. On first install, the plugin creates Custom mode with the Minimal base and initializes `prompt.md` to `你是一个中文助手`. Everything remains editable from Settings, and upgrades do not overwrite existing user data. The prompt is `prompt.md`. The next time a model step is assembled, that file is read again. History can load an older draft into the editor; loading does not write. A save computed against an older copy is refused when the file changed underneath. The model can change the same file only through `custom_prompt`, which asks first. The page is two branches. This assistant edits the one you have open, and all five base modes can be chosen. New assistant writes only when you click New assistant: Coding, Writing, and Chat stay selectable, and only the official Standard mode is lit. The other four official modes are dim and cannot be chosen there. | Posture | After create | | --- | --- | | Develop | Official Standard mode, tools as shipped. | | Write | Official Standard mode. Terminal off, file tools on. | | Chat | Official Standard mode. Files and terminal off. | ## Boundaries - It does not replace Standard, PTC, Minimal, or Creator. - It does not ship a role-play preset. - It does not run in the desktop profile from the CLI. Headless mode will not start a session that uses an agent preset. ## Compatibility Declared range: `>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.1.6-alpha.1 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.1.7-alpha.1 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0 || >=0.2.1-alpha.1 <0.3.0-0` | dsh | Claim | Checked for 2.3.0 | | --- | --- | --- | | `0.2.0-rc.2` | declared | Windows web profile, before this release | | `0.2.1-alpha.1` | declared, in CI | not re-run for this release | | `0.1.7-rc.2` | declared, in CI | not re-run for this release | The unit suite also passed under WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04 (Node only, no dsh process, no browser). That is not a Linux desktop result. ## Docs - [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) — wrong version installed, base mode unavailable, half-finished upgrade - [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — where the prompt is read, and which host calls this package depends on - [docs/PUBLISHING.md](docs/PUBLISHING.md) — tags and release - [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — people - [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — agents ## License MIT

plugins.description: Connect DeepSeek Harness to a ChatGPT subscription through official browser sign-in. macOS community add-on.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH OpenAI subscription add-on

![Installation guide: install the add-on, connect your ChatGPT plan, and choose a model in DSH](docs/installation.gif)

Install this small add-on after installing ordinary DeepSeek Harness. It adds OpenAI models and reasoning controls to DSH, using the official Sign in with ChatGPT subscription flow.

## Connect

This first release supports **macOS**, Node.js 22+, macOS Command Line Tools, pnpm, and **DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1**. It does not bundle another DSH runtime.

If DSH is not installed yet:

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.1 pnpm
```

Install the shared package, then connect:

```sh
npm install -g pnpm https://github.com/teilomillet/dsh-openai-subscription/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-openai-subscription-0.1.0.tgz
```
```sh
dsh-openai connect
```
```sh
dsh web
```

The connection command installs the provider into DSH's existing **web** profile and opens official browser sign-in. Allow the app to use your ChatGPT plan. In DSH, select a workspace, open the model menu, and choose **OpenAI subscription (ChatGPT)**. The **Effort** submenu exposes the documented options for that model. Restart DSH after connecting if it was already running.

Your other DSH providers, model selection, tools, and sessions remain intact. Usage counts against your ChatGPT plan. This add-on uses text and function tools; image input and native OpenAI hosted tools are not implemented.

The account model list can omit GPT-6.1 Sol. Connection makes at most one 60-second low-effort check for an omitted, previously unverified GPT-6.1 Sol, and adds it locally only after completed inference. That check uses a small amount of your plan allowance. Other reasoning levels come from official model capability documentation. Failed verification leaves the discovered models available. Reconnecting a verified profile avoids another access check.

## Share or install through Git

Share the **.tgz file**, or commit this package's source with its .gitignore. No login credentials or account-specific model state belong in the repository.

To build a package from source:

```sh
npm ci
npm pack
```

The pack step builds the vendored SDK automatically. Send the generated tarball to the other computer and run the connection commands there. Each person signs in with their own account.

## Commands

```sh
dsh-openai connect                 # install web provider and sign in
dsh-openai connect --profile headless
dsh-openai login                   # reconnect without reinstalling
dsh-openai status
dsh-openai models
dsh-openai logout
```

Without a global add-on installation, DSH's native plugin commands work too:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-openai-subscription-0.1.0.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-openai login
dsh web
```

To remove the provider from a profile, run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-openai-subscription`. Run logout first if you also want to disconnect the subscription.

## Local state and security

Authentication, model discovery, and the Keychain helper are stored under `$DSH_HOME/openai-subscription/` (normally `~/.dsh/openai-subscription/`). `DSH_OPENAI_HOME` can select a separate state directory. OAuth state is encrypted with a key stored in macOS Keychain; credentials are not copied from Codex. The package and generated tarball exclude all account state, sessions, model overrides, caches, and installed dependencies. Browser consent remains an explicit user action.

Windows and Linux are not supported by this release. The macOS helper needs Command Line Tools to compile on first use; install them using `xcode-select --install` if needed.

## License and provenance

This package and its modified Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit are distributed under the included **Sign-in with ChatGPT DevKit Noncommercial License**. Personal noncommercial experimentation is allowed; commercial use is outside this license. Vendor licenses, third-party notices, source, and modification notices are included. This is a community add-on, not an official DeepSeek or OpenAI product.

Inspected source revisions: Harness 5badb15009ae1756c3afe0ae0cef1faafc290ccc; DevKit f723814abdccec135b519c451fb6e1992ee5e933.

- [Official subscription sign-in](https://developers.openai.com/siwc/quickstart)
- [Models and inference](https://developers.openai.com/siwc/token-sharing-open-source/models-and-inference)
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

plugins.description: Push DeepSeek Harness agent notifications to your phone and watch via ntfy, Bark, Gotify, Telegram or a webhook.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify-push
Push DeepSeek Harness agent notifications to your phone and watch via ntfy, Bark, Gotify, Telegram or a webhook — without keeping the browser tab open.
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-notify-push?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-notify-push?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/releases/tag/v0.4.1)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-notify-push?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-notify-push?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-notify-push/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin. It pushes a short notification to your **phone** — and, through the
phone's own notification mirroring, to your **watch** — whenever an agent
finishes a turn, hits an error, or is waiting on your approval.

Unlike a browser notification, this leaves the machine: it goes out over the
network to a push service you choose, so it arrives while the Harness tab is
closed and the laptop lid is shut.

```
Settings ▸ Notify Push                          v0.4.1
└── delivery state, an editable configuration form,
    the exact server and topic to subscribe to, armed triggers,
    a live preview, the delivery log,
    and one "Send test notification" button
```

It is a section of the Settings panel, not a page in the working area: a
notifier is configured once and glanced at occasionally, so giving it a permanent
sidebar icon and a whole centre column overstated it. The Settings shell owns the
trigger, the nav entry, the panel and the scrolling container, so this plugin
contributes only the section body — deliberately with no `height`, no second
scroll and no horizontal padding, all of which the shell already provides.

The version beside the title is read from the manifest **at runtime**, not baked
in at build time, so it names the build the harness actually loaded. That matters
because installing a new package does not re-compose a running profile: a swap on
disk leaves the old code live until a restart, and the chip is the fastest way to
tell those two situations apart.

## What a notification says

Every notification carries the same three facts, in a fixed shape:

| Part | Where | Example |
|---|---|---|
| **event type** | title | `Agent finished` |
| **host** | title | `workstation.local` |
| **session** | body line 1 | `Fix the login redirect` |
| **detail** | body line 2 | `done in 42s` |

So a lock screen reads:

```
Agent finished · workstation.local
Fix the login redirect
done in 42s
```

The event type is one of `Agent finished`, `Agent error`, `Approval needed`,
`Question asked` or `Test notification`. `titlePrefix` prepends a literal
(`DSH · …`) when you run more than one Harness.

A `Question asked` notification carries the question itself, not just word that
one exists — a prompt that only said "the agent has a question" would make you
open the app to find out whether it mattered:

```
Question asked · workstation.local
Fix the login redirect
Choose Mode — Which deployment should I target?
Blue · Green
```

The heading, the question and (when there are a few) the offered choices, so the
lock screen carries enough to decide whether to answer now. A longer question is
truncated here, with a visible ellipsis, rather than left for the OS to cut
mid-word.

## Screenshots

![Notification pipeline](docs/images/notification-flow.png)
*How an event reaches your phone: the engine paces and de-duplicates, the formatter composes the two lines, the provider delivers.*

![Notification preview](docs/images/notification-preview.png)
*Rendered from this plugin's own formatter output — the exact title and body strings, shown as they appear on a lock screen. Not a device screenshot.*

![Settings section layout](docs/images/settings-section-mockup.png)
*Layout mockup of the **Settings ▸ Notify Push** section (illustrative, not a screenshot).*

## Surfaces

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| Host route `GET /api/dsh-notify-push/status` | provider, destination, armed triggers, counters, live preview, form descriptors |
| Host route `GET /api/dsh-notify-push/history` | the recent delivery log |
| Host route `POST /api/dsh-notify-push/test` | send one synthetic notification |
| Host route `POST /api/dsh-notify-push/config` | merge validated settings into this row's config |
| Settings section **Notify Push** | the whole surface: status, form, subscribe block, preview, log and test button |

One slot registration, into `settings.section` — a `list` slot declared by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-general`, whose entries carry
`{ id, order, label }` and whose active entry the shell renders inside its own
scrolling panel. `dsh.client.inject` names both that package and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`, which owns the canonical slot contract and
is what makes the registration type-check against the real slot map.

Every route is loopback-fenced, method-checked and body-size-capped. The config
route additionally validates its patch against the field specs before anything is
written — a rejected key never reaches the settings document, which outlives the
process and would otherwise be reapplied on every boot.

## Install

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check                              # typecheck both halves, build, then vitest
pnpm run pack                           # -> dist/dsh-notify-push-0.4.1.tgz
```

The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so `dsh plugin add`
refuses it: install the packed tarball from **Settings → Plugins**. A bundle
added to a running profile needs a **restart** before its entry can be imported;
the browser half additionally needs the page reloaded.

## Configure

**Edit it in the panel.** Open **Settings → Notify Push**; the **Configuration**
section renders a form for the selected provider: pick the backend, fill in its
fields, press Save. A saved value applies **immediately** — no restart — because
every field of the row's schema is `volatile`, so the loader swaps it into the
running fiber rather than waiting for the next boot. It is also written to the
host's settings document, so it comes back after a restart.

Secret fields (tokens, device keys) are **write-only**: the stored value never
leaves the host, so the input starts blank and shows `stored` or `not set`.
Leaving it blank keeps what is there — there is no clear action, deliberately, so
a save can never wipe a working credential by accident.

Each secret field carries its own eye button, which unmasks **what you are
typing** so you can check a paste before saving. It cannot show the stored value,
because the browser was never given it — an untouched field stays empty with its
`stored` placeholder, revealed or not.

Configuration also works from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, which survives
plugin upgrades. The row id is `dsh-notify-push`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-notify-push
  name: dsh-notify-push
  config:
    provider: ntfy
    ntfyServer: https://ntfy.sh
    ntfyTopic: <a long random topic>
```

Both paths write the same thing, so you can set a value in YAML and later adjust
it in the panel, or the reverse. If a deployment composes no settings service the
form renders read-only and says so, rather than accepting a change with nowhere
to put it.

**Installing changes nothing on its own.** Every trigger defaults to on, but no
provider is c
